enrichments.description:
The entry for Duhara Basaheen also mentions that she was Keeper under Sierin from 979 NE to 984 NE and indeed was depicted as so in the New Spring novel., Duhara Basaheen}} These years correspond to the years listed as the tenure of Sierin Vayu, so this has been raised as a possible inconsistency with Angharad ever having held the position.

One possible solution to this inconsistency comes from the fact that Duhara was discovered to have been involved in the pogrom of male channelers known as The Vileness and that she recieved penance for it., Duhara Basaheen}} It is also known that Sierin had "intended to crush" the Vileness, which makes it seem like she knew of its existence, but not necessarily who was involved or the exact nature of their involvement., The Vileness}} She certainly did not know enough to carry out what her successor did, namely publically whip and subsequently exile all three Red Sitters. Given unconfirmed suspicions, Angharad could feasibly have been a replacement for Duhara in while she was pending further investigation, a move that requires ratification by law of the Hall of the Tower. This very public change in sentiment against the Red Ajah could have provoked them to act swiftly, putting in motion events that would culminate in Sierin's murder later that year.

Her hair was greying, her face grave, and she loved to wear a lot of jewellery, especially necklaces and rings.

She was a Sitter for the Blue Ajah when Moiraine Damodred was raised Aes Sedai in .

It may be assumed that Anlee died at some point after the end of the Aiel War, as she is not mentioned in the main series, and such a prominent Blue would surely have been mentioned in Salidar, had she for some reason stepped down from her position. Being a Sitter means that she was also a senior sister. She may have died of old age; she may have gone into retirement; she may have been one of the sisters killed during "The Vileness". She may also have been the Blue Sitter who was killed during the White Tower schism.

A forceful woman, not particularly arrogant for a Yellow, but strong-willed and determined, she did not suffer fools gladly

enrichments.description:
Annoura Larisen is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the Aes Sedai advisor to Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron, the First of Mayene.

She has dark hair, braided in the Taraboner style with dozens of long thin braids, a broad face, a wide mouth, a beak of a nose, and the typical ageless Aes Sedai look. She could have a pleasant smile. She has a stocky build. When nervous, she rubbed her thumbs with her forefingers. She is about 5'4 tall., Annoura Larisen|comp}}

She could be very self-effacing, fading into the background so others failed to notice her. She could appear distracted by things that didn't seem important, but she never was - not really. Towards non-Aes Sedai, she displays the typical Aes Sedai confidence and unflappability, manipulating Colavaere Saighan into thinking she was going along with her plan and met secretly with Masema Dagar.

Annoura was very weak in the One Power with a strength level of . The Companion says she is "very self-effacing, fading into the background", which would match being very low in their hierarchy. Merana Ambrey also believes that "Annoura should have been having the harder time with Cadsuane by far", indicating Annoura would be far below her own strength. With regards her ability to Travel, see Errata/Speculation below.
enrichments.short_description: Annoura Larisen is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the Aes Sedai advisor to Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron, the First of Mayene.

She is lanky with dark hair and brown eyes. She has a narrow face and a pointed nose. Her slender build makes her appear more tall than she really is.

She has a detached nature, seldom showing any emotion at all.

She thinks about clothes as much as anything else, and her clothes are always neat and of a high quality.

She was born in in Tarabon and was enrolled in the White Tower in .

She is secretly a member of the Black Ajah and a member of a Heart along with Marris Thornhill and Karale Sanghir. She is Talene Minly's extra contact outside of her Heart.

Elayne recalls that the Stone of Tear was created using the One Power and that Atuan says that such a feat was impossible for the White Tower today.

Ayako Norsoni is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

She is small, about 5'2" or 158 cm tall, with waist-length black hair, black eyes, and a dark complexion, but not so dark as a Domani. Her dark eyes seems almost black when she is concentrating.

Ayako prided herself on her logic, but she was not a particularly cool-appearing woman, being rather on the merry side, with a twinkle in her eyes, although she seemed shy, a rarity among Aes Sedai.

Ayako is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

enrichments.description:
Circa , Azille was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Azille's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Azille was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Azille and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

Balladare was elected Amyrlin in , succeeding Edarna Noregovna., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}. She is famous for the consideration that it is the moral duty of the Amyrlin to "explain herself to the common people" once she had made an important decision.

The Kavarthen Wars occurred during her tenure.

She used this to explain her reign during the Kavarthen Wars just before her death. Centuries later Egwene al'Vere quoted this line to Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan.

Balladare is regarded as a weak Amyrlin and died in .

During the War of the Hundred Years, Ishara of Andor sent her eldest daughter to study in the White Tower. For her show of support of the Tower, she was granted Ballair as an advisor.

Ballair became the first Aes Sedai adviser since the dismissal by Artur Hawkwing of all Aes Sedai holding posts across his realm. Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai (Free Years) Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

As punishment her time as Accepted was prolonged three more years, despite the need of new Aes Sedai in the Trolloc Wars time, and also she was forced to pass the bond to another Aes Sedai. Once she was raised, she was finally forced to bond Anselan, a stubborn much older man than her previous Warder, chosen personally for her by the Amyrlin Seat.

The presumed love story of Barashelle and Anselan is detailed in a famous book: The Flame, the Blade and the Heart. Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai after the Breaking Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

We have no information on where Barasine stands with respect to the One Power hierarchy except that she stands lower than Katerine Alruddin. Since Katerine is very strong in the Power, her level is , this does not give us much information,

As many Reds, Barasine holds a dim view of Wilders.

Barasine was one of the sisters, along with Javindhra Doraille, who Logain Ablar says promised him support if he declared himself as the Dragon Reborn. He says that she talked a great deal. These accounts were intended to discredit the Red Ajah, although it is unstated if they were misrepresented truths (in the Aes Sedai fashion) or outright fabrications.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

enrichments.description:
Beldeine Nyram was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Beldeine was Saldaean and exhibited the natural traits of the region; namely slightly tilted brown eyes and a nose with a hint of a hook. She also displayed the typical tilted cheekbones, though they were not as pronounced as most Saldaeans. Beldeine's aging slowed more considerably than most other Aes Sedai, which caused her to frequently be mistaken for a young woman no older than twenty.. At 5'5" or 165cm, she was above average in height and stood a hand or more taller than Verin Mathwin.

The Green Ajah quickly noted her keen mind and management ability and marked her as a sister who might perform well as an administrator. Such duties were boring to Beldeine, whose personality sought out adventure whenever possible. Nonetheless, such abilities might explain why Egwene chose her as Keeper in the alternate reality in her Accepted test.

Beldeine was strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of ., Beldeine Nyram}} She can Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Beldeine Nyram was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Beldemaine is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is plump with silver bells in her hair.

Beldemaine is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

As she is Yellow Ajah, we can assume she has an above average ability with Healing for an Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Beldemaine is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Bennae Nalsad is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She has dark hair liberally streaked with gray worn in a silver net, and sharp, blue eyes. She is slender, in a bony way.

Bennae is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Caren Endelle and Nisain a'Cowel, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She went to the White Tower when she was sixteen. She spent thirteen years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted before being raised to the shawl. Although her age is not known, judging by her graying hair she is probably more than 200 years old.
enrichments.short_description: Bennae Nalsad is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Beonin is a pretty Taraboner with dark honey-colored hair in a multitude of braids and blue-gray eyes so big they made her appear startled. She has a heavy accent.

She was usually quiet and watched everything carefully. Like Morvrin, she required a great deal of proof before believing anything.

Beonin has a strength in the One Power of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. She is equal strongest among those we have information on in the Gray Ajah among the rebel faction. The Sitter Kwamesa Taramasu is her equal. The only others that are close are Merana Ambrey and Meidani Eschede at level , both of whom are conveniently sent on missions away from Salidar. She is the weakest of the Salidar Six, but not by much.

Beonin was born in the year in Tarabon. Her mother, Aeldrine Marinye, was a wealthy merchant who traded in dyes despite the disapproval of her grandmother. Her grandmother, Collaris, was a noted advocate in Tanchico and instilled a love of the intricacies of law into the young Beonin.
enrichments.short_description: Beonin is a pretty Taraboner with dark honey-colored hair in a multitude of braids and blue-gray eyes so big they made her appear startled. She has a heavy accent.

enrichments.description:
Bera is a stocky Andoran with a square face. She looks like a farmwife with short brown hair and brown eyes, and would have been mistaken for a farmwife if not for her agelessness. Despite this, she has a sternness and strength of character equal to that of her Green colleague Kiruna Nachiman.

She has a One Power strength of , placing her close to the very top of the Aes Sedai hierarchy. Among the rebel faction, only Romanda Cassin and Lelaine Akashi surpass her in strength, and only Sheriam Bayanar and Kiruna Nachiman are her equal., various entries}} She is strong enough to Travel.

She went to the Tower in at the age of 15. After spending only four years as Novice and four as Accepted. During this time, she and Kiruna were pillow friends. Alhough both enjoyed men exclusively later, they remained the very closest of friends.

Bera was raised to the shawl in the year at the age of 23 - an almost unprecedented young age.

enrichments.description:
Berana Shemon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and was elected Sitter in the Rebel Hall of the Tower, despite being too young. She has no Warder.

She is 5'4 1/2 tall, haughty, with big brown eyes cold as snow and dark brown hair. She looks slim compared to Aledrin and has silver-embroidered white skirts.

Berana is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Berana is seventy years old, she was born in the year and went to the Tower in . After spending ten years as Novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
enrichments.short_description: Berana Shemon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and was elected Sitter in the Rebel Hall of the Tower, despite being too young. She has no Warder.

enrichments.description:
Berenicia Morsad is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is part of the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She is plump and always looks grave. She has a sharp tongue.

Berenicia is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability for the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She is the second weakest in strength among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Valinde Nathenos being weaker.
enrichments.short_description: Berenicia Morsad is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is part of the Salidar Aes Sedai.

enrichments.description:
Berisha Terakuni was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She had hard eyes and a narrow face. She was lean and the same height as Egwene al'Vere. She spoke with a strong Arafellin accent.

We have no precise description of Berisha's strength in the One Power from the Companion, although her ability to open a gateway large enough for a cart with passenger to pass through indicates she is at least a strength of . She also seems to offer resistance to Katerine Alruddin, which she would not be able to do if she were much weaker. Since Katerine has a strength of , Berisha can be guessed to have a level between and , making her considerably above average among Aes Sedai.

She was from Arafel. She stood high in the Aes Sedai hierarchy.
enrichments.short_description: Berisha Terakuni was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is stocky in appearance and wears her hair in beaded braids hanging well below her shoulders. She is 5'5 tall, with hazel eyes and pale brown hair.

She tends to be aloof in public, but can laugh and tell jokes with close friends.

She is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . Among the ten ferrets, Bernaile is the third in hierarchy by strength and years of training. She is also second strongest of the White Ajah among the Rebel Aes Sedai of which we have information, only Carlinya Sorevin being stronger and Brendas her equal.

Born in , she goes to the White Tower in . After seven years as a novice and nine as Accepted, she is raised Aes Sedai in .
enrichments.short_description: She is stocky in appearance and wears her hair in beaded braids hanging well below her shoulders. She is 5'5 tall, with hazel eyes and pale brown hair.

enrichments.description:
Beryl Marle held the position for thirteen years until her death in . She was Igaine Luin's successor and Eldaya Tolen's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Beryl is described as a weak Amyrlin, a compromise candidate chosen after the Hall had deadlocked on others; she turned out to have little interest in the world at all, so the Tower's influence waned considerably during her rule.

During her reign, the Tower's last known Dreamer prior to Egwene al'Vere, Corianin Nedeal, died.

enrichments.description:
Berylla Naron is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and part of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters.

Berylla is lean, almost to scrawniness. She has black hair and dark brown eyes.

Berylla is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, only Joiya Byir was weaker and Amico Nagoyin was her equal.

Berylla is 67 years old. She was born in 933 NE and went to the White Tower in 948 NE. After seven years as a novice and five years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: Berylla Naron is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and part of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters.

enrichments.description:
Bharatine is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. She allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai during the split.

Bharatine is thin, yet graceful, with a long nose. Though thin as a rail, she manages to look elegant.

Bharatine is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of ., Bharatine|Bharatine}}

She was born in and went to the White Tower in at the age of 15. She spent nine years as a novice and seven years as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: Bharatine is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. She allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai during the split.
Biranca Hasad was an Aes Sedai who lived after the Breaking of the World and before the founding of the White Tower., Biranca Hasad}}

enrichments.description:
Birlen Pena is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. She was first mentioned in Verin Mathwin's book, naming her to be a Darkfriend. It is unknown which of the seven Ajahs she also belongs to, but being in the Tower just before reunification means that she was not a Blue.

She escapes from the White Tower just after Egwene al'Vere becomes Amyrlin Seat, and avoids re-swearing on the Oath Rod.

enrichments.description:
The Black Ajah Hunters were a group of independent Sitters of five Ajahs in the Hall of the Tower under Elaida a'Roihan during the White Tower Schism. They came together more by happenstance than by actual teamwork, partially due to the animosity between the Ajahs, but teamed up in a joint effort to hunt down the Black Ajah.

The Black Ajah Hunters were the following Sitters:

Upon discovering that her Keeper of the Chronicles, Alviarin Freidhen, was definitely chipping away her power and possibly plotting against her, Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan, a Red Sitter who had pulled down and stilled the former Amyrlin Seat, Siuan Sanche of the Blue Ajah, and taken her place as Amyrlin Seat, considered the time right to start looking for proof of Alviarin's treachery. She ordered a Sitter from the White Ajah, Seaine Herimon, to search for evidence of treachery "as high as needed be," hinting at the Keeper. Seaine assumed this meant to search for the Black Ajah.

To help her in this dangerous task, Seaine enlisted the help of her former friend and fellow Sitter, Pevara Tazanovni of the Red Ajah. It was not only her friendship with Pevara that made Seaine ask for her help; all of Tazanovni's family had been murdered by Darkfriends. Seaine therefore thought her suitable for the task at hand.
enrichments.short_description: The Black Ajah Hunters were a group of independent Sitters of five Ajahs in the Hall of the Tower under Elaida a'Roihan during the White Tower Schism. They came together more by happenstance than by actual teamwork,…

enrichments.description:
The Black Tower Alliance is an alliance between the Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere and the Black Tower.

It began when the Rebel Aes Sedai traveled to Shadar Logoth and discovered strong residue weaves, stronger than a circle could protect against. Escaralde suggest that the only way to increase a circle past thirteen is to include male channelers. Moria Karentanis then makes an official suggestion to seek out the Black Tower in order to gain use of the Asha'man's aid.

The sitting was called by Moria Karentanis, Malind Nachenin, and Escaralde with the pretense of questioning a band of sisters who were sent to Shadar Logoth to survey the area where a beacon of saidar had been felt. (Unknown at the time, this beacon was the Cleansing of saidin.)

The five sisters who were sent are the strongest of the Rebel Tower at reading residues. They are Akarrin, Therva Maresis, Reiko, and two others unnamed. Akarrin, the strongest in the One Power amongst the five, leads the group, and testifies that they found a crater that appears to be all that remains of Shadar Logoth. She defers to Reiko, the strongest at reading residues to describe what she observed.
enrichments.short_description: The Black Tower Alliance is an alliance between the Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere and the Black Tower.

enrichments.description:
The Blue Ajah of the Aes Sedai normally involve themselves with righteous causes and justice. They have the most extensive eyes-and-ears network, and enjoy the prestige of having the highest number of Amyrlin Seats raised from their Ajah in the last millennium.

The Blue has been at odds with the Red Ajah for a millennium and for a time were separate from the White Tower altogether. The head of the Blue Ajah is called the First Selector.

Another typical characteristic of the Blue Sisters is that they often become embroiled in intrigue. In the eyes of other Aes Sedai they are incorrigible schemers. At least in recent history, the Blue Ajah has been at the centre of the political landscape within the Tower, to a far greater degree than might be expected for their small size. This can be further seen by the fact they have the largest network of Eyes-and-ears of all the Ajahs.

While they are not as fond of men as the Green Sisters, the Blue Sisters do not avoid males as some of the other Ajahs, notably the Red and White, seem to. Alanna Mosvani of the Green Ajah comments that a Blue sister likes men as long as they share her causes and do not get in her way.
enrichments.short_description: The Blue Ajah of the Aes Sedai normally involve themselves with righteous causes and justice. They have the most extensive eyes-and-ears network, and enjoy the prestige of having the highest number of Amyrlin Seats…

enrichments.description:
Bonwhin Meraighdin was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat.

Her name could indicate that she was from Fel Moreina in Esandara, given that -in is a common ending of names in Far Madding of both first names and surnames in the New Era; as common are long surnames.

She was born in FY 738 and was elected Amyrlin from the Red Ajah in , the same year as Guaire Amalasan declared himself as the Dragon Reborn and Bonwhin ruled for more than fifty years, one of the longest reigns in the history of the White Tower.

But finally, her attempt at controlling Artur Hawkwing as a puppet led to disaster. All the Aes Sedai were expelled from Hawkwing's empire and his armies put a nineteen-year-long siege to Tar Valon.
enrichments.short_description: Bonwhin Meraighdin was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat.

enrichments.description:
She is pale with cool, dark eyes, and a voice like chimes. She never shows any emotion and speaks in a level tone.

Brendas has a One Power strength level of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. This is strong enough to be able to Travel. She is the second strongest of the White Ajah among the Rebel Aes Sedai of which we have information, only Carlinya Sorevin being stronger and Bernaile Gelbarn her equal.

Brendas is 54 years old. She was born in and went to the Tower in . After twelve years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 985 NE.

She was an Accepted during the Aiel War. She and Temaile were on duty attending Tamra Ospenya, the Amyrlin Seat, and Gitara Moroso, her Keeper, before Moiraine and Siuan’s shift on the day Gitara has her Foretelling.
enrichments.short_description: She is pale with cool, dark eyes, and a voice like chimes. She never shows any emotion and speaks in a level tone.

enrichments.description:
The Brown Ajah of the Aes Sedai is devoted to knowledge and the collection of ancient wisdom. They generally forsake the mundane world, instead dedicating themselves to history and study, and are responsible for the administration of the White Tower Library. The Brown Ajah is run by a ruling council, the head of which is called First Chair.}}

The Brown is the fourth-largest Ajah, behind the Gray and before the Yellow with roughly one hundred and thirty sisters before the White Tower Schism. It has a low concentration of Black sisters with about twenty-eight, but we have only learned the identity of five.

The breakdown of the nationality of named Brown Ajah sisters in recent history is as follows:

One sister, Martine Janata, is labelled as "Borderlander" without further information. All Aes Sedai from the Atha'an Miere are Brown Ajah and this is likely not coincidence.

enrichments.description:
Cabriana Mecandes was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She had long golden hair and pale blue eyes, which was fairly rare for a Tairen.

Cabriana was very weak in the One Power, with a strength in the One Power of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing. Moiraine describes her as "not very strong at all".

Cabriana has the Talent of fast learning., Cabriana Mecandes}}
enrichments.short_description: Cabriana Mecandes was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Cairlyn Nesolle is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah., Cairlyn Nesolle}}

Cairlyn has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.
enrichments.short_description: Cairlyn Nesolle is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah., Cairlyn Nesolle}}

enrichments.description:
With a strength in the One Power of , Caraigan is the strongest Aes Sedai whose strength is given in the Wheel of Time Companion. Three thousand years later, she would be matched by Nynaeve al'Meara. If either Sharina Melloy or Talaan din Gelyn become Aes Sedai, they will surpass her. It is not known if Caraighan was the strongest Aes Sedai of the Third Age or if any other Aes Sedai were as strong sometime between her lifetime and Nynaeve, except that none have come close in more than a thousand years.

Caraighan was born in in an unknown nation during a time of great change and consolidation. The Compact of the Ten Nations had been signed only three years before her birth and the great city of Tar Valon had just completed its long construction seven years before that. Indeed, the calendar marking these dates had only just been adopted a decade or so previously.

Although an organisation of Aes Sedai under Elisane Tishar had existed for some time before this, Caraighan would have belonged to one of the first generations of girls to have attended the White Tower as a novice. She would have been living at the same time as the similarly famous Aes Sedai Mabriam en Shereed and the False Dragon Raolin Darksbane. Birgitte Silverbow also had an incarnation around the time of Caraighan's birth.

Along with Rashima Kerenmosa and Cadsuane Melaidhrin, she is considered the greatest of the Green Ajah's heroes. According to the her entry in the glossary she was "the heroine of a hundred adventures, credited with exploits that even some Aes Sedai consider improbable despite their inclusion in the records of the White Tower." These exploits included:

enrichments.description:
She is described as stout, but graceful. Her bulk was muscle rather than fat. She had wide shoulders and arms as thick as most men's. She was 5'5" or 166cm tall.

Careane is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler. She was the weakest of the sisters sent by Salidar to Ebou Dar.

She was from Arad Doman. She was a novice for two years with Zarya Alkaese, now known as Garenia Rosoinde. She had three Warders, Cieryl Arjuna, Venr Kosaan and Tavan Shandare. Only Venr was a darkfriend.

She had been Aes Sedai for more than fifty years. Careane could have been in the same heart as Marillin Gemalphin, for she was the one who revealed her as Black Ajah.
enrichments.short_description: She is described as stout, but graceful. Her bulk was muscle rather than fat. She had wide shoulders and arms as thick as most men's. She was 5'5" or 166cm tall.

enrichments.description:
Caren Endelle is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Caren Endelle}} She was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

Caren is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Bennae Nalsad and Nisain a'Cowel, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan.

=Trivia== Caren Endelle is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
enrichments.short_description: Caren Endelle is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Caren Endelle}} She was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

enrichments.description:
Carenna is an Aes Sedai of an unknown Ajah. She allied herself with the rebels in Salidar. Therefore, she is not Red Ajah.

She went to the White Tower at age seventeen; spent thirteen years as a novice and eleven as Accepted; and was raised Aes Sedai at forty one. It can be said that twenty four years of training mean that Carenna is not particularly strong, in fact usually the period in training reflects the strength of an Aes Sedai (if other factors are not involved, such as stubbornness, periods of rebellion, immaturity, blocks) and twenty four years is the period of training of sisters at a low level in the hierarchy.

When Nynaeve passes off a trick for eavesdropping using the One Power learned from Moghedien as her own discovery, Carenna picks it up with suspicious quickness. Nynaeave thinks that she, as an Accepted, can hardly accuse Carenna of having used such a trick before her 'discovery'.

Carenna says that she thinks the weave can be used to communicate with other sisters over long distances (two or more miles away). This adaptation of the eavesdropping weave has not yet been seen, if it was successful. Though, the Wheel of Time Companion says that with inverted weaves, this communication would have been very secure. Category:Rebel Aes Sedai Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Carenna is an Aes Sedai of an unknown Ajah. She allied herself with the rebels in Salidar. Therefore, she is not Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Cariandre is plump, full-bosomed and 5'5 tall. She was good-looking, though not a beauty. She is described as wearing elaborately red-embroidered gray silk. She has dark eyes and hair which she wore cut short, exposing her ears.

She cultivated a cool, reserved air, such as she imagined a noblewoman to have. However, she also had a bad temper, and would snap at people she should not (such as sisters who stood above her) and say things better left unsaid.

Cariandre is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

She was born in Ghealdan in . Cariandre was the daughter of a shoemaker. She went to the White Tower in where she spent thirteen years as a novice and twelve as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in 972 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Cariandre is plump, full-bosomed and 5'5 tall. She was good-looking, though not a beauty. She is described as wearing elaborately red-embroidered gray silk. She has dark eyes and hair which she wore cut short, exposing…

enrichments.description:
Carlinya was 5'5" or 165 cm tall, pale, with cool, almost black eyes and a broad face. After most of her dark hair was fried off in a Tel'aran'rhiod nightmare, she wore it in a cap of dark curls. She was of moderate build, neither slender nor stout.

She was somewhat messy, her hair sometimes being unkempt and her dress edge muddy from forgetting to wear a cloak. She often dressed in white with white embroidery, including a white skirt embroidered with scrolls.

She had a cold manner, seldom showing any sign of emotion. Her rationality made few concessions for human foibles. Or for anyone disagreeing with her. Siuan Sanche thinks she is "A great deal of logic and not much common sense".

With a One Power strength level of , Carlinya was strong by Aes Sedai standards and among the top tier of channelers among the Rebel Aes Sedai. Among the Salidar Six, she is as strong as Anaiya Carel, Morvrin Thakanos and Myrelle Berengari, but not as strong as Sheriam Bayanar.
enrichments.short_description: Carlinya was 5'5" or 165 cm tall, pale, with cool, almost black eyes and a broad face. After most of her dark hair was fried off in a Tel'aran'rhiod nightmare, she wore it in a cap of dark curls. She was of moderate…

enrichments.description:
Carniele is fair-skinned for a Tairen and has blue eyes and black hair. She is 5'6.5" tall and of medium build.

Carniele has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Since she is of Yellow Ajah, we can assume she has an above average ability at Healing.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the schism.
enrichments.short_description: Carniele is fair-skinned for a Tairen and has blue eyes and black hair. She is 5'6.5" tall and of medium build.

enrichments.description:
Catala held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Kiyosa Natomo's successor and Elise Strang's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her resignation and retirement were, supposedly, of free will. The fact is that she was guarded until her death in . She had been a strong Amyrlin.

When she retired, approximately half the Hall resigned. These events were caused by one rebellion buried in the Tower's secret records.

enrichments.short_description: Catala held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Kiyosa Natomo's successor and Elise Strang's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
Cathal was tall for a woman at about 5'9" to 5'10", and she was lanky and bony in build. She was awkward, physically, often dropping things. She had dark brown hair that she wore drawn back with combs, and hazel eyes.

She blinked a great deal, as if she could not understand. In fact, she was a keen observer with an analytical mind—at least, when she had a reason to be interested in what was going on—and not nearly so retiring and half-asleep as she seemed.

She could recall every word she heard, word for word, even after a considerable time, a gift useful mainly when she could not take notes right away.

Cathal is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Cathal was tall for a woman at about 5'9" to 5'10", and she was lanky and bony in build. She was awkward, physically, often dropping things. She had dark brown hair that she wore drawn back with combs, and hazel eyes.

enrichments.description:
Catlynde Artein was an Aes Sedai who lived after the Breaking of the World and before the founding of the White Tower., Artein Catlynde}}

Circa , Catlynde was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power.

It is not clear if Catlynde and her group of Aes Sedai refused to participate in the building of Tar Valon or instead voluntarily joined one of the other seven groups that became the traditional seven Ajah of the White Tower.

In the first case most probably Catlynde's group was forced to bow by Elisane Tishar, the first Amyrlin Seat, as in other similar cases.
enrichments.short_description: Catlynde Artein was an Aes Sedai who lived after the Breaking of the World and before the founding of the White Tower., Artein Catlynde}}

enrichments.description:
Tylin comments that "Aes Sedai never tell a word more than they absolutely must", marking Elayne Trakand and Nynaeve al'Meara as exceptions to that rule. Surprisingly, she also says that she could also talk with Cavandra in the same way, indicating a more relaxed relationship between ruler and advisor.

Cavandra has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

She was Tylin Quintara Mitsobar's advisor before leaving her to go back to the White Tower after the new Amyrlin Elaida summoned her. Cavandra had been advisor also to Tylin's father when he was king of Altara.

The Companion says she "had limited influence, since she had been advisor to a minor throne for so long". It's unclear if this means that her influence was less because the throne was minor, or it was greater because of her longevity in the position.

enrichments.description:
Celestin is about 5'6" tall. She has black and straight hair worn above the shoulder at a length that suggested she can’t decide whether to wear it long or short. Her eyes are gray, though they seem almost pale blue at times. Her nose is perhaps a little too prominent; it makes her look like she's looking down on people, which she probably is, consistent with her somewhat supercilious manner.

Celestin is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She went to the White Tower in 976 NE at the age of sixteen.
enrichments.short_description: Celestin is about 5'6" tall. She has black and straight hair worn above the shoulder at a length that suggested she can’t decide whether to wear it long or short. Her eyes are gray, though they seem almost pale blue at…

enrichments.description:
Cemaile held the staff and stole for twenty-four years until her death in . She was Varuna Morrigan's successor and Marasale Jureen's predecessor.

Cemaile was a ruler of moderate strength and influence at the beginning of her reign, but by the end she was reduced to the role of a very weak Amyrlin, one of the weakest. She had great plans to restore the White Tower influence and greatness, but those went badly awry.

It is recorded only in the secret documents that from till her death she was not more than a puppet in the hands of the Hall, and her Keeper was in fact her guardian appointed there by the Sitters. This role of her Keeper was achieved by the Hall taking advantage of a special secret Tower Law about incapacitated Amyrlins and interpreting it quite extensively.

During her reign, the Tairens ceased collecting items of power: the twisted redstone doorway from Mayene (secretly studied by Aes Sedai) was one of the last items added to the Great Holding.
enrichments.short_description: Cemaile held the staff and stole for twenty-four years until her death in . She was Varuna Morrigan's successor and Marasale Jureen's predecessor.

enrichments.description:
Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given that her surname ends with the common Cairhienin ending -dred.

Cerilla held the position for twenty-two years until her death in . She was Ishara Nawan's successor and Igaine Luin's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Cerilla was a moderately strong Amyrlin. She negotiated the White Tower's way out of the situations in which her predecessor had enmeshed it. Her strength and influence came in large part from her ability to do that. In most other ways the Hall ran the White Tower and the Aes Sedai.

Despite Cerilla's interest and passion laying in the outside world, the Tower influence over the continent began to decline once more during her reign.
enrichments.short_description: Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given that her surname ends with the common Cairhienin ending -dred.

enrichments.description:
Cerist was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah in a Mirror World.

Cerist was captured by the Children of the Light, and was later rescued by Elayna Sedai.

Category:Characters original to the video game
enrichments.short_description: Cerist was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah in a Mirror World.

enrichments.description:
Cetalia Delarme (pronounced: seh-TAHL-ee-ah deh-LAHR-may) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah; she was also the head of her Ajah's eyes-and-ears network at the time of the Aiel War.

Cetalia is described as a tall, square-faced woman in sky-blue silk with steel-gray hair in a multitude of blue-beaded braids that hung to her waist., Cetalia Delarmes|comp}} Judging by her appearance, she must have been over two hundred years old when she died.

She was very strong in the One Power, by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . It was judged that she was stronger than Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche, at least until they both reached their full potential and demanded "more than mere deference" for her superior strength.

Being the head of the eyes-and-ears system of the Blue Ajah, Cetalia tested Siuan just after she gained the shawl; she used many puzzles in an attempt to find out if Siuan would be useful as an apprentice. Siuan passed the tests and spent her first months, and perhaps years, as an Aes Sedai being worked hard under Cetalia.
enrichments.short_description: Cetalia Delarme (pronounced: seh-TAHL-ee-ah deh-LAHR-may) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah; she was also the head of her Ajah's eyes-and-ears network at the time of the Aiel War.

enrichments.description:
During the White Tower Schism, she remains a loyalist to the Tower.

Chai is one of thirty-nine sisters sent to escort the Dragon Reborn to Tar Valon. As such, she was present at the Battle of Dumai's Wells, but managed to escape.

She is one of twelve sisters kept in Dorlan in order to prevent word of the Tower's defeat from reaching the city.

She was first mentioned in Verin Mathwin's book, naming her a Darkfriend.
enrichments.short_description: During the White Tower Schism, she remains a loyalist to the Tower.

enrichments.description:
Chesmal Emry was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

She was from Ghealdan. Chesmal was stern but handsome with dark hair and eyes. She was tall for a woman and seemed even taller. She was 5'7 tall.

She was often described as cold and arrogant.

Chesmal is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Chesmal Emry was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

enrichments.description:
Chisaine Nurbaya is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

She was on the White Tower secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor led by Galina Casban.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Chisaine Nurbaya, Janine Pavlara, Innina Darenhold and Vayelle Kamsa are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand. They did so under Verin's Compulsion.
enrichments.short_description: Chisaine Nurbaya is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Coiren Saeldain is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is plump and stately. She has a billowing voice.

She is notoriously pompous, bombastic and self-important. She has a mannerism that makes it sound as if she is making speeches or pronouncements every time she speaks. She is, nevertheless, no fool.

Coiren is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Coiren Saeldain is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Coladara was born in Tear sometime between 925 and .

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the final days of the Aiel War in .

At some point prior to , she was made advisor to King Paitar Nachiman of Arafel. They appear to have a close relationship. She is very fond of him.

When the White Tower split, she sided with neither Elaida nor the Rebels.
enrichments.short_description: Coladara was born in Tear sometime between 925 and .

enrichments.description:
Corele Hovian is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is a pretty Murandian, 5' 5 1/2" tall, with blue eyes, thick eyebrow and a mass of raven black hair that give her always a wild appearance no matter how neatly she dressed. The tip of her nose turned up.

She is boyishly slim with a perpetual smile. She always seems amused and often has a joking way of speaking. Corele has a lilting voice.

Corele is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Corele Hovian is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She studied Tel'aran'rhiod in detail for at least fifty years, as well as many ter'angreal related to Tel'aran'rhiod and Dreaming, in particular the sleepweaver that Egwene uses to enter Tel'aran'rhiod before her training with the Wise One dreamwalkers and later on by Nynaeve al'Meara, Elayne Trakand, Siuan Sanche, Leane Sharif, and eventually the rest of the Aes Sedai in Salidar. Verin Mathwin found the ring and a collection of her notes only by chance; all records of the ter’angreal had been removed from the official records. Verin thinks that Corianin was a very secretive woman. She kept most of her knowledge to herself, leaving most of what she had learned only in her notes.

This brings into question how much information Corianin withheld from the White Tower in her research. Given that Verin withheld the notes at the same time she was assisting Egwene in her search for members of the Black Ajah, Verin could have been caught between her Black Ajah oaths and the Amyrlin's command to help Egwene (violating which would have also meant violating the oaths). In that case, it is entirely possible Corianin was herself Black Ajah and that her notes proved it, or that somehow the notes, or how she came to possess them, would show Verin to be a Black sister.

enrichments.description:
Covarla's has a One Power strength level of , just enough to be able to Travel. Covarla learned the weave from Katerine.

She has been Aes Sedai as long as Elaida a'Roihan had been alive. She is strong enough to Travel . She was born in and went to the Tower in . She spent nine years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised in 950 NE.

She returned to the White Tower from the debacle of Dumai's Wells in the early hours of the morning to give Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan the bad news that Rand al'Thor had escaped.

She stands highest among the twelve sisters that initially returned back to Tar Valon. Elaida has her and her group stay away from the White Tower to hide her secrets and stay in the village of Dorlan.
enrichments.short_description: Covarla's has a One Power strength level of , just enough to be able to Travel. Covarla learned the weave from Katerine.

enrichments.description:
Dagdara Finchey was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was as wide as any man and taller than most. She had graying hair and a round face.

Dagdara is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

It was said that Dagdara knew more of Healing than any two other Yellow sisters, until the arrival of Nynaeve al'Meara and her new Healing weaves. She was among the best healers in the traditional Aes Sedai method, in the same range as Samitsu Tamagowa, Suana Dragand, and Chesmal Emry.
enrichments.short_description: Dagdara Finchey was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She had pale skin with long black hair and was plump and curvaceous. She wore the kesiera typical of many Cairhienin noblewomen. Hers is described as a moonstone dangling by a thin silver chain. She often wore clothes in the Cairhienin fashion. As the younger daughter of a minor Cairhienin house, she was entitled four stripes of color on her bosom. She added slashes of white to the skirts to represent her Ajah.

Daigian was loved and appreciated by the other sisters. Cadsuane Melaidhrin thinks that she had an excellent mind. She was considered a fine logician, and was extremely persistent and would never quit.

She logically assumed that, being the lowest-ranking Aes Sedai ever, she would have to act as servant when none were around and thus acted quiet and meek among all other sisters. Although she accepted her low rank as an Aes Sedai, she insisted on proper respect from non-Aes Sedai - both channelers and non-channelers. Aside from being stronger than those that would have been rejected by the Tower, other channelers still would be considered relatively untrained.

Daigian is described as exceptionally weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of , the "lowest level at which a woman traditionally was accepted for the Tower to become Aes Sedai". We know of no others as weak as her.

enrichments.description:
Dalevien is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Dalevien is stocky with short, dark hair streaked with gray. Her appearance hints that she might be just over 150, as with some sisters with streaks of gray in their hair, like Verin Mathwin and Dagdara Finchey.

Dalevien and Felaana Bevaine are maintaining a shield on Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the Tower cells. Dalevien is comparing the text between two books, barely registering Egwene's arrival.

enrichments.description:
She had big blue eyes and was dreamy, with few friends even in her own Ajah. She was 5'5 and slight of build. Mesaana also bore a passing resemblance to her, enough that only a little Illusion was needed for Mesaana to impersonate her.

Danelle was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Mesaana would have used an unknown weave to appear to be the same strength as Danelle to avoid suspicion, Messaana's true strength being almost as strong as it's possible for a woman to be.

Born in , she went to the White Tower in . Spending nine years as a novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised in . She would have progressed faster had she not always been going off into a dream. She spent much time in introspection and could drift off while talking to someone.

Danelle spent a lot of time out of the Tower - in fact, as soon as she gained the shawl she left - and had no close friends as she was always lost in thought or books. She was seldom in the Tower for more than a few months at a time, and at widely-spaced intervals. This meant she was quite unknown, and Mesaana took advantage of that to impersonate her. She also never had a Warder, which helped.

enrichments.description:
Deane Aryman ( - 1084) is credited as one of the greatest Amyrlin Seats in Aes Sedai history. Apart from her numerous achievements, she is also the longest ruling known Amyrlin Seat, having ruled for ninety-two years, from to 1084. At the time of her raising, she had also been the youngest woman in history to be Amyrlin.

She was born in or around FY 920 in the village of Salidar in what was then the kingdom of Shiota. She made her way to Tar Valon in FY 934 and became Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah after spending five years as a novice and four as Accepted.

In FY 992 Aryman discovered damning evidence proving that the incumbent Amyrlin Seat, Bonwhin Meraighdin, had manipulated nations into attacking Artur Hawkwing after he allegedly embarrassed her by saving Tar Valon from destruction by the followers of the false Dragon Guaire Amalasan during the War of the Second Dragon. Those actions, and her subsequent manipulations of Hawkwing as he ruled as High King, were to blame for Hawkwing's siege of the city beginning in , endangering the existence of the sisterhood. Aryman accused Bonwhin of negligence, incompetence, and being unfit to hold the staff and shawl. Bonwhin was deposed and stilled, sentenced to muck out the Tower's stables until she died a few years later. Deane Aryman was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in Bonwhin's place. At the time of her selection she was the youngest woman who had ever been raised Amyrlin.

Aryman's attempts to make peace with Hawkwing, even offering him a Healing that could have saved his life as he lay dying, were rebuffed. After his death in , Aryman negotiated with General Souran Maravaile, commander of the besieging forces, and also with his lover Ishara Casalain, the daughter of the Imperial Governor of the province of Andor. The outcome of these discussions was Maravaile lifting the siege and attaching the remnants of his army to Ishara's, who was crowned Queen of Andor. Andor and Tar Valon immediately signed a treaty of friendship that was to last for more than a thousand years. These were immense diplomatic successes, cementing Aryman's position as Amyrlin.

enrichments.description:
Delana Mosalaine was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and one of the Sitters of the Salidar Hall. She was also Black Ajah. Aran'gar, in the guise of Halima Saranov, was posing as her secretary.

Delana was somewhat stout and had an ample bosom. She had pale watery blue eyes and very light - almost white - hair. She was oddly graceful for one so stout. She had a deep voice for a woman, though not masculine. She was 5'6" tall.

She had a disconcerting habit of staring at someone so intently that it seemed nothing else existed. People were said to begin thinking of all the things they had done wrong because of her stare, and to sign treaties just so she would stop staring.

Delana is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

enrichments.description:
Demira Eriff is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Demira Eriff}}

Demira is a gracefully beautiful Domani with coppery skin. She wears clothing in the fashion of her native Arad Doman, although she often contemplates switching to less provocative dresses. as she does not like the unwanted attention. However, she never got around to changing her dresses as she was preoccupied with other matters.

Demira is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

She is the third weakest among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Berenicia Morsad and Valinde Nathenos being weaker and Kairen Stang being her equal. She is, however, only slightly weaker than Merana Ambrey and several others.

enrichments.description:
Desala Nevanche is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

Desala is a beautiful Cairhienin with large dark eyes and a voice like chimes.

She has quite a temper. The surest way to rouse it is to have harmed a child.

She despises wilders and purely hates women who pretend to be Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Desala Nevanche is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is willowy, with brown hair and large brown eyes. She wears her Great Serpent ring on her right hand.

Desandre is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the Black Tower, with only Lemai being as strong.

Assuming she enrolled between the age of 14 and 18, the earliest she could have been born was 947 NE and latest was 958 NE.

She spent six years as novice and seven as Accepted.

enrichments.description:
Doesine was elegant, and tall for a Cairhienin. She was pale, slender, and somewhat boyish. Her large, dark eyes seemed even darker because of her paleness. Though pretty, she looked like a mischievous boy. Her eyes often seemed naughty.

She has a One Power strength level of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. Among the Black Ajah Hunters, however, only Seaine Herimon was weaker.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she has the Talent of Healing.

Doesine was 133 year old when she died. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . She was born with the spark, and was found by an Aes Sedai very shortly after she had first touched the Source. Doesine didn't believe what she had done, and didn't want to go to the Tower; she went unwillingly, bound hand and foot, and gagged. She would often tell this story to novices, to show them their circumstances weren't as bad as hers.

Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien.

Doniella held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Serenia Latar's successor and Aliane Senican's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Doniella was a quiet Amyrlin, not particularly strong, but not in the control of the Hall, either; her benign neglect did leave the Hall pretty much in control of the Tower.

Doniella quite voluntarily resigned as Amyrlin in order to spend more time on her loved studies. She spent the next thirty-one years studying happily, however she was not allowed to return to the Tower and was strongly discouraged from letting anyone know that she had been the Amyrlin Seat.

enrichments.description:
Doraise Mesianos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Although unconfirmed, her melodious surname ending in -os suggests an Illianer origin.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Alviarin Freidhen suggests that Elaida a'Roihan reward her, along with Farellien and Kiyoshi, while simultaneously punishing Josaine and Adelorna Bastine, who held angreal and ter'angreal without the Tower's permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs.
enrichments.short_description: Doraise Mesianos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Duhara Basaheen was an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Red Ajah., Duhara Basaheen}} For a time she also held the position of Keeper of the Chronicles. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah. She became a Dreadlord before the Last Battle.

Duhara was tall, slim and beautiful with big dark eyes, full lips, long slender neck and the typical Domani coppery skin, but there was a meanness about her. She had worn, on both occasions we have met her, red skirts so dark they almost seemed black, although slashed with bright red.

She moved gracefully, but stood almost rigidly straight. She looked at everyone as if she were wondering what wrongdoing they had been up to. Basically she was meaner than a snake, though only her mouth gave any outward hint.

Even the mention of male channelers made her angry. In TWoTC it is stated that during the execution portion of male channelers pogrom, Duhara participated eagerly, but her involvement was discovered and she received a stiff penance (because this Vileness happened mostly during the reign of the Amyrlin Sierin Vayu and Duhara was her Keeper of the Chronicles, it has still to be explained how Duhara was able to participate so eagerly, and so far from the White Tower.)

enrichments.description:
Circa , Dumera is recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Dumera's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Dumera was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Dumera and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

Eadyth (pronounced: ee-DITH) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

Her long white hair suggests she is very old for an Aes Sedai, likely well over 200 years old.

Eadyth was the First Selector of the Blue Ajah, as well as a Sitter in the Hall. She was considered one of the most capable Blue in the last one hundred years and was First Selector during this time.

She is one of the Blue Ajah Sitters who present the shawl to Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche when they first become Aes Sedai.

Edesina is handsome and slender, with waist-length black hair.

Edesina is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Given she is Yellow Ajah, she would have an above average ability at Healing.

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the Aiel War when the Dragon was reborn. Accepted Edesina asks Alanna and Pritalle to loan her stockings in preparation for the bounty collection.

enrichments.description:
Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah. She was formerly the Amyrlin Seat.

Once serving as the influential yet unpopular Aes Sedai advisor to Andor and one of the strongest Aes Sedai in the White Tower, Elaida deposed and replaced sitting Amyrlin Siuan Sanche after it was revealed that she was plotting to protect the Dragon Reborn. Elaida's controversial seizure of power led to the White Tower Schism.

Although she finally managed to capture the rebel Amyrlin, Egwene al'Vere, she became unpopular among her own supporters for her hubris and arrogance, her failings against the Dragon Reborn and the Asha'man, and the growing sectarianism of the Ajahs.

During the Battle of Tar Valon, she was captured by the Seanchan, made damane, and given the name Suffa. In her absence, Egwene was raised to Amyrlin by the remaining loyalist sisters, leading to the reunification of the White Tower.
enrichments.short_description: Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah. She was formerly the Amyrlin Seat.

enrichments.description:
Elayna was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as Keeper of the Chronicles, and briefly as Amyrlin Seat around .

Given her extreme natural weakness in the White Tower to the point that she cannot effectively participate in any combat without the use of objects of the One Power, Elayna's natural strength in the One Power likely sits at around , the level of Daigian Moseneillin, the weakest ever known Aes Sedai from the primary world. This is only an estimation, as the Mirror World that Elayna is from may have different standards for an Aes Sedai.

As a child, Elayna was once trapped in a collapsing cave during one of her adventures. She remembered this experience during her test to be raised Accepted at the White Tower, during the first experience with the silver arches. She then experienced being trapped in the basement of a prominent Darkfriend, and being sent to Fal Dara to stand against Shadowspawn as a full Aes Sedai. The Mistress of Novices of the time, of the Blue Ajah, deemed that she had passed the test, and raised her to Accepted.

Elayna was eventually raised to the shawl and chose the Brown Ajah, although she was as weak as possible for an Aes Sedai to be. She was a student of ter'angreal and used them to raise her abilities in the One Power to the extent that it raised her own political standing within the White Tower.
enrichments.short_description: Elayna was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as Keeper of the Chronicles, and briefly as Amyrlin Seat around .
Eldaya held the position for sixteen years until her death in . She was Beryl Marle's successor and Alvera Ramosanya's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
Moiraine relates the legend that Eldrene was "so beautiful that it was said the flowers bloomed to make her smile". Histories relate that she was kind and patient and loved her subjects dearly. In turn she herself was greatly revered and it is known that soldiers of Manetheren invoked her name in battle as a rallying cry.

In the graphic novel, she and Aemon are depicted with blonde hair and blue eyes, but no physical description is given in the books or wider canon and so her portrayal is strictly artistic licence.

There is no history that survives the Trolloc Wars to relate Eldrene's activities as a full Aes Sedai sister. However, because the era was one of great upheaval that required the participation of nearly all Aes Sedai sisters, it is likely that Eldrene contributed in some manner. What is known with certainty is that sometime prior to she returned to Manetheren where she eventually married King Aemon al Caar al Thorin and bonded him as a Warder. She thus became the queen of Manetheren at a time when the entire world was at war against the Shadow and she ruled from her country's wondrous capital city, high and secure in the cloud-capped peaks of the Mountains of Mist. Her nation was known to have always been at the forefront of the fighting and it was said that people of other nations referred to Manetheren as "a thorn to the Dark One's foot and a bramble to his hand".

In time the wars would consume some within the alliance of nations, including Manetheren's close ally Aridhol. The fall of Aridhol would allow Shadowspawn forces to push unopposed into the centralized countries of Coremanda and Safer. This also allowed dreadlord generals to work towards their milestone goal of exterminating Manetheren. Sometime around Aemon was lured into overextending his military which allowed the shadow to strike directly towards the Manetheren capital. When the shadow's plans became known to Aemon, he recalled his forces from the Field of Bekkar - site of Manetheren's most recent victory - and back to the Manetheren heartland where they engaged their enemy in a titanic multiple-day struggle that came to be known as the Battle of the Tarendrelle River. Knowing that he could not win the battle unaided, Aemon sent messengers carrying a plea for aid to all the remaining allied powers of the Ten Nations thumb|260px|left|Eldrene feels the death of Aemon and a special messenger was sent to Eldrene's former rival Tetsuan who had since been elevated to the Amyrlin Seat.

enrichments.description:
Eldrith was plump, with a round face. Asne Zeramene claimed that drab attire suited her.

Eldrith was strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . Even with such strength, she was only third strongest among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, with Liandrin Guirale and Marillin Gemalphin being stronger.

Eldrith was 116 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After twelve years as a Novice and seven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 920 NE.

She was a little vague; considering her relative strength she could have risen faster as a student, but she was much too dreamy and absent-minded even then.
enrichments.short_description: Eldrith was plump, with a round face. Asne Zeramene claimed that drab attire suited her.

enrichments.description:
Eleyan al'Landerin was an ancient Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Eleyan al'Landerin}}

There is a statue of her and her Warders in the southwestern side of Tar Valon, in the same place she sacrificed herself with her Warders to stop and repel Artur Hawkwing's army at the beginning of the nineteen-year-long siege to the city.

Her name indicates that she was from the Two Rivers region of Farashelle.

The name of this character comes from the name of a Tarvalon.net member.
enrichments.short_description: Eleyan al'Landerin was an ancient Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Eleyan al'Landerin}}

enrichments.description:
Elisane Tishar was the very first Amyrlin Seat and is generally held responsible for the founding of the Aes Sedai in their modern (post-Breaking) form. Her achievements are numerous, and she is partially responsible for the choice of location for the Aes Sedai city and the decision to build the White Tower.

Elisane Tishar is first mentioned in history in , identified as the leader of twelve women representing an ajah (note the lowercase), a temporary grouping of female channelers named the Aes Sedai holding a common position in a debate.

The decision to unify their groups into a new organization was taken at this meeting, with Elisane playing a major role. Over the next fifty years this organization ruthlessly tracked down any rival groups "claiming" to be Aes Sedai, forcing them to capitulate and join their organization or stilling them.

By Elisane Tishar is mentioned as holding the rank of Amyrlin Seat (as she had for several years by this point), advised by a council of seven women who may have been the founders of the seven Ajahs known today (although a separate Hall of the Tower is noted as also existing at this time). The construction of Tar Valon and the White Tower also began in this year.

Elise's name could indicate Andoran origin (see Kairen Stang, Elisa al'Seen, Elisa al'Vere, and Elise Marwin).

Elise held the position for twenty-one years until her death in . She was Catala Lucanvalle's successor and Comarra Zepava's predecessor.

She was such a weak Amyrlin that she had to beg to have what she wanted from the Hall.

enrichments.description:
She participated in the Last Battle and survived.

She is one of four Aes Sedai, the others being Saerin, Rubinde and Yukiri, trying to convince Rodel Ituralde to take the throne of Arad Doman after the Last Battle.

All the Aes Sedai that persuaded Rodel Ituralde to become King and Cadsuane Melaidhrin to become Amyrlin were Sitters, except Elswell. However, the situation might suggest that Elswell is also a Sitter and, if so, she would be the unknown Sitter of the Blue Ajah.

During a Q&A with Brandon Sanderson, he said, with no absolute certainty, that this theory is possibly correct. Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

enrichments.description:
She had a pleasant-face with brown hair and eyes. She is 5'5 tall.

She is normally cool, but could become rabid about Rand.

Elza is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

In fact, she was so conscious of her strength that other Aes Sedai felt she thought too much about her place in the hierarchy, when dealing with other sisters.
