enrichments.description:
Erian is pale and lovely. She has dark hair and brown eyes, and is beautiful. She is short and slender, and her pale face is like an exquisite oval.

Erian is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

Erian is from Illian and is 49 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending seven years as a novice and five years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 978 NE. She had four Warders, but two of them were killed by Rand al'Thor. The other two are named Rashan and Bartol. Galina Casban, the Highest of the Red Ajah, became infatuated with Erian., Galina Casban}}

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split. She is part of the White Tower embassy that makes an alliance with the Shaido.
enrichments.short_description: Erian is pale and lovely. She has dark hair and brown eyes, and is beautiful. She is short and slender, and her pale face is like an exquisite oval.

enrichments.description:
Escaralde Hamdey is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and has been elected as a Sitter in the Salidar Hall, despite being too young.

Escaralde is very short but seems to loom by sheer force of will. She is 4'10, which is inches shorter than Nisao Dachen.

She is stubborn and would refuse to believe that she could not do or learn anything, until she proved it to her own satisfaction. She insisted on trying to learn to make ter'angreal despite lacking the sufficient strength.

Escaralde is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.
enrichments.short_description: Escaralde Hamdey is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and has been elected as a Sitter in the Salidar Hall, despite being too young.

enrichments.description:
Ester is under five feet tall, with large brown eyes, a short cap of dark brown curls and a small, upturned nose. She is cute, almost doll-like, which she does not like having pointed out, any more than she enjoys anyone referring to her height.

With a strength level is , she is strong for an Aes Sedai. She is strong enough to Travel.

Among the ten ferrets, Ester is the second in hierarchy by strength and years of training.

Ester is 45 years old. She was born in 955 NE and went to the White Tower in 972 NE. After spending seven years as a novice and eight years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: Ester is under five feet tall, with large brown eyes, a short cap of dark brown curls and a small, upturned nose. She is cute, almost doll-like, which she does not like having pointed out, any more than she enjoys…

enrichments.description:
Evanellein Lorn was an Aes Sedai and a sitter of the Gray Ajah, who was also secretly of the Black Ajah.

She wore a low neckline at Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's meeting. Elaida thought that she was too concerned with clothes and her own looks to seem a Green instead than a Gray. She was quite pretty, though not among the most beautiful of the Aes Sedai. She was tall, with a medium build, and dark brown hair which she wore in ever-changing styles and thought was one of her best features.

She worried about the size of her bottom, though her worries were all in her head. She was very concerned about whether men and women saw her as beautiful - but she was more concerned about women's opinions. She often wore the latest fashions, though only when she found them flattering. She preferred low-cut dresses, as she liked the shape of her bosom.

Evanellein is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
enrichments.short_description: Evanellein Lorn was an Aes Sedai and a sitter of the Gray Ajah, who was also secretly of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Faeldrin Harella was an Aes Sedai from the Green Ajah.

She has cool eyes and thin braids in her dark hair adorned with colored beads. She is 5'4" or 163 cm in height.,Faeldrin Haralla|comp}}

Faeldrin is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of .

Merana Ambrey feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, even though she is its appointed leader. Faeldrin, Masuri Sokawa and Rafela Cindal are the three strongest sisters in the group. She is strong enough to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Faeldrin Harella was an Aes Sedai from the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Faiselle Darone is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders.

Faiselle is stocky, copper-skinned and square faced. She owns silks with dense green embroidery.

Faiselle is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Faiselle is Domani and is 171 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending ten years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
enrichments.short_description: Faiselle Darone is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders.

enrichments.description:
Falion Bhoda was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, who was also Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters and became a Dreadlord of the Shadow before the Last Battle.

Falion was a cold, long-faced Kandori with dark, glossy hair. She stands 5'5 tall.

She was willing to use the Power to torture anyone, even to death, but was dispassionate about it. She only cared whether they gave her the answers she wanted.

Falion was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . While she is strong enough to be able to Travel, it's not certain she would have had the opporunity to learn from any Black Sister we know can Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Falion Bhoda was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, who was also Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters and became a Dreadlord of the Shadow before the Last Battle.

enrichments.description:
Faolain Orande is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, sworn to Egwene al'Vere.

Faolain is dark of complexion and has a round face and dark curly hair.

Faolain is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power potential of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She has had a suffient length of training to assume she has already reached her full potential.
enrichments.short_description: Faolain Orande is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, sworn to Egwene al'Vere.

enrichments.description:
Alviarin Freidhen, acting in the interest of her true Ajah, the Black, ordered Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to reward Farellin of the Yellow, Kiyoshi of the Gray and Doraise Mesianos of the Brown and uphold them as models of preserving the law. Farellien is given a new horse. Alviarin's goal was to create paranoia in the White Tower as none of the sisters involved had done anything to deserve such praise, and it implicated them as the informants on Adelorna Bastine and Josaine, who were severely punished for keeping angreal and ter'angreal in their rooms.

Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Alviarin Freidhen, acting in the interest of her true Ajah, the Black, ordered Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to reward Farellin of the Yellow, Kiyoshi of the Gray and Doraise Mesianos of the Brown and uphold them as models…

enrichments.description:
Farnah Sadaou is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. She replaced Talene Minly., Farnah Sadaou}}

In communications between Encyclopedia Wheel of Time and Brandon Sanderson, Farnah's last name is revealed to be Sadaou. Her last name is not given in The Wheel of Time Companion.

Because she is chosen as a Sitter after reunification, it can be assumed that Farnah has been Aes Sedai for more than one hundred years and is, at least around 130 years old.

Nothing is known about Farnah's strength or ability in the One Power.
enrichments.short_description: Farnah Sadaou is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. She replaced Talene Minly., Farnah Sadaou}}

enrichments.description:
Felaana is slim with yellow hair and a raspy voice. Egwene thinks that her hair gleams as if she brushes it several times a day.

Felaana is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

While Moiraine Damodred is out searching for the Dragon Reborn she meets up with several Aes Sedai in Kandor, Felaana being one among them. Felaana thinks she is a Wilder rather than an Aes Sedai who has not reached the ageless look yet and tries to convice Moiraine to come to the White Tower.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.
enrichments.short_description: Felaana is slim with yellow hair and a raspy voice. Egwene thinks that her hair gleams as if she brushes it several times a day.

enrichments.description:
Fera is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of .

She was born in , and went to the White Tower in . She spent 13 years as a novice and 9 as Accepted.

She was on the White Tower secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner by the Asha'man at Dumai's Wells and has sworn fealty to Rand al'Thor. However, unlike the other Aes Sedai, her oath was a lie.
enrichments.short_description: Fera is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of .

enrichments.description:
Feragaine held the position for twenty-two years until her death in . She was Marasale Jureen's successor and Myriam Copan's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Feragaine was in large part a puppet of the Hall, as her predecessor Marasale, she was chosen because the Sitters thought she was easily controlled by them, in fact in large part it happened.

She made some effort to restore her power and authority but was almost always outmanoeuvred. Her interests as in many from the Blue Ajah lay outside the White Tower and its politics and she floundered badly in the treacherous currents of the Hall.

During her reign the legendary Sereille Bagand was selected as Sitter by the White Ajah, showing her remarkable qualities in a so influential Hall.
enrichments.short_description: Feragaine held the position for twenty-two years until her death in . She was Marasale Jureen's successor and Myriam Copan's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
Ferane is 5'2" or 158cm in height. She is plump and stout with a mild, round face and the coppery skin of a Domani She has steely black eyes . Her hair is long and black, at times looking like it is in urgent need of brushing.

Despite being a White, she has a fierce temper. She can appear vague as a Brown, and often as untidy, but she can catch the slightest crack in the logic of an argument.

Ferane never lost the skills taught to all Domani girls and has been known to captivate a man's attention whenever she wished. She also has a measure of vanity, evidenced by the relative luxury of her apartment furnishings.

Ferane has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
enrichments.short_description: Ferane is 5'2" or 158cm in height. She is plump and stout with a mild, round face and the coppery skin of a Domani She has steely black eyes . Her hair is long and black, at times looking like it is in urgent need of…

enrichments.description:
Gabrelle has brown hair, barely touching her shoulders, with large green eyes and an upturned nose. She has a dusky complexion, and is around 5'5" tall., Gabrelle Brawley}}

She attempts to seduce and win over Logain as an atypical Brown with a sense of pragmatism.

Gabrelle is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability at the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She has an ability in Healing. She heals Logain's wounds during the Last Battle.
enrichments.short_description: Gabrelle has brown hair, barely touching her shoulders, with large green eyes and an upturned nose. She has a dusky complexion, and is around 5'5" tall., Gabrelle Brawley}}

enrichments.description:
Galina Casban was an Aes Sedai and former Highest, or leader, of the Red Ajah. She was also of the Black Ajah. Believed dead by the White Tower, she is now the permanent personal gai'shain to Therava of the Shaido Aiel.

Galina has long black hair and a pretty round face with hard eyes.

Galina Casban was a member of the Red Ajah. Her reputation for cruelty made her one of the most feared Aes Sedai. She has very little, if any, guilt over her actions or for the people that she hurts or kills as she is convinced that it is all for the greater good.

Ironically despite her strong belief in her own superiority, Galina was shown to have an almost cowardly side to her as she tended to try and avoid physical combat whenever possible.
enrichments.short_description: Galina Casban was an Aes Sedai and former Highest, or leader, of the Red Ajah. She was also of the Black Ajah. Believed dead by the White Tower, she is now the permanent personal gai'shain to Therava of the Shaido Aiel.

enrichments.description:
She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A Bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of Air.

Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Short pages Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A Bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of…

enrichments.description:
Gerra held the position for thirty-seven years until her death in . She was the successor of Shein Chunla, and Varuna Morrigan's predecessor.

She was later on considered an Amyrlin as successful as Sereille Bagand, one of the greatest Amyrlins, but instead of iron will, Gerra used political prowess to turn the different groups of the Hall of the Tower against each other.

She was elected partly because her mild personality was so much in contrast to her predecessor, that many Sitters thought to be able to control her, and partly because Gerra was among the ringleaders of the coup that toppled Shein Chunla, which should have given the others some clue as to how biddable she would be.

Anyway she used her skills as a negotiator and mediator to play factions against each other, and an attempted coup against her was crushed utterly.
enrichments.short_description: Gerra held the position for thirty-seven years until her death in . She was the successor of Shein Chunla, and Varuna Morrigan's predecessor.

enrichments.description:
Gitara Moroso (pronounced: gih-TAH-rah moh-ROH-soh) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, advisor to Queen Mordrellen Mantear of Andor and the Keeper of the Chronicles under Tamra Ospenya.

She was thought to be beautiful, almost voluptuous, with snow-white hair. She also was flamboyant enough for a Green or a Yellow with a fondness for jewelry.

Moiraine Damodred thought her to be always just and usually fair, but kindness never seemed to occur to her.

Gitara is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .
enrichments.short_description: Gitara Moroso (pronounced: gih-TAH-rah moh-ROH-soh) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, advisor to Queen Mordrellen Mantear of Andor and the Keeper of the Chronicles under Tamra Ospenya.

enrichments.description:
The Gray Ajah of the Aes Sedai are dedicated to politics and mediation. They favor harmony and consensus above all else, and are often conflict mediators or ambassadors. The leader of the Gray Ajah is called the Head Clerk.

The Gray is the third-largest Ajah, behind the Green and before the Brown, with roughly one hundred and forty Sisters just prior to the Last Battle, as it is stated in TWoTC.

In The Gathering Storm it is discovered that there are thirty-one members of the Black Ajah among the Gray sisters, but only the names of six of them are known. In Towers of Midnight the name of the former Gray Sitter Evanellein is added to the list of Blacks infiltrated in this Ajah.

The breakdown of nationality for named Gray Ajah sisters in recent history is as follows:
enrichments.short_description: The Gray Ajah of the Aes Sedai are dedicated to politics and mediation. They favor harmony and consensus above all else, and are often conflict mediators or ambassadors. The leader of the Gray Ajah is called the Head…

enrichments.description:
The Green Ajah of the Aes Sedai holds itself ready for Tarmon Gai'don, for the final battle between good and evil when the Dark One inevitably breaks free from his prison. They were called the "Battle Ajah" during the Trolloc Wars and are excellent generals who can plan effective battle strategies. They bond as many Warders as they wish and have been on friendly terms with the Blue Ajah for a millennium. The head of the Green Ajah is known as the Captain-General.

The Green has been always the second-largest Ajah, after the Red, since the founding of the White Tower, but if initially the Red has been the largest by far, during the centuries, and especially after the Trolloc Wars, the gap between this two Ajah has started to dwindle progressively.

So in the last decades the Green Ajah is following closely behind the Red who has around two hundred members; in fact by the time of the Dragon birth, the Greens have roughly 190-180 members.}}

The Green also has a high concentration of Black sisters with at least thirty-eight, however we have only learned the identity of six.
enrichments.short_description: The Green Ajah of the Aes Sedai holds itself ready for Tarmon Gai'don, for the final battle between good and evil when the Dark One inevitably breaks free from his prison. They were called the "Battle Ajah" during the…

enrichments.description:
She is a tall woman with silver-gold hair.

Guisin is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

She is allied with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

The Salidar Six, led by Sheriam, send Guisin, Afara and Edesina Azzedin to Tarabon as emissaries of the Rebel Aes Sedai. All three were captured by the Seanchan and made damane.
enrichments.short_description: She is a tall woman with silver-gold hair.

enrichments.description:
Gyldan was the name of a Red sister who was also Black Ajah.

Gyldan appears in Egwene al'Vere's third step during her testing for Accepted in the Silver arches ter'angreal. Gyldan is Elaida's close confidant and is one of thirteen sisters of the Black Ajah who were going to turn Egwene to the Shadow with thirteen Myrddraal. It is unknown if there is a real Aes Sedai with this name.
enrichments.short_description: Gyldan was the name of a Red sister who was also Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Haesel Lusara is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah from Murandy, Haesel Lusara}}

Haesel is not particularly pretty, average in face and figure, but has a vivacity that makes most people see her as pretty.

About 5'4" tall, she is neither slim nor stout. Her black hair is worn in an elaborate braid that hangs halfway down her back, with the braiding running onto the top of her head. She has black eyes.

In "The Wheel of Time Companion" Haesel level of strength is described as , which is a quite high level in the Aes Sedai hierarchy.
enrichments.short_description: Haesel Lusara is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah from Murandy, Haesel Lusara}}

enrichments.description:
Enough information has been given in the series to work out all but one of the members of the Hall of the Tower under Siuan Sanche just before the White Tower Schism.

Category:Aes Sedai Hall of the Tower under Siuan Sanche Category:Ruling bodies
enrichments.short_description: Enough information has been given in the series to work out all but one of the members of the Hall of the Tower under Siuan Sanche just before the White Tower Schism.

enrichments.description:
Hattori Gatano is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Her Warder is Sleete, whom she bonded ten years before the Last Battle.

Sleete mentioned that Hattori doesn't have much influence in the Tower, suggesting that she may be relatively weak in the One Power.

Since Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai, Hattori must have an One Power strength level of or less. She would not be able to Travel without linking.
enrichments.short_description: Hattori Gatano is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Igaine held the position for forty-four years until her death in . She was Cerilla Marodred's successor and Beryl Marle's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Igaine was an Amyrlin of average strength and influence. She was chosen in large part because she would lead the White Tower away from the open involvement in the world's affairs that her four predecessor had espoused.

Around 500 NE, during Igaine's reign, the last traces of the nation of Caralain vanished.

Category:Historical people Category:High Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Character not mentioned in books Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: Igaine held the position for forty-four years until her death in . She was Cerilla Marodred's successor and Beryl Marle's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
Illeisien is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

Illeisien is the leader of five Aes Sedai who accidentally encountered Tenobia Kazadi on her way out of Saldaea. She is described as being intent on secrecy - more so then Tenobia herself.

This group is uncommited to any faction - loyalist or rebel - so they are not Red nor Blue Ajah; they accompany Tenobia south. Category:Unaligned sisters Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Illeisien is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She was part of the White Tower secret group to Cairhien led by Coiren Saeldain and took part in kidnapping Rand al'Thor.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Chisaine Nurbaya, Janine Pavlara, Innina Darenhold and Vayelle Kamsa are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand. They did so under Verin's Compulsion.

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Innina probably fought the Last Battle on the slopes of Thakan'dar. It is not stated whether she survived or not.
enrichments.short_description: She was part of the White Tower secret group to Cairhien led by Coiren Saeldain and took part in kidnapping Rand al'Thor.

enrichments.description:
Her strength in the One Power is unknown, but given the amount of time spent in training (12 years), it can be assumed that she is moderately strong and probably a middle-high ranking sister.

Irgain was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and six years as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 958 NE.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Irgain was one of the Aes Sedai involved in kidnapping Rand. She was shielding him along with Ronaille Vevanios and Sashalle Anderly when the Battle at Dumai's Wells occurred. They were all stilled when Rand broke the shield . Irgain's two Warders were also killed during the battle. She was taken prisoner soon after by the Aiel Wise Ones. They used mild manners with her because for them her stilling was a sufficient punishment.
enrichments.short_description: Her strength in the One Power is unknown, but given the amount of time spent in training (12 years), it can be assumed that she is moderately strong and probably a middle-high ranking sister.

enrichments.description:
Faile mentions Jestian Redhill, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told them to do. It is said that Isebaille delivered the throne of Arad Doman and brothers that she loved to their enemies upon command from the White Tower.

Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Faile mentions Jestian Redhill, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told them to do. It is said that Isebaille delivered the throne of Arad Doman and…
Ishara Nawan was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year ., Ishara Nawan}}

enrichments.description:
Ispan Shefar was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, and secretly of the Black Ajah.

Ispan was a Taraboner with black hair in a multitude of braids with blue and green beads after the Taraboner fashion.

Ispan was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of .

She was 109 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and eight years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 922 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Ispan Shefar was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, and secretly of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is around five feet tall. Moiraine, at 5'2" (157 cm), is "nearly a hand taller".

The ending of her surname suggests a Cairhienin origin.

Due to her already having gray hair at the time of the Aiel War, she likely to have been born before .

At this time, she had two Warders, one was a round-faced man playing a stately melody on a flute, the other a pale-haired young man no more than twenty. It is unknown if those Warders are still alive by .
enrichments.short_description: She is around five feet tall. Moiraine, at 5'2" (157 cm), is "nearly a hand taller".

enrichments.description:
She is very weak in the One Power and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

She disappears from the White Tower after Egwene al'Vere becomes Amyrlin Seat and asks all Aes Sedai to re-swear the Three Oaths on the Oath Rod. This strongly suggests she is Black Ajah, even though her name was not on Verin's list. Egwene also thought she might possibly be Mesaana.

Another possibility is that she was taken by the Seanchan.

Category:Low Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: She is very weak in the One Power and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

enrichments.description:
Janine Pavarla is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

She is 5'3" and plump, with large dark eyes and luxuriant black hair, which she wears pulled into a bun on the back of her neck.

Janine is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was born in and went to the White Tower in 978 NE. After spending eleven years as a novice and nine years as Accepted, she was raised to the Red Ajah in 998 NE. Since she is new to the shawl, she has not yet achieved the ageless look. It was for this reason that she, along with Beldeine Nyram and Marith Riven, was chosen to participate in Rand al'Thor's kidnapping.
enrichments.short_description: Janine Pavarla is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Janya Frende is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

Janya is unusually tidy for a Brown Sister. She is slender, with short, dark hair, and pretty despite a perpetual frown. Despite her age not a hint of gray is showing in her hair. She is described as "bird-like". Romanda thinks that Janya maybe has bad eyes, which would explain her squinting.

She is very inquisitive, wants to know the why and how of everything, and becomes very disappointed because she can not make ter'angreal or Cuendillar. She talks in quick and long cascades. She does not bother to hide her curiosity behind a mask of serenity

Janya is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Janya Frende is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Jarna Malari (pronounced: JAHR-nah MAL-ah-ree) was an Aes Sedai and Sitter for the Gray Ajah and secretly head of the Black Ajah.

She had liquid brown eyes and long black hair which was going white at the temples., Jarna Malari|Jarna Malari}} She was 5'6" or 168 cm in height.

She was well-loved and respected by many Aes Sedai, seen as a model of virtue with a saintly reputation.

Sometime prior to the Aiel War, she was made a Sitter for the Gray Ajah. She was also appointed head of the Supreme Council of the Black Ajah at an unknown point.
enrichments.short_description: Jarna Malari (pronounced: JAHR-nah MAL-ah-ree) was an Aes Sedai and Sitter for the Gray Ajah and secretly head of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Javindhra Doraille is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and for a while she was a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

Javindhra is tall, has smooth cheeks but a very angular face. She speaks with a very harsh manner. She is bony.

Javindhra is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Javindhra is 158 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as novice and five as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year . She was elected Sitter in the year 985 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Javindhra Doraille is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and for a while she was a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

enrichments.description:
Jeaine had the appearance of a typical Domani, with coppery skin and a swan neck. She had dark brown eyes.

She detested men, and chose Green partly so she could beguile and control them. Yet, she was not attracted to women.

Jeane is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel. We can assume that all Black Ajah that took part in the Last Battle were taught the weave.

Jeaine was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and six years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: Jeaine had the appearance of a typical Domani, with coppery skin and a swan neck. She had dark brown eyes.

enrichments.description:
Jenare Balmaen is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Jenare Balmaen}}

She is pale and sturdy. She has a pale, square face.

Jenare is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was a part of the group of fifty-one sisters, led by Toveine Gazal, sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to take out the Black Tower. Jenare was part of the group of ten sisters led by Toviene herself when they were both shielded and captured and bonded by the Asha'man. Jenare was bonded by Welyn Kajima, a fact for which she blamed Toveine.
enrichments.short_description: Jenare Balmaen is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Jenare Balmaen}}

enrichments.description:
Jennet Cobb is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Jennet Cobb}}

She is 5' 4 1/2" or 164 cm tall, with dark red hair flowing down her back, and green eyes. She is not beautiful, but most men would think her pretty except that her manner is reserved. Not cool, but private and very self-contained.

Despite this outward appearance, she has a considerable temper. She learned to control it during her time as a novice, although it was not easy for her. It could flare, however, especially over what she perceived as injustice.

Jennet is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Jennet Cobb is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Jennet Cobb}}

enrichments.description:
Jesse is 5' 11" tall and wiry, resembling a sparrow, but she is much stronger physically than she looks. Her hair is grey with a little black, her eyes are small and dark., Jesse Bilal}}

She has a habit of tilting her head to one side when she is studying something in front of her, and a habit of tapping two or three fingers on her lips while thinking. She is very intent on whatever she focused on; some people think she focused so intently as not to notice other things around her, but they are mistaken.

She is a very forceful woman, especially for a Brown.

Jesse has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
enrichments.short_description: Jesse is 5' 11" tall and wiry, resembling a sparrow, but she is much stronger physically than she looks. Her hair is grey with a little black, her eyes are small and dark., Jesse Bilal}}

enrichments.description:
Faile mentions Jestian, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of an Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told her to do.

Category:Short pages Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Faile mentions Jestian, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of an Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told her to do.

enrichments.description:
Jezrail is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

Jezrail does not show too much deference to Katerine Alruddin, so she can't be too weak. Because Katerine's level of strength is , it can be guessed that Jezrail level could be between and in the top ten levels of the recent Aes Sedai hierarchy and enough to open alone suitable gateways for Traveling.

Jezrail almost married a young man before she came to the White Tower. She still keeps a miniature of him and speaks fondly of him, even though his grandchildren would be grandparents now. That would probably make her over one hundred years old, likely even older.

She prevents Katerine from using the One Power to punish Egwene al'Vere when she makes a display in a novice class by splitting her weaves fourteen ways, a deed that impressed Jezrail. She grabs Katerine's wrist and admonishes her for going too far, as Egwene was in danger of being injured. Jezrail also seems to dislike anything related with forkroot.
enrichments.short_description: Jezrail is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Joiya Byir was a Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and a member of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

Joiya appeared to be a handsome woman, with a friendly, motherly face, dark gray eyes and dark hair.

Joiya is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . She was the weakest among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters.

Joiya was 171 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: Joiya Byir was a Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and a member of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

enrichments.description:
Joline Maza is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders, Blaeric Negina and Fen Mizar.

Joline is slender and pretty, with large brown eyes. She is taller than Merilille.

Joline is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She is relatively skilled in the Aes Sedai method of Healing, at least better at it than Teslyn.
enrichments.short_description: Joline Maza is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders, Blaeric Negina and Fen Mizar.

enrichments.description:
Josaine was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

She had remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Several years ago, Josaine found an angreal and kept it to herself. Alviarin Freidhen ordered Elaida a'Roihan to personally search Josaine's room, as well as Adelorna Bastine's, as Adelorna had removed an angreal from the storeroom without permission.

When Elaida found the angreal, she was to give stiff punishments to both sisters. At the same time, Alviarin ordered Elaida to reward Doraise Mesianos, Kiyoshi and Farellien (a Brown, a Gray and a Yellow), which will make it seem as if the latter three had exposed the former two. Elaida wanted to know why Alviarin was ordering this, as it would create dissension between the Ajahs.
enrichments.short_description: Josaine was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Juilaine Madome is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

She is attractive with short-cut black hair and dark eyes. She is 5'7" (170 cm) tall.

Juilaine has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Juilaine was born in . She was born with the spark and was a tomboy when she was found, climbing trees, running in the streets and wearing boy's clothes much more often than dresses.
enrichments.short_description: Juilaine Madome is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Kairen Stang was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Kairen Stang}}

She was described as being beautiful, with an oval face and icy blue eyes. She is 5'4 tall.

Kairen was of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

She is the third weakest among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Berenicia Morsad and Valinde Nathenos being weaker and Demira Eriff being her equal. She is, however, only slightly weaker than Merana Ambrey and several others.
enrichments.short_description: Kairen Stang was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Kairen Stang}}

enrichments.description:
Karale Sanghir is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and member of a Heart along with Atuan Larisett and Marris Thornhill.

She is forced to swear on the Oath Rod obediance to Yukiri and the rest of the Black Ajah hunting Sisters. She is adamant that she now walks in the Light again.

After her interrogation, the hunt for the Black Ajah came to a problematic stalemate, since Karale's contact outside of her Heart was with the Rebel Aes Sedai.

Her Warder takes poison and kills himself when he is betrayed by Karale.
enrichments.short_description: Karale Sanghir is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and member of a Heart along with Atuan Larisett and Marris Thornhill.

enrichments.description:
Circa , Karella was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Karella's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Karella was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Karella and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

Her name is spelled Karelia Fanway in The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time.

Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai after the Breaking Category:Short pages Category:Character not mentioned in books Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Ajah Heads
enrichments.short_description: Circa , Karella was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing…

enrichments.description:
Kateri Nepvue was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

She was raised to the shawl twenty years ago.

It was unknown whether she sided with Elaida, the Rebels or remained neutral during the White Tower Schism.

She did not heed Egwene's advice to remain alert and refrain from being alone due to recent Aes Sedai murders in the Tower.
enrichments.short_description: Kateri Nepvue was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She had very long, dark hair, hard eyes, and a sharp face. She is vulpine with a mass of raven hair.

Katerine is strong enough to not need to defer to many Aes Sedai (see below). Her unwillingness to defer to others, however, can be extended to those few that are above her in her hierarchy. She has to "stamp out a spark of anger" when Galina Casban, her own Ajah Head, teases her and tries to avoid deferring to Saerin Asnobar, a Sitter. Both are only marginally stronger than her, but this highlights a personality flaw that chafes at being submitting to anyone's authority. Katerine's own point of view highlights that her respect towards Galina is less than what is due. She later questions Silviana Brehon's orders with regards Egwene. Although they are of equal strength, Silviana is her superior in training times and age and has absolute authority over the treatment of novices as Mistress of Novices. Katerine also snaps at Narenwin Barda, indicating a lack of respect for those weaker than her. In summary, she has a generally bad attitude towards everyone.

Like many sisters, Katerine has a contempt for Wilders.

Katerine is strong in the One Power with a strength level of . Verin considers her "far from weak".
enrichments.short_description: She had very long, dark hair, hard eyes, and a sharp face. She is vulpine with a mass of raven hair.

enrichments.description:
Kera Haellin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Kera has the blue eyes and fair hair that appeared occasionally among Tairens. She has an arrogant demeanor common to Greens.

She is of Tairen noble birth.|Kera Haellin}}

She is almost certainly a relative of High Lord Sunamon Haellin, although we do not know how distant a relative. She may be anything from a sister to a branch of the family that existed 200 years before the start of the books.
enrichments.short_description: Kera Haellin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Kerene Nagashi was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and its Captain-General. She was also one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

She was tall and beautiful with short dark hair lightly touched with white. Her eyes were nearly black.

She was reputed to adhere to the strictest letter of the law no matter her own feelings, whether pity or contempt.

Kerene was exceptionally strong in the One Power, with a level of ., Kerene Nagashi|comp}} She stands above Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche, but lower than Cadsuane Melaidhrin. Cadsuane said that "no one had come to the Tower who could match [herself] in a thousand years. No one to match Kerene or Meilyn in almost six hundred." There was "a sharp drop" between Kerene and Moiraine in terms of strength.
enrichments.short_description: Kerene Nagashi was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and its Captain-General. She was also one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.
Kiam Lopiang was an Aes Sedai who lived at the time of the formation of the White Tower., Kiam Lopiang}}

enrichments.description:
Kirin held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in . She was Aleis Romlin's successor and Noane Masadim's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Kirin was a quite weak Amyrlin, though not so lacking in influence and strength as her predecessor Aleis. In truth many of the things she did helped pave the way for some stronger Amyrlin to come after her.

Verin Mathwin last made a serious mistake during Kirin's reign. This was probably her choice betwen joining the Black Ajah or die.

Vandene and Adeleas retired at some point durign Kirin's reign, most likely in the late 920s.
enrichments.short_description: Kirin held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in . She was Aleis Romlin's successor and Noane Masadim's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
Kiruna Nachiman was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Kiruna was 5'7, statuesque and regal-looking, with dark eyes, a full mouth and a full bosom, and arrogantly beautiful. As a member of the Royal House of Arafel, her queen-like demeanor was hardly surprising.

Kiruna had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. There are very few named Aes Sedai stronger than her. She is certainly strong enough to Travel.

Born in , she was the younger sister of the King of Arafel, Paitar Nachiman. She was supposed to be his favorite sister.
enrichments.short_description: Kiruna Nachiman was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Kiyosa held the position for twenty-six years until her death in . She was Medanor Eramandos's successor and Catala Lucanvalle's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her strength of will and strong personality helped her manage Tower affairs, making her a strong Amyrlin.

Due to her Japanese-inspired name, it is likely that she hailed from the Borderlands.

Category:Historical people Category:High Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Character not mentioned in books Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: Kiyosa held the position for twenty-six years until her death in . She was Medanor Eramandos's successor and Catala Lucanvalle's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
Kiyoshi is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is a stickler for punctuality and neatness.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Alviarin Freidhen suggests that Elaida a'Roihan reward her, along with Farellien and Doraise Mesianos, while simultaneously punishing Josaine and Adelorna Bastine, who held objects of the One Power without the Tower's permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs.
enrichments.short_description: Kiyoshi is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Kryalyn is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

Kryalyn is the second-in-command of Aelidas as part of the White Tower's mission against Mazrim Taim when he declares himself to be a False Dragon.

Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Black Ajah Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Black Ajah Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Kryalyn is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Kumira was a handsome with blue eyes, graceful hands and short dark brown hair. She was 5'5" tall. She preferred strong woolens over silk, but would sometimes wear a silk scarf. She sometimes gets ink stains on her clothes, but she would deal with them as soon as she could.

Like many of the Brown Ajah, Kumira could become easily absorbed in her studies, sometimes to the exclusion of the world around her. She had a reputation of aggressively pursuing those things of which she had taken an interest.

Unlike most Browns, she is also hard-headed, practical, observant and very strong-willed. She is interested in everything and doesn't like wasting time.

She was not afraid to swear, sometimes using the word "peace" as if it were an oath. She takes care not to offend anyone on purpose, even those of a lower status than hers; in fact, she is often more considerate of those with lower status, such as when she debates with Daigian over logic.
enrichments.short_description: Kumira was a handsome with blue eyes, graceful hands and short dark brown hair. She was 5'5" tall. She preferred strong woolens over silk, but would sometimes wear a silk scarf. She sometimes gets ink stains on her…

enrichments.description:
Kwamesa Taramasu was an Aes Sedai and rebel Sitter of the Gray Ajah.

Kwamesa was dark and slender with a sharp nose. She was of average height, 5'3 1/2 tall., Kwamesa Taramasu|comp}}

She has the habit of peering down her nose at everyone and put great store in ceremony. Some thought her precocious.

There is potentially conflicting infomation on Kwamesa's exact strength in the One Power. The Companion lists her strength level as , which would make her strong for an Aes Sedai. In the books, however, Nynaeve thinks that Reanne Corly "easily equaled Sheriam, say, or Kwamesa or Kiruna. Not many women possessed so much strength". The other three women in that list all have a strength of . Nynaeve may simply be grouping strong sisters together, but she has met several Aes Sedai stronger than Kwamesa to use as examples - all the members of the Salidar Six, for example. Being would make her very strong for an Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Kwamesa Taramasu was an Aes Sedai and rebel Sitter of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She was killed while taking Rand as a prisoner to the White Tower. Rand still considers her as one of the women who died for him. She was possibly one of the sisters holding his shield when he escaped from the chest they used to hold him.

Category:Cairhien expedition Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: She was killed while taking Rand as a prisoner to the White Tower. Rand still considers her as one of the women who died for him. She was possibly one of the sisters holding his shield when he escaped from the chest…

enrichments.description:
She is short and toad-like. She has curly hair.

It is likely that she is a librarian, as Egwene al'Vere thinks of her as one of the Brown sisters who spent her life "roaming the back library stacks and only surfaced once a century or so to recite instructions to prospective Amyrlins". Once a century is likely an exaggeration, but the rest is possibly true.

She instructs Egwene on the proper procedure when going through the raising of a new Amyrlin Seat. Egwene had never met her before.

Category:Librarians Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: She is short and toad-like. She has curly hair.

enrichments.description:
Lannis was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and an ancient scholar who wrote about the Forsaken., Lannis}}

When Egwene learns that Mesaana hides in the White Tower camouflaging herself to a sister, she asks Yukiri and Saerin to find and learn everything about Mesaana in the library of the Tower. Saerin mentions Lannis:

"The only other thing I could find of relevance, Mother, was a curious reference from the Blue scholar Lannis, who indicated that Mesaana was second only to Demandred in sheer anger. Not hate. Anger. Lannis thought Mesaana was angry – at herself, at the world, at the other Forsaken– because she wasn't one of those at the forefront. That could make her very dangerous.".

Category:Aes Sedai Category:Scholars Category:Channelers Category:Characters named after fans
enrichments.short_description: Lannis was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and an ancient scholar who wrote about the Forsaken., Lannis}}

enrichments.description:
She had long dark hair with white wings and copper skin. She had thin eyebrows. She is elegant.

Larelle had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. At the time of New Spring, she is stronger in the One Power than Moiraine Damodred, although Moiraine would eventually be stronger once she reached her full strength.

She taught Moiraine in several classes, both as novice and Accepted and had a way of asking the question you least wanted to hear. Her pupils were torn between being intimidated by her and wanting to be her. Every girl in her classes thought her the perfect sister. She had a way of asking the last question you wanted to hear.

While Moiraine Damodred is out searching for the Dragon Reborn she meets up with Larelle in Kandor.
enrichments.short_description: She had long dark hair with white wings and copper skin. She had thin eyebrows. She is elegant.

enrichments.description:
Larissa Lyndel was an Aes Sedai from the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was a bony woman whose "plainness almost overcame Aes Sedai age-lessness".

Larissa is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she would have an above-average ability in Healing.
enrichments.short_description: Larissa Lyndel was an Aes Sedai from the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She has the copper skin of a Domani, and is thin and nearly as tall as a man. She is willowy, graceful, and beautiful. When Min meets her at Tar Valon, she describes her hair straight, dark and only a little longer than Min's own hair.

She lost her ageless look after being stilled, and looked about 23 years old.

As Keeper of the Chronicles, she was brisk and well-organized.

After being stilled and Healed, she was considered very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of . Leane explains that she and Siuan were less than half their original strength and, had they even been as strong as half, "most [in Salidar] would be as strong, and a good many stronger". Siuan, with a strength level of , considered herself so weak that a "no more than middling" sister like Aeldene Stonebridge would expect her to be "holding my tongue until [she] give me permission to speak". Aeldene would be classed as no more than low average and we know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker than Leane.

enrichments.description:
Lelaine Akashi is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She is currently First Selector of the Blue and one of its Sitters in the Hall of the Tower.

Lelaine is tall, slender and quite pretty, with a warm smile that transforms her face, although she does not smile often. She is dignified, has dark penetrating almond shaped eyes, and full lips. Despite her age her hair has not sign of gray.

Lelaine is has a strength level of in the One Power, putting her at the very top tier of Aes Sedai in terms of strength. She was one of only four women mentioned by Cadsuane Melaidhrin in New Spring as being the on par with Moiraine Damodred, and Cadsuane predicted that these five would be at the top of the hierarchy once she, Kerene Nagashi and Meilyn Arganya were dead. Within a year of this prediction, Lelaine would have been the strongest Aes Sedai in the Tower.

Due to a number of deaths between New Spring and the end of A Memory of Light, she is now the fourth strongest living Aes Sedai, behind Nynaeve al'Meara, Elayne Trakand and Cadsuane Melaidhrin with a large gap between herself and Cadsuane.
enrichments.short_description: Lelaine Akashi is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She is currently First Selector of the Blue and one of its Sitters in the Hall of the Tower.

enrichments.description:
Lemai spent six years as novice and eight as Accepted. She remained loyal to the White Tower during the White Tower schism.

Lemai is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the Black Tower, with only Desandre Alraed being as strong. In the hierarchy, Lemai is slightly behind Desandre, being referred to her as "second" to her. This is because she spent longer in training.

She was one of Toveine Gazal's group of fifty-one sisters sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to destroy the Black Tower. They were all captured and bonded involuntarily by the Asha'man. In particular Lemai was bonded by Morly Hardlin.

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Lemai, at Alviarin Freidhen's suggestion.
enrichments.short_description: Lemai spent six years as novice and eight as Accepted. She remained loyal to the White Tower during the White Tower schism.

enrichments.description:
Liandrin has dark brown eyes and honey-colored hair, which she wears in a multitude of thin beaded braids. She is pretty with a face bearing doll-like features and a rosebud mouth.

She is selfish and cunning, willing to use manipulation or intimidation tactics to get what she wants. Liandrin deliberately behaves and speaks like upper crust Taraboners. However, when angry she will sometimes lapse into the more vulgar dialect she spoke during her commoner upbringing.

Liandrin is very strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . Few equalled this strength, and even fewer surpassed it.

Liandrin had developed a rudimentary form of Compulsion which she frequently uses to manipulate others to forward selfish personal agendas. She is very weak in healing, and is frequently jealous of those who can kill directly with the power; a skill tightly linked with healing. Though she first learned to channel on her own as a girl, she does not consider herself a wilder and loathes them.
enrichments.short_description: Liandrin has dark brown eyes and honey-colored hair, which she wears in a multitude of thin beaded braids. She is pretty with a face bearing doll-like features and a rosebud mouth.

enrichments.description:
A librarian is a person who professionally works with information management. The professional duties of librarians encompass a wide range of activities, including the provision of access to information, the conduct of research, the creation and management of information systems, the creation, leadership, and evaluation of educational programs, and the provision of instruction on information literacy to users.

The role of the librarian has evolved significantly over time, particularly in the past century, which has witnessed the emergence of numerous media and technologies. From the earliest libraries in the ancient world to the modern information hub, there have been individuals responsible for the maintenance and dissemination of information stored in data repositories. The roles and responsibilities of librarians vary considerably based on factors such as the nature of the library, the librarian's area of expertise, and the functions essential for the maintenance of collections and their accessibility to users.

Education for librarianship has undergone a transformation over time, adapting to the evolution of its roles and responsibilities.

enrichments.description:
Circa , Lideine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

From a letter dated , it is stated that Lideine has since been stilled, along with several of her followers. It is highly likely that Lideine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of .

It appears she was a leader among the Aes Sedai who refused to follow Elisane Tishar, since after her stilling, most of the resistance against Elisane came to a halt.
