enrichments.description:
Lirene Doirellin is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah., Lirene Doirellin}}

She is 5'2" tall, a little shorter than Egwene al'Vere. She has nervous eyes that remind Egwene of a sparrow watching out for cats. She used to be plump, but lost a lot of weight due to her exile. Her skin has become weathered as well.

Although she is Red Ajah, her clothing only has traces of red in it. It is possible that she wishes to disown the Ajah that disowned her in her years of exile.

Lirene is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.
enrichments.short_description: Lirene Doirellin is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah., Lirene Doirellin}}

enrichments.description:
Llana is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

Llana is part of the Red Ajah's mission to capture Mazrim Taim. However, she is also sent by the Black Ajah in order to kidnap Taim before he can be brought to the White Tower and gentled.

Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Black Ajah Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Black Ajah Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Llana is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Ludice Daneen was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

She was bony, with a long grim face and brightly beaded Taraboner braids that hung to her waist.

She was handpicked by Tamra Ospenya for the task of searching for the Dragon Reborn due to her strict way and dedication to Tower law.

She was murdered by the Black Ajah while tring to find the Dragon Reborn. As in the case with Aisha Raveneos and Valera Gorovni, it is unknown where and how she was murdered.
enrichments.short_description: Ludice Daneen was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

enrichments.description:
Lusonia Cole is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Lusonia Cole}}

Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest of the group that escaped Dumai's Wells. Therefore, it is likely that Lusonia's strength level is beneath , which is Covarla's level.

Lusonia was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

After kidnapping him and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan. Her room there is displaced with the arrival of Tarna Feir.
enrichments.short_description: Lusonia Cole is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Lusonia Cole}}

enrichments.description:
Lyrelle Arienwin is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall, before the schism, later among the rebel Aes Sedai and finally after reunification.

She is tall for a Cairhienin, although of average height (about 5'4 tall), and elegant and graceful. She is pale and has large dark eyes. She somehow seems beautiful without being at all pretty. She owns a dress of blue slashed silk, with red and gold embroidered on the bodice.

Lyrelle is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Lyrelle was born in the year , so she is 167 years old. She went to the Tower in 849 NE. After spending six years as novice and four years as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year . She was elected Sitter recently in the year 995 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Lyrelle Arienwin is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall, before the schism, later among the rebel Aes Sedai and finally after reunification.

enrichments.description:
Mabriam is one of the few historical Aes Sedai to be given a strength rating in The Wheel of Time Companion. She was exceptionally strong in the One Power, with a level of . This is the same strength as Cadsuane, with no sister being as strong in the last thousand years. Even given the decline in strength of Aes Sedai since her lifetime, she was still likely high in the hierachy, not that much weaker than the Forsaken who were uncommonly strong even during the Age of Legends.

History records that in addition to being a natural negotiator, she was Ta'veren; able to guide events around her to bend the pattern to her design.

During the late second or early third century After the Breaking, Mabriam proposed to the rulers of the nine other vast countries spanning the Westlands that they sign a formal treaty of alliance binding them together against the threat of the Shadow.

Through Mabriam's ta'veren nature and Aes Sedai help in the negotiations, the Compact of the Ten Nations was signed in . The Compact would stand for over eight hundred years and help the kingdoms fight the Trolloc Wars, although the wars would eventually overwhelm and destroy half of the kingdoms. The other half would collapse following the end of the wars and new nations would later arise.
enrichments.short_description: Mabriam is one of the few historical Aes Sedai to be given a strength rating in The Wheel of Time Companion. She was exceptionally strong in the One Power, with a level of . This is the same strength as Cadsuane, with…

enrichments.description:
Maenadrin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Maenadrin and Negaine were surprised to see Egwene al'Vere in the Brown Ajah quarters very late at night. In reality, Egwene had been following her usual path to the novice quarters and was just as surprised to see the Brown sisters on reaching what she thought was her destination. This confusion was a result in a shift in the Pattern which had swapped the locations of part of the novice quarters with a portion of those belonging to the Brown Ajah.

The swap occured without any of those inside the affected areas feeling any motion or vibration. Maenadrin, along with the other Browns in the same situation, continued to live in her old room in the middle of the novice quarters as the alternative would have been to be squeezed into a much smaller and basic accommodation provided to a novice.

Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Maenadrin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Maerin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Her tent is large and extravagant, filled with lots of furniture and carpets. She is thought of as one of the Aes Sedai who "were not accustomed to austerity." Few brought as much to the battlefield as she.

Her number of Warders is unknown, but due to the amount of luggage she brought, she likely has several.

As part of Gawyn Trakand's efforts to protect his Ward, Egwene al'Vere, the Amyrlin Seat, he has her sleep in different tents every night, and during the initial White Tower offensive into the Shadow-dominated Kandor, Egwene stays for one night in her tent.
enrichments.short_description: Maerin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Magla Daronos is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. Her Warder is Rorik.

She is described as being a large woman with broad shoulders and well muscled and so she looked as though she had worked a hammer or a sword. But she is not fat.

Her personality is in accordance with her body type: direct and forceful, sometimes overpowering.

Magla is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent. This is slightly different from how her strength is listed in the The Wheel of Time Companion - see Errata below.
enrichments.short_description: Magla Daronos is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. Her Warder is Rorik.

enrichments.description:
Maigan is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Maigan}}

Her name suggests she is from Andor as we know another Maigan who is Andoran.

She is beautiful with a long face, large eyes, and full lips, and is "elongated" somehow but not very tall.

Maigan seems to be a very influential sister, chosen by the Blue Ajah as a substitute to Anaiya, killed by Aran'gar, as a member of Egwene's advisory council. She has the same level of strength in the One Power, , as three others in Egwene's council: Myrelle, Morvrin, and Carlinya.
enrichments.short_description: Maigan is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Maigan}}

enrichments.description:
Circa , Mailaine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

It is highly likely that Mailaine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of , because from a letter dated , it is stated that after the stilling of Lideine Rajan, Mailaine ceased her resistance and led her followers to kneel.

It is not known if also Mailaine was stilled or instead enrolled in the White Tower.

Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai after the Breaking Category:Short pages Category:Character not mentioned in books Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Circa , Mailaine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

enrichments.description:
Malind Nachenin is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Green Ajah.

Malind is a slightly plump and pretty Kandori with a round face, full smiling lips, and fierce, dark eyes.

Malind is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Malind is 59 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in 957 NE. After spending twelve years as Novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 980 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Malind Nachenin is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Maralenda is an Andoran Aes Sedai of noble origin, in the rebel camp near Tar Valon. Therefore, she is not of the Red Ajah.

She is a distant cousin to the House Trakand and Siuan uses the fact that she had been seen talking to Romanda to distract Lelaine and trying to manipulate her.

Category:Rebel Aes Sedai Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Nobility
enrichments.short_description: Maralenda is an Andoran Aes Sedai of noble origin, in the rebel camp near Tar Valon. Therefore, she is not of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Marasale's name could indicate a Domani origin (see Duhara Basaheen, Saroiya Farseen, Sanaiye Asaheen, and Hafeen Bakuvun).

She was the Amyrlin Seat at the time of Cadsuane Melaidhrin and Romanda Cassin's births.

Marasale held the position for twenty-seven years until her death in . She was Cemaile Sorenthaine's successor and Feragaine Saralman's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was in large part a puppet of the Hall, chosen because the Sitters thought she would be easily controlled by them. In fact, in large part it happened.
enrichments.short_description: Marasale's name could indicate a Domani origin (see Duhara Basaheen, Saroiya Farseen, Sanaiye Asaheen, and Hafeen Bakuvun).

enrichments.description:
Marillin Gemalphin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

She is skinny, with dreamy blue eyes and lifeless brown hair. She has a narrow face.

She loves cats and other animals, quite possibly more than she likes people, going out of her way to Heal stray cats.

Marillin is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . Among thirteen sisters that fled with Liandrin, only Liandrin is stronger, although Eldrith Jhondar is only slightly weaker. When the much weaker Temaile Kinderode calls her a fool, Marillin is quick to reminder her who should stand higher among them, a fact observed by Elayne Trakand.
enrichments.short_description: Marillin Gemalphin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

enrichments.description:
Marith Jaen was Amyrlin Seat from to . She was raised from the Blue Ajah.

Born in , she went to the White Tower in . She is described in the Companion as being a "stainless-steel bitch".

She retired to the country in when Tamra Ospenya was raised Amyrlin Seat. It was speculated that she did so because of personality clashes with Tamra, and because she wanted to be Amyrlin instead. Her stated reason was that she wished to write her memoirs.

After the death of Sierin Vayu in , Marith was called from retirement to take the Amyrlin Seat. The Hall felt they had no choice, as both Tamra and Sierin had died suddenly, as had many senior sisters (as part of the Black Ajah's efforts to find the Dragon Reborn for themselves).
enrichments.short_description: Marith Jaen was Amyrlin Seat from to . She was raised from the Blue Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Marith Riven is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Marith Riven}}

Marith is 5'6" tall and has not yet achieved the ageless look.

Marith is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Marith is 32 years old. She was born in 968 NE and went to the White Tower in 984 NE. Marith spent eight years as a novice and seven as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in 999 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Marith Riven is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Marith Riven}}

enrichments.description:
Marris is described as being plump-chinned. She usually seemed mild and absorbed in her studies.

Marris is exceptionally weak for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power strength level of . She is the second weakest known Aes Sedai, just above Daigian Moseneillin, and so at the bottom of the hierarchy. It may be speculated that being at such a disadvantage with respect to other Aes Sedai would make her bitter enough to join the Black Ajah.

Marris' history is not given in the books or Companion, although some details may be inferred. Her lack in strength means she would have spent a long time in training. Daigian, of similar strength, was in training for forty eight years whereas two other weak Aes Sedai, Bennae Nalsad and Cariandre Temalien were in training for twenty-four and twenty-five years respectively. Marris is considerably weaker than these two, however. Her connection with Leane Sharif and Elin Warrel may indicate they were in training together, but this is less certain.

She spends long periods in the White Tower itself.
enrichments.short_description: Marris is described as being plump-chinned. She usually seemed mild and absorbed in her studies.

enrichments.description:
Marthera is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

During the Seanchan attack on the White Tower, Marthera stands with Josaine and Adelorna Bastine to fight the invaders. The group is defeated within minutes (Josaine dies and Adelorna is forced to flee) and Marthera is taken captive by the Seanchan and gets an a'dam placed around her neck. Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Slaves Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: Marthera is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She was tall and slender with dark deep-set eyes.

During the Aiel War, Marya held the White Tower's seat on a decision-making council for the Grand Alliance. She was advised by Azil Mareed, a Domani and commander of the Tower Guard. She was the only member of the council to be excluded from field command of the armies of the Alliance, most probably because the aversion to Aes Sedai from the Children of the Light.

She supposedly died in her bed but she was actually killed by the Black Ajah because she was suspected to be aware of their goals and to be one of the sisters chosen by Tamra Ospenya to search for the Dragon Reborn.

Category:Deceased Category:High Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: She was tall and slender with dark deep-set eyes.

enrichments.description:
Faile mentions Jestian Redhill, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told them to do. Mashera bore seven children for a man she loathed.

Other than Elayne, she is the only reference we have to an Aes Sedai becoming pregnant.

Category:Short pages Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Faile mentions Jestian Redhill, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told them to do. Mashera bore seven children for a man she loathed.

enrichments.description:
Masuri Sokawa is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She is slim, pretty but not beautiful, and has brown, merry eyes. She always speaks quietly, but unlike many Browns, she always speaks straight to the point.

She is an untypical Brown in that she takes some interest in clothes and men, and likes to flirt, though she could sometimes ignore the man she is flirting with, because of something interesting, such as a book or just a sudden interesting thought.

Masuri is a strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of .
enrichments.short_description: Masuri Sokawa is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Mayam Colona is a Tairen Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has no Warder.

Mayam is slim, 5'6 tall, with dark skin, black eyes and black hair. She still lacks the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

She could eat as much as she liked without gaining a pound.

Mayam has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
enrichments.short_description: Mayam Colona is a Tairen Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has no Warder.

enrichments.description:
Her name could indicate that she was from Illian, given her melodious surname that ends with -os.

Medanor held the position for twenty-nine years until her death in . She was Balladare Arandaille's successor and Kiyosa Natomo's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

It is possible that the Kavarthen Wars continued into her reign, as they are only stated as having begun at the end of the reign of the former Amyrlin Seat.

She was a fairly strong Amyrlin and skilled in mediation.
enrichments.short_description: Her name could indicate that she was from Illian, given her melodious surname that ends with -os.

enrichments.description:
Megda is a Tar Valoner Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. Her Warder is Maynard.

Megda is a slender woman with fiery red hair, green eyes, and pale skin.

She was known to be in Tobin's Hollow in Toman Head during the Seanchan attack in the region, after learning of rumors about women using the One Power to harm others. While in the region, she was able to convey messages by use of a ter'angreal.

She was taken as damane by a sul'dam named Tumva. Her messages stopped, which alerted the attention of Nadira Sedai. She manages to escape and be reunited with Maynard when Falme is attacked by the Heroes of the Horn.
enrichments.short_description: Megda is a Tar Valoner Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. Her Warder is Maynard.

enrichments.description:
Meidani is pretty, with dark golden hair, blue eyes and full lips. She is tall and slim, but has a large bust which seemed overly large because of her slimness, something which gave her concern. She often wore ornaments and pins in her hair as she liked jewelry. She has a melodious voice.

She had less control over her facial expressions than most Aes Sedai, especially when angry or resentful - her eyes would narrow or blaze with anger and her mouth would pout. This was more evident because she always controlled her voice well. This only happened with personal matters though, as she always maintained perfect composure during negotiations and mediations.

Meidani is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel, a weave she learned from Egwene al'Vere.

She was only a fair-to-average negotiator and mediator. If she felt things were not progressing as they should, she would dig in her heels even if it was a detriment to finding a solution.
enrichments.short_description: Meidani is pretty, with dark golden hair, blue eyes and full lips. She is tall and slim, but has a large bust which seemed overly large because of her slimness, something which gave her concern. She often wore ornaments…

enrichments.description:
Meilyn Arganya was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She had one Warder named Andro.

She was a tall woman with silver-gray hair, a thrusting chin, a smooth face, and "startling" blue eyes.

She was exceptionally strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . Except for Cadsuane Melaidhrin, she was the strongest channeler the White Tower had seen in six hundred years.

She went to the White Tower in at the age of 16. She spent 7 years as a novice and 6 as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in at the age of 29.
enrichments.short_description: Meilyn Arganya was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She had one Warder named Andro.

enrichments.description:
She is a plump Andoran with ample hips, bright blue eyes,and thick black eyebrows. Her mouth looks like she is ready to smile.

She is a slightly atypical Red sister in that she does not seem to despise men - in fact she sends money back to Andor for her grandnephews' education. This implies that Melare is not a very old Aes Sedai.

Melare, along with Arebis, Desala Nevanche, Zanica, and three other Aes Sedai, were involved in the capture of Leane Sharif at Northharbor. She did not quite approve of Desala beating Leane, even if she was claiming to be Aes Sedai.

She was also sent, along with Pevara Tazanovni, Javindhra Doraille, Desala, Jezrail, and Tarna Feir, to the Black Tower to put the proposition of Red sisters bonding Asha'man as Warders to Mazrim Taim. He has agreed to this. Melare was chosen because she supports her nephews; indicating that, unlike most Reds, she does not hate men.
enrichments.short_description: She is a plump Andoran with ample hips, bright blue eyes,and thick black eyebrows. Her mouth looks like she is ready to smile.

enrichments.description:
Melavaire Someinellin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Melavaire is a stout, short Cairhienin (inches shorter than Egwene), with flecks of white in her dark hair.

She was kindly, but could be fearsome when angry.

She is likely to be more than 150 years old as she has streaks of white in her hair, a sign of extreme age in an Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Melavaire Someinellin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Melvara is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. Her supposed Ajah is unknown.

She was first mentioned in Verin Mathwin's book, naming her a Darkfriend. Category:Dreadlords Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Melvara is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. Her supposed Ajah is unknown.

enrichments.description:
She seems to be a pleasant person, both in appearance and personality. However, she seems very strong-minded, never letting anything stand between herself and her goals. She was also willing to do anything that did not violate the Three Oaths., Memara}}

Memara is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Memara was sent by Alviarin to Queen Tenobia in Saldaea as her personal advisor; her real purpose was to keep the queen under control and lessen Davram Bashere's influence on her, but Memara failed and was unsuccessful in both; she was left behind when Tenobia went to meet the other Borderland rulers.

Elaida intended to have Tenobia kidnapped and brought to the White Tower as King Alsalam and King Mattin Stepaneos; Likely Memara was initially part of this plan.
enrichments.short_description: She seems to be a pleasant person, both in appearance and personality. However, she seems very strong-minded, never letting anything stand between herself and her goals. She was also willing to do anything that did not…

enrichments.description:
Meramor is one of only three Yellow sisters who accepts Nynaeve al'Meara as a full sister before she is actually raised.

Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower
enrichments.short_description: Meramor is one of only three Yellow sisters who accepts Nynaeve al'Meara as a full sister before she is actually raised.

enrichments.description:
Merana Ambrey is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Merana Ambrey}} She is notable for being the one initially put in charge of the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn.

Merana is on the slim side of a medium build, with dark hair and hazel eyes. She is about 5'4 tall.

Merana is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of .

She is above the stated minimum strength to be able to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Merana Ambrey is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Merana Ambrey}} She is notable for being the one initially put in charge of the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn.

enrichments.description:
Merean Redhill (pronounced: MEH-ree-an red-hill) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah publically, and secretly a member of the Black Ajah.

She was plump and motherly with graying hair. She was 5'8 tall.

She was very strong in the One Power, with a strength of , only a little below Moiraine's ultimate strength. Few would have been her equal, and even fewer would have surpassed her.

She was Aes Sedai for more than 200 years. She was born in .
enrichments.short_description: Merean Redhill (pronounced: MEH-ree-an red-hill) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah publically, and secretly a member of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Merilille Ceandevin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is a short and slender Cairhienin with glossy black hair and large liquid dark eyes. She is pale skinned and elegant.

Merilille has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She is not able to Travel. She is noted as having to rely on the help of Reanne Corly to open a gateway, a fact which irked her.

She went to the Tower in 845 NE at the age of 18, relatively late for a novice.
enrichments.short_description: Merilille Ceandevin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is tall, with blue eyes and dark hair drawn severely back and an ivory complexion. She is stern-faced with a stern manner. Some thought her beautiful without being pretty, some saw her as handsome, while others saw only severity.

Merise has a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong in the Aes Sedai hierarchy. Few are as strong as her, and fewer stronger. She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She has an ability at Healing, although not as good as Corele Hovian.

She went to the White Tower in at the age of thirteen, an extremely young age for a Novice. She lied about her age but was discovered, and so she spent fifteen years as a novice and five as Accepted.
enrichments.short_description: She is tall, with blue eyes and dark hair drawn severely back and an ivory complexion. She is stern-faced with a stern manner. Some thought her beautiful without being pretty, some saw her as handsome, while others saw…

enrichments.description:
Merym is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is only mentioned in passing and never appears in a scene.

Nothing is known about Merym's strength in the One Power.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She is one in the group of sisters that take Egwene into custody, when she was discovered blocking the harbor with cuendillar weaves.
enrichments.short_description: Merym is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is only mentioned in passing and never appears in a scene.

enrichments.description:
Mesaana (meh-SAH-nah; /mɛˈsɑː.nɑ/), previously known as Saine Tarasind, is one of the thirteen Forsaken who were trapped in Shayol Ghul at the end of the War of Power due to the Dragon's sealing. During the Age of Legends, Saine Tarasind worked as a teacher at Collam Daan. She later organized schools teaching the glories of the Dark One once she turned to the Shadow and took on the name Mesaana.

She is 5'5" tall, looks just short of her middle years, with big watery blue eyes and chin-length dark hair. She has a voice that sounds like chimes. She was pretty rather than beautiful.

She occasionally changes her appearance to that of a shadow, wearing blacks and whites and having eyes and lips of silver.

Her strength in the power is , making her one of the most powerful female channelers ever, only outstripped by Alivia, Semirhage, and Lanfear (prior to having the Finn feed on her).
enrichments.short_description: Mesaana (meh-SAH-nah; /mɛˈsɑː.nɑ/), previously known as Saine Tarasind, is one of the thirteen Forsaken who were trapped in Shayol Ghul at the end of the War of Power due to the Dragon's sealing. During the Age of…

enrichments.description: She partook in the battle against the White Tower and its allies in Tel'aran'rhiod. She was killed by Egwene al'Vere with a ball of fire. If she was in her own body in Tel'aran'rhiod when she was killed, (which Darkfriends tend to do) her soul would be obliterated. It is likely, however, that she was using one of the stolen dream ter'angreal. Category:Dreadlords Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: She partook in the battle against the White Tower and its allies in Tel'aran'rhiod. She was killed by Egwene al'Vere with a ball of fire. If she was in her own body in Tel'aran'rhiod when she was killed, (which…

enrichments.description:
Mirlene is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was enrolled in the Novice book in at the age of sixteen. After spending eleven years as a Novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in at the age of 34.

Mirlene was in the group of Aes Sedai that kidnapped Rand. She and both her Warders were killed during the Battle at Dumai's Wells.

Mirlene Cornwell is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion". She is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
enrichments.short_description: Mirlene is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

enrichments.description:
Circa , Mitsora was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Mitsora's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Mitsora was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Mitsora and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

enrichments.description:
She has iron-gray hair and is tall and plump. A stern woman who brooked no nonsense and saw nonsense everywhere.

Having gray hair may indicate that Miyasi is very old, most likely more than two hundred.

Miyasi is very particular and will only eat walnuts if they are whole.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split. She is one of the sisters to hold the shield over Leane Sharif, when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her.
enrichments.short_description: She has iron-gray hair and is tall and plump. A stern woman who brooked no nonsense and saw nonsense everywhere.

enrichments.description:
Rumor has it that her Warders are her two brothers, though no one has dared comment on it to her.

They are described as "handsome", so are likely not old men. Assuming they are her younger brothers and she is no more than 15 years older than them, she is likely not older than 70, but as young as 30.

She reports to Saerin Asnobar about the positions of the Aes Sedai during the Battle of Tar Valon.

Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Rumor has it that her Warders are her two brothers, though no one has dared comment on it to her.

enrichments.description:
Moria Karentanis was an Aes Sedai Sitter of the Blue Ajah, who was also secretly a member of the Black Ajah.

Moria was ordinary and plain - so much so that the ageless look was not obvious. She was not considered graceful and had a thick accent. She wore plain blue wool.

Moria is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Moria was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending eight years as Novice and seven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year . She was raised a Sitter in , in Salidar.
enrichments.short_description: Moria Karentanis was an Aes Sedai Sitter of the Blue Ajah, who was also secretly a member of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Morvrin Thakanos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Morvrin is 5'5" tall, round-faced and stout, with graying hair, brown eyes, plump hands, and ample hips.

Morvrin is a placid sort, and sometimes has an absently vague look. She requires a great deal of proof for anything.

Morvrin is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai. Among the Salidar Six, she is equaled by Myrelle Berengari, Carlinya Sorevin and Anaiya Carel with only Sheriam Bayanar stronger and Beonin Marinye weaker. However Morvrin serves the distinction of being much more senior, having worn the shawl for more than a hundred and fifty years longer than the others.
enrichments.short_description: Morvrin Thakanos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Murane is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

Murane is part of the Red Ajah's mission to capture Mazrim Taim. However, she is also sent by the Black Ajah in order to kidnap Taim before he can be brought to the White Tower and gentled.

Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Black Ajah
enrichments.short_description: Murane is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Musarin is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is tall and aging. She has white hair., Musarin}} Her hair color implies she is significantly more than two hundred years old.

She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of Air. Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Musarin is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Myrelle Berengari (pronounced: my-REHL beh-renh-GAH-ree) is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Myrelle Berengari}}

Myrelle is described as darkly beautiful with an oval face and smooth, olive skin. She has large, dark eyes and dark hair. She is about 5'4 tall.

She is impatient and has a particularly fiery temper, even among the Greens. She often wears a knowing smile.

Myrelle is strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of . Among the Salidar Six, she is equalled by Morvrin Thakanos, Anaiya Carel and Carlinya Sorevin. Sheriam Bayanar is slightly stronger, and Beonin Marinye slightly weaker.
enrichments.short_description: Myrelle Berengari (pronounced: my-REHL beh-renh-GAH-ree) is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Myrelle Berengari}}

enrichments.description:
When she was raised in she was considered a weak Amyrlin. However, after she returned from a seemingly self-imposed retreat in 758 NE she seemed a new woman. She was then a strong Amyrlin, considered one of the strongest the White Tower has ever had. She was considered a successful Amyrlin with Egwene al'Vere stating centuries later that she wants to be just like Myriam.

The true story, however, is not widely known. This "retreat" was actually a kidnapping by a fifty-three year old Cadsuane Melaidhrin. Cadsuane captured her with the intent to make her a stronger Amyrlin. Over the two months she had her captured, she toughened the Amyrlin through many methods, including physical ones. When she returned, she deflected the accusations by implying that Cadsuane did nothing of the sort.

Myriam held the position for forty-three years until her death in . She was Feragaine Saralman's successor and Zeranda Tyrim's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Notably, Myriam chose Sereille Bagand of the White Ajah as her Mistress of Novices, though the name of her Keeper of the Chronicles and her subsequent Ajah are unknown. Sereille served excellently in the same office also during the reigns of the two Amyrlins who succeed Myriam (a Brown and a Gray respectively) becoming legendary in this role.
enrichments.short_description: When she was raised in she was considered a weak Amyrlin. However, after she returned from a seemingly self-imposed retreat in 758 NE she seemed a new woman. She was then a strong Amyrlin, considered one of the…

enrichments.description:
Nacelle Kayama was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and also secretly a member of the Black Ajah., Nacelle Kayama}}

She was tall and slender and had blue eyes.

Romanda thinks that she is not particularly intelligent.

Nacelle has a One Power strength of , which is very weak for an Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Nacelle Kayama was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and also secretly a member of the Black Ajah., Nacelle Kayama}}

enrichments.description:
Nadira is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. Her Warder is Gable.

Nadira was communicating with Megda of the Green Ajah via ter'angreal when the other woman went to Toman Head to investigate claims of women harming others with the One Power. Communication stopped after Megda was taken damane by the Seanchan, which worried Nadira, who went to the village of Aturo's Orchard on the border of Almoth Plain and Toman Head.

Nadira later traveled to Tanchico, where she began investigating the activities of Belyne Sedai, and learned that Megda had been able to escape Falme when the city was attacked by the Heroes of the Horn.

Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Characters only mentioned in the RPG Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Nadira is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. Her Warder is Gable.

enrichments.description:
Nagora is a Cairhienin Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a loyalist contingent. , Nagora}}

She is lean with pale hair worn in a roll on the nape of her neck. She is short of stature and sits very straight as if to make up for her lack of height.

She is one of the few Whites with a Warder.

She is one of the sisters to hold the shield over Leane Sharif, when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her. She also taught Egwene logic; the lesson turned to how to deal with an aging Warder.
enrichments.short_description: Nagora is a Cairhienin Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a loyalist contingent. , Nagora}}

enrichments.description:
She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She is one of the Aes Sedai bound to Rand al'Thor, and therefore one of the Aes Sedai who was captured after the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Along all the prisoner sisters in Cairhien she has sworn an oath of fealty to Rand al'Thor.
enrichments.short_description: She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

enrichments.description:
She is very weak in the One Power, likely less than level in the One Power, and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

She disappears after Seanchan raid on the White Tower. She is on a shortlist of Aes Sedai that Egwene al'Vere receives when searching for candidates that may be Mesaana. It is likely she was captured by the Seanchan and made damane.

Category:Low Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai Category:Unknown status
enrichments.short_description: She is very weak in the One Power, likely less than level in the One Power, and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

enrichments.description:
She is the eldest daughter of Quillin Tasil. Her mother was one of the most successful silk merchants in Bandar Eban. Since her father is still alive, it can be assumed that Namine is a relatively young Aes Sedai.

She went to the White Tower and joined the Brown Ajah, settling down as a Librarian. Cadsuane Melaidhrin was impressed with Namine's understanding of current events and followed the link down to her father, an Andoran innkeeper in Bandar Eban, who became one of her eyes-and-ears.

Category:Librarians Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: She is the eldest daughter of Quillin Tasil. Her mother was one of the most successful silk merchants in Bandar Eban. Since her father is still alive, it can be assumed that Namine is a relatively young Aes Sedai.

enrichments.description:
Naorisa Cambral is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Nothing is known about Naorisa's strength or abilities in the One Power. , Naorisa Cambral}}

She is elected as a Sitter in the Rebel Hall to replace Delana Mosalaine. She reswears the Three Oaths on the Oath Rod and proves that she is not Black Ajah. She is then part of the unanimous vote to attack the White Tower with their army.

After the reunification, she and Kwamesa Taramasu (the other Gray Sitter elected in the Rebel Hall) were no longer Sitters. Varilin Zanaire and Yukiri Haruna resumed the seats they had before the split with the seat formerly held by the Darkfriend sister Evanellein Lorn, being taken by Andaya Forae who was appointed by the Head Clerk of the Gray Ajah, Serancha Colvine.
enrichments.short_description: Naorisa Cambral is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Narenwin Barda is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is thin, very short and with a square face. She usually is so quiet that people could forget she was there; she was also mousy around other sisters.

Nerenwin is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of " or "., Narenwhin Barda}} The lower possible strength matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability a the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

Being a Yellow sister also usually indicates a skill in Healing.
enrichments.short_description: Narenwin Barda is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Natasia is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is Saldaean, with dark tilted eyes, high cheekbones and full lips.

Nearly every flat surface in her room is filled with figurines, small carvings and painted miniatures.

She was known as a lenient teacher, and lectured pedantically.
enrichments.short_description: Natasia is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Negaine is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She and Felaana Bevaine found Beonin Marinye wandering in Tar Valon and brought her to Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan when she asked to see the Amyrlin Seat.

Negaine and Maenadrin were surprised to see Egwene al'Vere in the Brown Ajah quarters very late at night. In reality, Egwene had been following her usual path to the novice quarters and was just as surprised to see the Brown sisters on reaching what she thought was her destination. This confusion was a result in a shift in the Pattern which had swapped the locations of part of the novice quarters with a portion of those belonging to the Brown Ajah.
enrichments.short_description: Negaine is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is 5'2 tall, slim, wiry and whipcord tough. Rand thinks she is relatively pleasant for an Aes Sedai.

Nelavaire has a strength in the One Power of , slightly below average for an Aes Sedai. She is unable to Travel without linking.

She was born with the spark which began to manifest at the age of thirteen. Due to this, the White Tower made an exception and she was enrolled at thirteen as a Novice in the year .

After spending ten years as a novice and six years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in at the age of 29.
enrichments.short_description: She is 5'2 tall, slim, wiry and whipcord tough. Rand thinks she is relatively pleasant for an Aes Sedai.
Nemaira Eldros was an Aes Sedai who lived after the Breaking of the World and before the founding of the White Tower., Nemaira Eldros}}

enrichments.description:
She stands higher than average in the Aes Sedai hierarchy, being able to create a suitable gateway on her own, which implies to be above level .

She is plump and blue eyed and as mean as a snake with an itch.

She is sent to collect tributes for Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower and collected a tribute from Aesdaishar in Chachin. Ashmanaille, sent by the Rebel Aes Sedai to do exactly the same thing, was told by the shambayan that the Tower had already collected its tributes, and deduced that the sister from Elaida's Tower was Nesita.

She is one of the Red Ajah who follows Egwene al'Vere around the White Tower and feeds her forkroot. When Egwene tried to refuse the tea, Nesite helped pour it down her throat with a funnel.
enrichments.short_description: She stands higher than average in the Aes Sedai hierarchy, being able to create a suitable gateway on her own, which implies to be above level .

enrichments.description:
Nesune is a slender and birdlike Kandori with dark hair and nearly black eyes.

She is strong in the One Power with a strength of . In the group of Aes Sedai that arrived in Far Madding, only Cadsuane Melaidhrin and Merise Haindehl stand higher. Among the thirty-nine Aes Sedai sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to kidnap Rand al'Thor, only Galina Casban and Sashalle Anderly are higher and Katerine Alruddin is her equal.

According to Egwene al'Vere, Nesune has an exceptional eidetic memory: she can cast a look on a page and then read it aloud, and remember conversations word by word that took place years ago. She can tell if the attention of a student wanders, even if her back is to the class. She is a naturalist, and likes to collect specimens.

Nesune is 174 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending five years as novice and four as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
enrichments.short_description: Nesune is a slender and birdlike Kandori with dark hair and nearly black eyes.

enrichments.description:
Niande Moorwyn is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Niande Moorwyn}}

She is pale-haired and plump, with a sharp nose and inquisitive gray eyes.

Niande is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Niande is 149 years old, she was born in and went to the Tower in . After thirteen years as novice and twelve as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
enrichments.short_description: Niande Moorwyn is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Niande Moorwyn}}

enrichments.description:
Nianh is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah and former advisor to Queen Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu of Kandor.

She told Queen Ethenielle that the Kandori Spire was a remnant of the Age of Legends and probably harmless.

She disappeared without a trace after news of Elaida's deposition of Siuan Sanche and her subsequent ascension to the Amyrlin Seat, either returning to Tar Valon, recognizing Elaida, or joining the Rebel Aes Sedai in Salidar.

Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Characters named after fans
enrichments.short_description: Nianh is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah and former advisor to Queen Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu of Kandor.

enrichments.description:
Niere is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

Niere is one of only three Yellow sisters who accepts Nynaeve al'Meara as a full sister before she is actually raised.
enrichments.short_description: Niere is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Nimri is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Nimri}}

She is petite, and described as "drowsy-eyed", though it is unclear whether this is a feature of her appearance or due to her being awake at a late hour.

Nimri stands high in the Aes Sedai hierarchy, being able to create a suitable gateway on her own, which implies to be above level .

She is the sister on duty at the Traveling ground during a failed assassination attempt on Egwene al'Vere. She makes a gateway for Gawyn Trakand to a hillside an hour's travel from Caemlyn.
enrichments.short_description: Nimri is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Nimri}}

enrichments.description:
Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given the common Cairhienin ending -in preceded by a distinct consonant combination.

Aloisia Nemosni, one of the oldest people alive and one of the Kin, may have been born during Nirelle's time on the Seat.

Nirelle held the position for twenty-three years until her death in . She was Suilin Escanda's successor and Ishara Nawan's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Nirelle was a strong Amyrlin, forceful and dynamic. Chosen in the belief that she would extricate the White Tower from her predecessor's foreign intrigues, she instead continued them, involving the Aes Sedai in a number of wars.
enrichments.short_description: Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given the common Cairhienin ending -in preceded by a distinct consonant combination.

enrichments.description:
Nisain a'Cowel is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is gangly with a strong chin, dark reddish hair and startlingly blue eyes. She has a lilting voice. , Nisain a'Cowel|Nisain}}.

Nisain is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Caren Endelle and Bennae Nalsad, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She has the Talent of reading weaves made of saidar; among the six rebel sisters sent to Shadar Logoth, she was the best.
enrichments.short_description: Nisain a'Cowel is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is very short (under five feet) and has an average build for her height. Neither plain nor beautiful, she has dark hair and large dark brown eyes that are her best feature.

She is considered intelligent, even by Romanda. As a Yellow, she is self-assured and thus often unwilling to step back for anyone.

Nisao is strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . She was likely chosen as a member of Egwene al'Vere's Council for this reason, although (along with Beonin Marinye) she is the weakest of that group. Nonetheless, she is the second strongest member of the Yellow we know of among the Rebel Aes Sedai, the strongest being Romanda Cassin. She has sufficient strength to Travel.

Her area of study is the healing of the mind problems and diseases.
enrichments.short_description: She is very short (under five feet) and has an average build for her height. Neither plain nor beautiful, she has dark hair and large dark brown eyes that are her best feature.
Noane held the position for twenty-three years until her death in . She was Kirin Melway's successor and Tamra Ospenya's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

enrichments.description:
She is beautiful, with large 'liquid' eyes, often vague as any Brown.

Her strength is not given in the Companion, nor are their clues as to her strength in the books.

She has few friends, perhaps none. She was almost as dreamy as Danelle and perhaps as friendless and solitary.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.
enrichments.short_description: She is beautiful, with large 'liquid' eyes, often vague as any Brown.

enrichments.description:
Notasha is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

She was injured while battling during the Battle of Tar Valon and was Healed at some stage.

She, along with two other Red sister, accompanies Katerine Alruddin when Katerine tries to replace Saerin Asnobar as the Aes Sedai in charge of the resistance within the lower levels of the White Tower.
enrichments.short_description: Notasha is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Notori was an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah, and secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She took part in the Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod and was killed by a blast of Fire created by Nynaeve al'Meara. Because she was killed in the World of Dreams, she also died in the waking world.

She was probably using a dream ter'angreal, otherwise her soul would be obliterated from the Pattern.

es:Notori Category:Dreadlords Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Notori was an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah, and secretly part of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest of the group that escaped Dumai's Wells. Therefore, it is likely that Nubei's strength level is beneath , which is Covarla's level.

An Arafellin, Nubei sedai remained loyal during the Tower split. She was sent to Cairhien to kidnap Rand and escaped Dumai's Wells with Covarla Baldene. Along her she took refuge in Dorlan.

Nubei Peldovni is described only in The Wheel of Time Companion, she is never mentioned in the main books of The Wheel of Time. enrichments.description:
Nyein has dark skin, hair, and eyes. Like other Sea Folk Aes Sedai, she doesn't wear any jewelry except for her Great Serpent ring.

Outwardly, she is a shy, withdrawn woman.

She is one of the Atha'an Miere and works in the White Tower Library, along with Aiden Shimura and Zemaille Amassa, the other Atha'an Miere Aes Sedai. They tend to stay on the upper levels of the library with the secret records.

At the time of the Dragon Reborn's birth, there were four Sea Folk Aes Sedai in the White Tower, and two of them were almost 300 years old. Nyein is one of the younger two.
enrichments.short_description: Nyein has dark skin, hair, and eyes. Like other Sea Folk Aes Sedai, she doesn't wear any jewelry except for her Great Serpent ring.

enrichments.description:
Notably, Parenia kept Sereille Bagand of the White Ajah as her Mistress of Novices, though the name of her Keeper of the Chronicles and her subsequent Ajah are unknown. Sereille served excellently in the same office also during the reigns of the two Amyrlin that preceded Parenia (a Green and a Brown respectively) becoming legendary in this role.

Parenia was the last Amyrlin elected from the Red-Yellow-Gray axis for 160 years. From this time on the Blue-White-Green axis was very politically strong - Amyrlins were elected almost exclusively from these Ajahs in alternation (except for one Brown) until Sierin Vayu and then another two Blues. The Reds could barely get even one of their allied Ajahs elected, whereas previously, more Amyrlins were raised from the Yellow or the Gray. There was no Yellow Amyrlin in nearly 300 years and no Red since Bonwhin Meraighdin until Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan.

Parenia was an Amyrlin of average strength and influence. She was more interested in negotiations and treaties between nations than in the ruling of the White Tower. She still kept fairly good control in order to gain backing for her diplomatic goals.

enrichments.description:
She guards Egwene al'Vere's cell when Seaine Herimon comes to visit her.

Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: She guards Egwene al'Vere's cell when Seaine Herimon comes to visit her.

enrichments.description:
Pevara Tazanovni is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah.

Pevara is a pretty woman with large dark, twinkling eyes, short black hair and a merry face., Pevara Tazanovni|Pevara}} She is "pleasingly plump", stout and 5'4" or 163 cm in height. Her personality is cheerful, and she has a ready smile. She does not dislike men, as many Red Sisters do; instead, her devotion to her Ajah comes from her belief that gentling male channelers is a way for her to challenge the Shadow to the best of her abilities.

Pevara has a One Power strength of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}} She is weak in Earth.

She is capable of opening a Gateway and possesses the Talent of Healing. Seaine Herimon notes she was very good at hunting down men who can channel.
enrichments.short_description: Pevara Tazanovni is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is lean and small-boned, with dark hair and brown eyes. Much like the Brown Ajah stereotype, she tends to allow her low quality clothing to fall into disrepair, with tears and stains. She might be considered pretty if not for how much she frowns.

Phaedrine is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

Although she is not strong enough to Travel, she and Shemari linked together were just strong enough to make a barely usable gateway.

She is allied with the Salidar Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: She is lean and small-boned, with dark hair and brown eyes. Much like the Brown Ajah stereotype, she tends to allow her low quality clothing to fall into disrepair, with tears and stains. She might be considered pretty…

enrichments.description:
She fought with Egwene al'Vere at the Last Battle. Her Warder and Sleete guarded the area where Egwene, Silviana Brehon, and Gawyn Trakand were fighting in one of the early battles.

Because she has a Warder who is not an Asha'man, she is not Red Ajah. It is also unlikely that she is White because few of them have Warders and probably not Yellow as well because the majority of the Ajah was in Mayene.

She is named after Pia Maria Vaajakallio, a Finnish fan who was one of a number of people involved in a competition to have a character named after them.

enrichments.short_description: She fought with Egwene al'Vere at the Last Battle. Her Warder and Sleete guarded the area where Egwene, Silviana Brehon, and Gawyn Trakand were fighting in one of the early battles.

enrichments.description:
Poleine was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around .

Elayna Sedai is raised to Amyrlin Seat while Poleine is away from the White Tower on a foreign mission

She is believed to have been close to uncovering the secret to unlocking a certain Portal Stone. She was later captured by the Black Ajah and rescued by Elayna.

Category:Characters original to the video game

enrichments.description:
She has green tilted eyes, but has only a trace of the typical Saldaean nose.

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the Aiel War when the Dragon was reborn.

She doesn't hide the fact that she dislikes teaching Novices and Accepted.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

enrichments.description:
As the Last Battle rages on the border between Kandor and Arafel, Pylar fight alongside the Amyrlin Seat, Egwene al'Vere.

Her status following the Last Battle is unknown, but she is assumed alive.

enrichments.description:
Raechin Connoral is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

She is a tall, dark-haired woman, who likes to wear her hair in a coil of braids atop her head.

Nothing is known about Raechin's strength or abilities in the One Power.

She has a sister, Viria Connoral, who is also a Sitter for the Red. With the deaths of Vandene and Adeleas Namelle, they are the sole remaining siblings in the White Tower. Being a Sitter in the Hall means that Raechin has been Aes Sedai for, at least, more than one hundred years.
enrichments.short_description: Raechin Connoral is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

enrichments.description:
Raemassa is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

She fights in Kandor during the Last Battle, accompanied by Egwene al'Vere, the Amyrlin Seat, Leane Sharif, Lelaine Akashi, Silviana Brehon, Romanda Cassin and a handful of Warders when a huge gateway splits the air and brings hundreds of Sharan channelers onto the battlefield. The Aes Sedai camp is completely routed in the attack.

Her status following this ordeal and the Last Battle is unknown, but lacking other information she is presumed alive.

Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Characters named after fans
enrichments.short_description: Raemassa is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Rafela Cindal (pronounced: rah-FELL-ah sin-DAHL) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is tall and plump and of a dark complexion. She has a round face that is normally mild and pleasant, but could be serious or even stern. Her voice is normally sweet.

Rafela is a strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of .

Merana Ambrey feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, even though she is its appointed leader. Rafela, Faeldrin Harella and Masuri Sokawa are the three strongest sisters in the group. She is strong enough to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Rafela Cindal (pronounced: rah-FELL-ah sin-DAHL) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Rahvin's Pet Aes Sedai is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who has just been recently raised to the shawl.

She is quite young with brown eyes and lacks the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

She had been planted in Andor by the White Tower ruled by Elaida a'Roihan to spy on Morgase Trakand. She was, however, betrayed by someone from the Black Ajah who told Rahvin. He used Compulsion on her to report back what he wanted the White Tower to know.

It is not known what happened to this Aes Sedai after Rand killed Rahvin and conquered Caemlyn.
enrichments.short_description: Rahvin's Pet Aes Sedai is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who has just been recently raised to the shawl.

enrichments.description:
She is tall and slender. She is seen wearing silver bells embroidered onto her white dress, perhaps suggesting she is Arafellin.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

When Alviarin Freidhen was removed as Keeper of the Chronicles, Alviarin heard Norine Dovarna address Ramesa with a scathing remark about Alviarin. Ramesa seemed to wonder why Norine was addressing her, since they were not friends.

enrichments.description:
Ramola is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah.

She takes part in the Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod and is seen standing next to Alviarin Freidhen, sending random blasts of Power away from them in order to try and draw Egwene al'Vere into a trap.

If she was with Alviarin, it is likely that she escaped and survived the battle.

Category:Dreadlords Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Ramola is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Rashima Kerenmosa (c. 1150 - ) is one of the most decorated and famous Aes Sedai since the Breaking of the World. She is considered a hero by the Green Ajah, one of their greatest and, alongside Caraighan Maconar, the symbol of all it means to be a Green sister.

Rashima was born circa , during the Trolloc Wars. She went to the White Tower around and spent five years as a novice and five years as Accepted. She was raised to the Green Ajah around . In , she became the Amyrlin Seat, the most powerful position on the continent. While all Amyrlins during the Trolloc Wars had been more martial than their peacetime counterparts, Rashima took this to new extremes. She served directly as a general and battle leader, rather than relying on advice from a Warder or general. She fought in person rather than relying on others. Rashima is credited with restoring morale to the faltering Ten Nations after the destruction of Aridhol and Manetheren, with Trolloc armies ranging as far south as Barashta on the Sea of Storms.

Rashima led the defense of Tar Valon when the Trollocs broke into the city and partially razed it circa . She began diplomatic and military overtures that led to a string of major victories for the Ten Nations over the next ten years, most notably at Kaisin Pass, the Sorelle Step, Larapelle, and Tel Norwin. Rashima's efforts culminated at the Battle of Maighande in , where the nations achieved a decisive victory over the Trollocs. Although not the final victory—tracking down and destroying all the remaining Trolloc bands would take another fifty years—it broke the back of the Shadowspawn invasion.

Rashima died during the battle, along with her five Warders. Around their bodies a wall of Trolloc and Myrddraal corpses was found, along with the bodies of no fewer than nine Dreadlords. This proves that she must have been very strong in the One Power.

enrichments.description:
Razina is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of Dumai's Wells by the Asha'man.
enrichments.short_description: Razina is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

enrichments.description:
The Red Ajah of the Aes Sedai was, for more than two thousand years, dedicated to prevent the wrong and dangerous use of the One Power. In particular the Red sisters dedicated themselves in locating men with the ability to channel saidin (the tainted and very dangerous half of the One Power) and bringing them to the White Tower for gentling.

Red sisters generally do not have friends outside of their Ajah, and upon donning the shawl are often forced to end any friendship with women not also of the Red. Until recent times they bond no Warders, and have been at odds with the Blue Ajah for a millennium. The leader of the Red Ajah is known as the Highest.

For a detailed list of all known members, see List of Red Ajah sisters

During the more than three-thousand year history of the Tower, the Red has always been the largest Ajah. From the founding up until the Trolloc Wars, the overall proportion was much larger than it is now, with between one quarter and one third of all Aes Sedai choosing the Red. During and after the Trolloc Wars, the focus of Aes Sedai as an organisation shifted from curtailing the activity of male channelers to fighting the Shadow at the Blight and the Green Ajah correspondingly began to increase in numbers to almost rival the Red in terms of numbers. Despite this, the Green has never surpassed the Red as the largest Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Reiko Kerevon is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is stout with long, dark hair in which she wears silver bells.

With a One Power strength level of , Reiko is very weak for an Aes Sedai and therefore stands very low in their hierarchy. She is the third weakest Aes Sedai we know of, with only Marris Thornhill and Daigian Moseneillin beign weaker.

Reiko is an Arafellin. She was born in and is 173 years old.
enrichments.short_description: Reiko Kerevon is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

enrichments.description:
In the present, Egwene al'Vere sends some Brown Ajah sisters to look for the example of Renala in relation to the divisions within the White Tower.

Egwene in fact considers Renala situation to have been in some way similar to the current one and wants them to look through the history of divisions, hoping that if the Aes Sedai make the connection, they might begin to see that the problems can be solved.

enrichments.description:
Rianna Andomeran is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, but also secretly a member of the Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

Rianna is black haired with a white streak above her left ear. 5'4 tall, she had a coldly arrogant face.

Rianna has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She has the ability to cause someone's blood to boil, or to make one's heart to stop, killing them. Although this Talent is closely linked with Healing, her potential Healing skills are unknown.
enrichments.short_description: Rianna Andomeran is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, but also secretly a member of the Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

enrichments.description:
Rina Hafden is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah.

She is described as being elegant despite being stocky. She has a square face and an upturned nose. She is a fierce, tenacious and determined woman, not easily daunted.

Rina has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Rina is 77 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 955 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Rina Hafden is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Rislyn was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah in a Mirror World.

Rislyn is given charge of the defenses of the White Tower in the absence of the Amyrlin Seat, much to the displeasure of Sephraem.

Category:Characters original to the video game
enrichments.short_description: Rislyn was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah in a Mirror World.

enrichments.description:
Romanda Cassin was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was one of the most powerful and influential Sitters in the Hall of the Tower, firstly before her retirement, then among the rebels and, after that, in the reunified Hall. In the past and for a long time she held the position of Ajah Head and she regained this position for a while among the rebels of her Ajah.

Romanda was handsome, with dark eyes and gray hair worn in a bun at the nape of her neck. Her face always looked set for scolding, but she had a beautiful, high-pitched voice. She had a commanding personality and projected a grandmotherly air, with a strong will.

She had a weakness for love stories, particularly The Flame, the Blade and the Heart.

At a strength level of , Romanda was very strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards and in the top rank of Aes Sedai. At the beginning of the series, she was equalled only by Lelaine Akashi, Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan, Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche and surpassed by only Cadsuane Melaidhrin, although the latter had retired.

enrichments.description:
She is tall, with brown skin and black hair.

Rosara has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Rosara was one of the sisters in Cadsuane's group in Cairhien.

When Cadsuane went to Far Madding in search of Rand, she left Rosara and other sisters to keep an eye to the situation there, under the leadership of Samitsu Tamagowa.
enrichments.short_description: She is tall, with brown skin and black hair.

enrichments.description:
Rosil is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is slender and tall, with a long neck.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she has the Talent of Healing.

We don't know her strength in the One Power, but she is put in charge of the Aes Sedai manning the Healing station in Mayene during the Last Battle, implying that she holds some high level in the Aes Sedai hierarchy and possesses a high strength in the One Power.
enrichments.short_description: Rosil is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Rubinde Acedone is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Green Ajah.

She is 5'5 tall, sturdy and has very dark hair with eyes like sapphires.

Rubinde is described as having a rebellious nature, likely a factor in being persuaded to depose Siuan Sanche and elect Elaida a'Roihan as her replacement.

She always looked ready to walk through a wall; even when she tried to smile, she looked like she was grimacing.
enrichments.short_description: Rubinde Acedone is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Ryma Galfrey was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah who is now a damane.

She is slim and elegant, with dark hair and blue eyes.

Ryma is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Ryma was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending eight years as a novice and seven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: Ryma Galfrey was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah who is now a damane.

enrichments.description:
Saerin is 5'6" tall and has olive skin and straight black hair that is graying slightly at the temples. She has a faint, faded scar on her left cheek and jaw, giving her a somewhat intimidating look. She is attractive but unlike her Brown Ajah sisters she is seen as quite fierce; scowling as well as any Warder. Saerin retains an Ebou Dari sense of honor and often carries a traditional curved dagger behind her belt, which she unconsciously fingers when angry.

Saerin has a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai., Saerin Asnobar}} Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}}

The non-canon A Fire Within the Ways has her an expert in the Ways.

She is from Altara. Saerin was born in near Ebou Dar.

enrichments.description:
Circa , Salindi is recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Salindi's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Salindi was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Salindi and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

enrichments.description:
Salita Toranes is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Yellow Ajah.

Salita is a dark-skinned Tairen, with skin "as dark as charcoal". She is plump, with a round face and cool eyes. She is about 5'4 tall.

She is known for her love of clothes, allegedly emptying her trunk every morning to find the perfect outfit, such as a yellow-slashed green dress embroidered with yellow scroll work on the bosom.

Salita is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.
enrichments.short_description: Salita Toranes is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Samalin Naerodan is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and a Sitter in the Salidar Hall., Samalin Naerodan|comp}}

Samalin is a fox-faced Murandian with a mannish stride.

Despite being sharp-faced she has a surprising sense of humour and a bright, clear laugh.

Samalin has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
enrichments.short_description: Samalin Naerodan is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and a Sitter in the Salidar Hall., Samalin Naerodan|comp}}

enrichments.description:
She is a slim, pretty, hazel-eyed Arafellin, who wears bells in her dark, braided hair.

She had a commanding, overbearing manner and could be petulant when balked.

As a Healer, Samitsu does not care if she gets bloodied or messy.

Samitsu is 144 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as a novice and four years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: She is a slim, pretty, hazel-eyed Arafellin, who wears bells in her dark, braided hair.

enrichments.description:
Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai. Sanaiye's strength must therefore be below that of Covarla ().

She was one of the Aes Sedai sent to kidnap Rand in Cairhien. She escaped with Covarla Baldene after Dumai's Wells battle and took refuge in the village of Dorlan.

This Aes Sedai is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
