enrichments.description:
Sareitha Tomares was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Sareitha was a dark Tairen with inquisitive brown eyes and a square face. She looks slightly older than Nynaeve.

Sareitha is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Sareitha was 35 years old, she was born in 965 NE and went to the White Tower in 980 NE. After ten years as Novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 998 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Sareitha Tomares was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is from Tarabon. She has dark hair that she wears in beaded braids and is 5'4" or 163 cm in height; Sarene is considered one of the most beautiful women in the Tower, but she seems totally unaware of her stunning beauty..

When Accepted together, Moiraine thinks Sarene has a sharp tongue that often gets her into hot water, and remarkably little tact, though she seems to be as unaware of what she says as she is of her beauty. Moiraine also thinks Sarene's mother must have been glad to see Sarene's sharp tongue go off to Tar Valon.

Sarene is a typical White. She insists on reasoning logically, and often does not understand matters of the heart. However, Egwene notes that she has a temper, and although she usually keeps it leashed, she can snap your nose off if you put a foot wrong. Sarene will listen to what other people have to say, and is not afraid to admit that she is wrong.

Sarene is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel., Sarene Nemdahl}}

enrichments.description:
Saroiya Farseen is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the White Ajah.

She is blocky/stocky but looks slim compared to Aledrin Malenry. She is 5'4" or 153cm tall. She has brown hair and brown eyes.,Saroiya Farseen|comp}} She has the habit of tugging her ear when in deep thought. She is extraordinarily patient. According to Romanda Cassin, when Saroiya starts grinding her teeth, most sisters would be shouting.

Saroiya is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Saroiya is 143 years old. She was born in Arad Doman in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending thirteen years as novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
enrichments.short_description: Saroiya Farseen is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the White Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She has blue eyes and curly hair, wore in ringlets to her shoulders, also a stubborn jaw. After being stilled and Healed, she has lost the ageless look and, instead, looked merely short of her middle years. She also looked prettier after losing her ageless look.

Sashalle is very strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of . Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}} After being Healed, she was restored to her full strength, although she was no longer bound by the Three Oaths.

Her name indicates that she is likely from Andor. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . She was a novice for nine years and Accepted for six. Sashalle was raised to the shawl in .

Sashalle was one of the Aes Sedai involved in Rand al'Thor's kidnapping. Along with Galina, she was the strongest in this expedition, and so they were at the top in the hierarchy when the Red Ajah took charge after diplomatic failure.
enrichments.short_description: She has blue eyes and curly hair, wore in ringlets to her shoulders, also a stubborn jaw. After being stilled and Healed, she has lost the ageless look and, instead, looked merely short of her middle years. She also…

enrichments.description:
Seaine Herimon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower., Seaine Herimon}}

Seaine is a Murandian with watery blue eyes and thick black hair and eyebrows.

Seaine is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel. Among the Black Ajah Hunters, however, she is the weakest.

Seaine is the daughter of a furniture-maker from Lugard. All her family are now long dead.
enrichments.short_description: Seaine Herimon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower., Seaine Herimon}}

enrichments.description:
Sedore Dajenna was an Aes Sedai and a loyalist Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was plump and had a round face with dark eyes and long dark hair. In Elaida’s opinion, she was one of the most arrogant of all among the sisters.

Sedore is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

When Sedore died, she was 187 years old. Born in Tear in , Sedore went to the White Tower in 829 NE. After spending nine years as a novice and seven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 845 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Sedore Dajenna was an Aes Sedai and a loyalist Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Selame Necoine was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year .

Selame held the position for fifty-five years until her death in . She was Deane Aryman's successor and Rabayn Marushta's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She failed to capitalize on Deane's earlier successes as mediator and negotiator to put an end to the Hundred Years War, and the war continued for another thirty years. Still, she was an Amyrlin of average strength.

enrichments.short_description: Selame Necoine was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year .

enrichments.description:
Seonid Traighan is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Seonid is a short (5'1 tall) and pale Cairhienin with dark hair that fell in waves to her shoulders with big, dark, bottomless eyes. While she is not particularly slender, neither is she stocky or stout. She is atypical for a Green in that she is cool and reserved, with an air of dignity and authority, with sometimes a determined smile. Her normal attitude is to be brisk, practical, businesslike and methodical.

She sometimes wears a Kesiera on her forehead, with a white fingernail-sized stone.

Seonid is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Among the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, she was equal in strength to Merana Ambrey, although there were several stronger sisters in the group.
enrichments.short_description: Seonid Traighan is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Sephraem was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around .

After the unexpected death of the Amyrlin Seat, Sephraem tried to wrestle control from Elayna Sedai, who had been the most recent Keeper of the Chronicles.

Category:Characters original to the video game
enrichments.short_description: Sephraem was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around .

enrichments.description:
Serafelle is 5'4 tall, and pretty in a plump fashion, with brown hair and large hazel eyes. Sometimes, especially when thinking, she had the physical mannerisms of a spoiled noblewoman.

She was a quick study and a fast learner—very observant, very intelligent and quick-witted.

Serafelle is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Serafelle was born in Murandy in to mid-level nobility.
enrichments.short_description: Serafelle is 5'4 tall, and pretty in a plump fashion, with brown hair and large hazel eyes. Sometimes, especially when thinking, she had the physical mannerisms of a spoiled noblewoman.

enrichments.description:
She has a pinched mouth and pinched nose, that constantly seems to be detecting a bad smell. She has light brown hair and pale blue eyes. Even her pale eyes seem pinched with disapproval. She might well have been considered pretty otherwise. She has tight, cramped handwriting.

No information is given about Serancha's strength in the One Power in either the books or the Companion. Both Sitters and Ajah Heads can be either weak or strong in the One Power, so no inferences can be made.

Serancha was born in the year and went to the White Tower in at the age of 15.

She spent seven years as novice and six as Accepted and appears to have made a few enemies. She was Accepted over both Seaine Herimon and Pevara Tazanovni. All three were later Accepted together. Pevara regards her as a prig suitable for the Gray.
enrichments.short_description: She has a pinched mouth and pinched nose, that constantly seems to be detecting a bad smell. She has light brown hair and pale blue eyes. Even her pale eyes seem pinched with disapproval. She might well have been…

enrichments.description:
Sereille Bagand was Amyrlin Seat from to .

Due to her fierce personality, morality, sternness, and severity, Sereille became one of the strongest Amyrlins in the last millenium.

Sereille had a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai.

Sereille Bagand was born in Far Madding in 586 NE, went to the Tower in 601 NE. After thirteen years as novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year at age 39, choosing the White Ajah.
enrichments.short_description: Sereille Bagand was Amyrlin Seat from to .

enrichments.description:
She was Comarra Zepava's successor and Doniella Alievin's predecessor.

She was a strong Amyrlin who increased the Tower's influence and prestige. Her skillful negotiations ended many wars and effected many treaties.

She died in Altara after negotiating the end of a civil war there. Somehow her corpse was seized by Whitecloaks who hanged it as a final affront.

Her image at the gallows decorates an alcove in the Dome of Truth in the form of fresco
enrichments.short_description: She was Comarra Zepava's successor and Doniella Alievin's predecessor.

enrichments.description:
Serinia is an Aes Sedai of an unknown Ajah.

When Jesamyn did not return from Caemlyn, Elayne Trakand sent Serinia to discover what was wrong. She returned with Captain Charlz Guybon only to tell Elayne that Caemlyn had been overrun.

Having been sent to Caemlyn probably means that Serinia is strong enough to open a gateway alone to Travel.

Category:High Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai Category:Characters named after fans
enrichments.short_description: Serinia is an Aes Sedai of an unknown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She is stately, with a touch of gray in her hair. She has hazel eyes. She wears a marriage knife set with red and white stones nestled between generous cleavage, and carries a curved belt knife in the Ebou Dari fashion.

Before burning herself out, she had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. Few would have matched her strength, and even fewer surpassed it. She was an expert in ter'angreal.

Setalle was born Martine Janata somewhere in the Borderlands in .

She went to the White Tower in . She spent five years as a novice and four years as Accepted before being raised to the shawl in .
enrichments.short_description: She is stately, with a touch of gray in her hair. She has hazel eyes. She wears a marriage knife set with red and white stones nestled between generous cleavage, and carries a curved belt knife in the Ebou Dari fashion.

enrichments.description:
Sevlana Meseau is a well-known, historical and legendary Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah who Merana thought of as impressive., Sevlana Meseau}} In fact when Bera and Kiruna find themselves confronted with Cadsuane Melaidhrin, Merana thinks that it must be like herself meeting Alind Dyfelle, Sevlana Meseau or Mabriam en Shereed.

Category:Historical people Category:Short pages Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
enrichments.short_description: Sevlana Meseau is a well-known, historical and legendary Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah who Merana thought of as impressive., Sevlana Meseau}} In fact when Bera and Kiruna find themselves confronted with Cadsuane…

enrichments.description:
She was 5'2" tall and quite stout, with copper skin. Shahal had a flirtatious streak; in fact, when she chose to flirt, men quickly forgot that she was short and stout.

Shahal is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

She was born roughly 200 years ago in Arad Doman. Nothing is known about her training, but she is likely to have been raised Aes Sedai sometime between between 835 and .

Shahal Comanli was one of the unaligned sisters in Cadsuane Melaidhrin's group in Cairhien.
enrichments.short_description: She was 5'2" tall and quite stout, with copper skin. Shahal had a flirtatious streak; in fact, when she chose to flirt, men quickly forgot that she was short and stout.

enrichments.description:
Shana Goridien is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

She has bulging eyes and reminds Elayne of a fish. She always looks startled, although she normally maintains a deep reserve.

Shana is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She matches Siuan Sanche's strength level after she was Healed for her stilling.

Although weak in the One Power, she is an expert at reading residues.
enrichments.short_description: Shana Goridien is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Shanelle is slender. She has pale blue eyes and a dark, pretty face.

Shanelle has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Although she was not particularly strong, Healing was her best Talent by far, and she had a very good ability with it.

She was born not far from Ebou Dar, although we do not know how old she is.
enrichments.short_description: Shanelle is slender. She has pale blue eyes and a dark, pretty face.

enrichments.description:
Before being raised Amyrlin Seat she had been the Captain-General of the Green Ajah.

She was the youngest Amyrlin since Deane Aryman, raised seven centuries earlier.

She was the Amyrlin Seat during the Third War of Garen's Wall. It is widely believed by historians that she completely mishandled the situation, and caused the war. It is also believed she died in the White Tower of natural causes.

However in the secret histories held in the Thirteenth Depository of the Tower Library, it has been recorded that Shein Chunla was controlled by the Hall of the Tower during this time.
enrichments.short_description: Before being raised Amyrlin Seat she had been the Captain-General of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Shemaen is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

During the Aiel War, Shemaen is told by Adelorna Bastine about Gitara Moroso's Foretelling that the Last Battle will come during the lifetime of sisters now breathing. Ellid Abareim overhears this conversation and repeats it to her fellow Accepted, Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche.
enrichments.short_description: Shemaen is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Shemari is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and a librarian.

Shemari is a vigorous, square-faced woman. She is often too proper in her behavior to the point of seeming to mock those she is greeting; she had been known to curtsy to Egwene from a hundred paces away.

She is quite weak in the One Power, needing to link with another Aes Sedai in order to weave a gateway.

She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Shemari is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and a librarian.

enrichments.description:
Shemerin is plump. She never mastered the outward calmness of the Aes Sedai and so always has a look of strained anxiety in her eyes.

She is a coward, and knows she is. Many sisters thought she was unsuitable to be Aes Sedai, even before Elaida demoted her.

Shemerin is strong in the One Power, with a level of . While there are Aes Sedai stronger in the Power, there are not many. In fact, among the Yellow Ajah we have details on, only Romanda Cassin is stronger and only Desandre Alraed is her equal.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she is regarded as a good Healer.
enrichments.short_description: Shemerin is plump. She never mastered the outward calmness of the Aes Sedai and so always has a look of strained anxiety in her eyes.

enrichments.description:
Sheraine Caminelle is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah captured by the Seanchan at Falme and renamed Mylen.

Sheraine is slender and very short, indicating that she is from Cairhien. She is a pretty little woman, 4'10 tall, pale with dark hair and eyes. She physically resembles fellow Cairhienin Moiraine Damodred.

Upon her capture by the Seanchan, she refuses to eat and becomes skin and bones. After Tuon takes her in, she becomes healthier, plumper and rounder of bosom and bottom.

When the Seanchan arrive at Falme, Sheraine and her Warder are ambushed and her Warder killed. She is made damane and renamed Mylen. She refused to cooperate with the sul'dam holding her, refusing to eat or drink, and nearly died. She was taken back to Seanchan, and Tuon bought her on the docks at Shon Kifar. All of the der'sul'dam had despaired and expected her to die, but Tuon successfully trained her. Mylen has become a perfect damane and was chosen to be one of six damane to accompany Tuon across the Aryth Ocean.
enrichments.short_description: Sheraine Caminelle is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah captured by the Seanchan at Falme and renamed Mylen.

enrichments.description:
Sheriam was also a member of the Black Ajah, although she had only joined the Shadow hoping it would advance her political standing in the Tower; nonetheless, she was ordered to steal several sleepweaver ter'angreal by Mesaana. Sheriam's true allegiances were exposed by Egwene when she learned of Verin Mathwin's decades-long project of chronicling sisters of the Black Ajah, and she was executed in the rebel camps outside Tar Valon.

Sheriam was of Saldaean heritage and displayed the typical high cheekbones and slightly tilted eyes from the region. She stood about 5'5" tall and was regarded as being slightly plump, though she had been more slender in her youth. Sheriam's most notable physical quality was her fiery red hair, which was easily notable from any distance. She also had clear pale green eyes, and a warm inviting personality.

Sheriam was considered to be very strong in the One Power by traditional Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of ., Sheriam Bayanar}}

When the Rebel Aes Sedai were gathering in Salidar, only two other sisters were as strong, Bera Harkin and Kiruna Nachiman, and none were stronger. After they were sent to the Aiel Waste to look for Rand al'Thor, this made Sheriam the strongest among them.
enrichments.short_description: Sheriam was also a member of the Black Ajah, although she had only joined the Shadow hoping it would advance her political standing in the Tower; nonetheless, she was ordered to steal several sleepweaver ter'angreal by…

enrichments.description:
She was very tall and thin, not much short of bony, with an angular face, a long chin, and a cap of curly hair. She has spidery fingers..

Shevan can be very dry at times and she frequently was.

Shevan is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Shevan was 157 years old; she was born in and went to the White Tower in . After four years as novice and six as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
enrichments.short_description: She was very tall and thin, not much short of bony, with an angular face, a long chin, and a cap of curly hair. She has spidery fingers..

enrichments.description:
Silvane Redford is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Silvane Redfor}}

Silvane is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of .

Silvane was one of the sisters in Cadsuane Melaidhrin's group in Cairhien.

When Cadsuane went to Far Madding searching for Rand, she left Silvane and other sisters to keep an eye on the situation in Cairhien, under the leadership of Samitsu Tamagowa.
enrichments.short_description: Silvane Redford is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Silvane Redfor}}

enrichments.description:
She is stocky with a square face and speaks with a gruff voice. She has her dark hair in a bun and has large eyes.

She is physically very strong; she reminds people of a strict aunt, the one who would not stand for any nonsense, but who views her nieces and nephews as a raw material to be whipped into shape as human beings. This may have been a factor in her being chosen as Mistress of Novices.

Silviana is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . After the events of The Path of Daggers, there are only four women stronger than her in the White Tower that we have details on, three of whom are also Sitters. The other is, of course, the Amyrlin Seat herself.

Silviana is 151 years old. She was born in the year 849 NE in Amadicia and went to the Tower in . After spending twelve years as novice and eleven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in the year 890 NE.
enrichments.short_description: She is stocky with a square face and speaks with a gruff voice. She has her dark hair in a bun and has large eyes.

enrichments.description:
The Stole of the Amyrlin Seat is one of the symbolic items of regalia worn by the Amyrlin Seat. It is a long strip of silk, about "a hand wide" that the Amyrlin wears over her dress, that traditionally contains seven bands of color, one for each Ajah. Robert Jordan confirmed the order of these colors for the graphic novel:}}

These colors are also repeated on the hems of the dresses of Accepted in the White Tower.

The size of the stole is a mystery. It is generally described as "broad," in contrast to the "narrow" stole of the Keeper of the Chronicles. Egwene al'Vere can store the stole in her belt pouch. Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's stole is "wide enough to cover her shoulders." Perhaps, like the width of the Keeper's stole, the width of the Amyrlin's is based at least partly on personal preference.

Just after the coup, Elaida is seen wearing the traditional seven-striped stole. However, she clearly resented the Blue Ajah and appeared in dreams wearing a six-striped stole with no blue stripe on three occasions. It is not clear when she made this a reality, but she is noted as wearing the six-striped version by Alviarin Freidhen on her return from Tremalking and by Tarna Feir after Alviarin's replacement. Around the same time, the disbanding of the Blue Ajah was first mentioned. It's possible that the declaration of war by Egwene al'Vere in Murandy towards the end of The Path of Daggers was a precipitating event that caused such an irrevocable rift that Elaida could make her dreams a reality.

enrichments.description:
This article is about the distribution of One Power strength among Third Age Aes Sedai. For a list of all strength rankings and an explanation of the numbering system, see One Power strength rankings.

The following table gives a full list of strengths of Aes Sedai according to their entries in The Wheel of Time Companion. If there are no Aes Sedai at a given level, it is not included below. Those who are in training as novices are marked with *, those who are Accepted are marked with **. The Kin are not included in this list. See Strength in the One Power among the Kin for more details. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="background-color: #dimgray;" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5" ! style="text-align:center;" | Strength Level ! style="text-align:center;" | White Tower initiates ! style="text-align:center;" | Notes

Some modification and explanations are required:

The Companion lists Cadsuane's strength as , which would be significantly stronger than Elayne/Egwene/Aviendha's potential and just below Nynaeve. Additionally, the Companion entry for Tamela calls the Wise One "the equal of Cadsuane, with a strength level of ".
enrichments.short_description: This article is about the distribution of One Power strength among Third Age Aes Sedai. For a list of all strength rankings and an explanation of the numbering system, see One Power strength rankings.

enrichments.description:
Suana Dragand is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current head of the Yellow Ajah.

She described as "beefy" with "too much chin, a square stone of it". The Companion describes her as "A beefy woman, with too much chin, blue eyes, a square face and wide square hands"., Suana Dragand|comp}}

She has an unyielding demeanor.. Alviarin thinks she is arrogant and likely to take her own views as that of her whole Ajah. She has a blunt manner.

She is also politically well-connected and very knowledgeable - a woman with a will who could get things done..
enrichments.short_description: Suana Dragand is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current head of the Yellow Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Suilin Escanda was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year .

Her name indicates that she was almost certainly from Tear.

Suilin held the position for forty-one years until her resignation in . She was Aliane Senican's successor and Nirelle Coidevwin's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Suilin was an Amyrlin of moderate strength who involved the Tower in a number of foreign intrigues.
enrichments.short_description: Suilin Escanda was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year .

enrichments.description:
In FY 450, history records that she was removed from her home kingdom by the Aes Sedai and taken to Tar Valon, where she spent many years mucking out the White Tower stables as a lesson in humility.

It is not known why this was done, although there are many theories. Some suggest that Sulmara was an Aes Sedai (maybe the last to rule openly as Queen and Aes Sedai before Elayne Trakand some 1,700 years later) who had returned home to rule her kingdom without the Amyrlin Seat's leave, although this is not considered likely. It is also suggested that Sulmara was simply a Queen who had ignored her Aes Sedai advisor's suggestions one time too many, compelling the sisters to make an example to show that even a Queen was not beyond the White Tower's power.

Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai (Free Years) Category:People of the Free Years
enrichments.short_description: In FY 450, history records that she was removed from her home kingdom by the Aes Sedai and taken to Tar Valon, where she spent many years mucking out the White Tower stables as a lesson in humility.

enrichments.description:
Takima has long black hair and skin the color of aged ivory. She is a tiny, bird-like woman and stands 5'1" or 155 cm in height., Takima Deraighdin}} However small, quiet and observant by nature, she can still be forceful if she wishes.

Takima is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Takima has a formidable memory. She remembers everything she reads. Takima could recognize one of her pupils at a hundred paces.

Takima was born in in the Mountains of Mist
enrichments.short_description: Takima has long black hair and skin the color of aged ivory. She is a tiny, bird-like woman and stands 5'1" or 155 cm in height., Takima Deraighdin}} However small, quiet and observant by nature, she can still be…

enrichments.description:
Talene Minly was an Aes Sedai and a Sitter. She belongs to the Black Ajah, posing as a sister of the Green Ajah.

She is described as being statuesque with golden hair. She has blue eyes and is beautiful, with a perfect oval face, full red lips, full-bosomed and round of hip. Seaine thought of her as "beauty carved from ice", though this thought came at a time of tension. Talene could be very personable and charming, though she hated deferring to anyone or to be less than another in any way whatsoever.

Talene has a One Power strength of , which is strong for an Aes Sedai.

While she is strong enough to Travel, there is no way she would have been able to learn the weave.
enrichments.short_description: Talene Minly was an Aes Sedai and a Sitter. She belongs to the Black Ajah, posing as a sister of the Green Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Talva was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also part of the Black Ajah.

She is thin, and wears her golden hair in a bun.

Talva is among the Black sisters who flee the White Tower before the Black Ajah hunters can question them.

While eavesdropping on Egwene al'Vere, Nynaeve al'Meara and Elayne Trakand in Tel'aran'rhiod, Talva unknowingly sets off one of Egwene's wards. She begins to weave Fire at Egwene when the Amyrlin comes to investigate, but is too slow, and Egwene shields her and binds her in flows of Air instead.
enrichments.short_description: Talva was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also part of the Black Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She was described as having long hair streaked with gray as well as a square face.

Tamra was of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is further evidence that strength is not always a factor when it comes to appointed positions.

She was thought to be fair and always just. She also seemed to be a devious manipulator.

She was raised to Amyrlin Seat from the Blue Ajah in . Her raising to the staff and stole was rumored to be the reason for the retirement of Romanda Cassin and Marith Jaen.
enrichments.short_description: She was described as having long hair streaked with gray as well as a square face.

enrichments.description:
Tarna is from Altara and has pale, yellow hair, sharp, blue eyes, and a prominent chin. She is said to be humorless, arrogant, and haughty.

Tarna is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size and is trusted enough by Elaida to be among the first sisters taught the weave.

She was born in the year 950 NE in the north of Altara near the Andoran border. She was a Wilder who touched saidar about as early as is possible for a girl to do so, but had developed a block that made her unable to touch the Source unless she had her eyes closed.

In , at the age of fourteen, she became a novice in the White Tower. Galina Casban helped her overcome that by beating her until she overcame her block. This was technically illegal, but the Mistress of Novices at the time kept silent about it. At this time, this would likely have been Merean Redhill. Both Merean and Galina were fairly highly ranking sisters of the Black Ajah. After spending nine years as novice and six as Accepted, Tarna was raised to the shawl in the year 979 NE.
enrichments.short_description: Tarna is from Altara and has pale, yellow hair, sharp, blue eyes, and a prominent chin. She is said to be humorless, arrogant, and haughty.

enrichments.description:
Teire Alentaine is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Teire has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Teire was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien. After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan along with other sisters under the leadership of Covarla Baldene.

After Elaida learned of the failure from Dumai's Wells, she ordered the sisters to remain in Dorlan and sent Narenwin Barda to take command of the group.
enrichments.short_description: Teire Alentaine is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Temaile Kinderode was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

She was a fox-faced Cairhienin with very big blue eyes and shoulder-length dark hair. She was 5'2" (158 cm) in height and appeared fragile, like a pretty child.

Despite her innocent appearance, she was a complete sadist and enjoyed hurting people physically and emotionally.

Temaile has a One Power strength of . This is relatively strong for an Aes Sedai.
enrichments.short_description: Temaile Kinderode was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

enrichments.description:
Teramina is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Teramina|Teramina}}

She has been an Aes Sedai for years and is very weak in the One Power.

She disappears from the White Tower after Egwene al'Vere becomes Amyrlin Seat and asks all Aes Sedai to re-swear the Three Oaths on the Oath Rod. This would put strong suspicion on her being Black Ajah.

Egwene thought Teramina might have been posing Mesaana, but she had been in the White Tower for years.
enrichments.short_description: Teramina is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Teramina|Teramina}}

enrichments.description:
Tesan is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is an arithmetist who applies numbers to logic.

She has the typical beaded braids of a Taraboner. Her hair is dark and she has a narrow face.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the Schism.

In the White Tower, Alviarin Freidhen hears her discussing statistical methods relating to the failing of the Keepings on the food storerooms in the Tower with Astrelle.
enrichments.short_description: Tesan is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is an arithmetist who applies numbers to logic.

enrichments.description:
Tesien Jorhald was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

Her name indicates that she was likely from Tarabon as no other names ending in "hald" are from anywhere else (see Geofram Bornhald, Aludra Nendenhald, Androl Genhald, Tazenia Nerenhald).

In traditional Red Ajah custom, she forced Pevara Tazanovni to give up being friends with Seaine Herimon once Pevara was raised to the shawl. This may indicate she was Highest of the Red Ajah at the time, but not necessarily so.

Category:High Ranking Aes Sedai Category:Channelers Category:Aes Sedai
enrichments.short_description: Tesien Jorhald was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
Teslyn has bony fingers. No one had ever thought her beautiful. She is scrawny, with narrow shoulders, a gaunt face, and a narrow nose. She has dark brown eyes and thin lips. After her time as a damane, she fleshed out a bit.

Teslyn has a One Power strength of . This is above average strength for an Aes Sedai and strong enough to be able to Travel. Joline Maza calls Tesyln "inexorable" and unlikely to defer to anyone that did not have a significant advantage over her.

Teslyn possesses a decent ability at Healing, although not as good as Joline.

Teslyn is 130 years old, she was born in Illian in . She went to the White Tower in and spent seven years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised in .
enrichments.short_description: Teslyn has bony fingers. No one had ever thought her beautiful. She is scrawny, with narrow shoulders, a gaunt face, and a narrow nose. She has dark brown eyes and thin lips. After her time as a damane, she fleshed out…

enrichments.description:
Records regarding the appearance of Tetsuan are scant. Scraps of history imply that she was "plain" in her appearance though exceptionally strong in her ability to channel. Records indicate that until the arrival of Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan at the White Tower, Tetsuan was considered an exceptional novice and the strongest channeler of her era; possessing strength greater than all other Aes Sedai of the time and was exceeded only by the legendary Aes Sedai Caraighan Maconar who had died nearly 700 years previous. Tetsuan's absolute strength in the power is unknown, but given that she was less powerful than both Caraighan Maconar (who was rated as on the power strength scale, Caraighan Maconar}} ) and Eldrene (strength unknown but also exceeded by Caraighan Maconar), it is reasonable to assume Tetsuan's strength to be between and .

Due to the loss of knowledge that accompanied the destruction of records during the Trolloc Wars, very little of Tetsuan's history is known to loremasters. Her region of birth and her surname have both been forgotten.

What is known about her is that she arrived at the White Tower as a novice circa AB 1105 during the middle years of the Trolloc Wars. For a short time Tetsuan was regarded as the strongest potential channeler of her era. This prestige ended with the arrival of fellow novice Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan of Manetheren.

White Tower records imply that Tetsuan and Eldrene quickly emerged as adversaries and that Tetsuan developed an adolescent jealousy of Eldrene's overwhelming beauty and greater strength in the power. Specific details of their animosity are unknown, though it is believed that because she had a "plain" appearance, Tetsuan bent all of her time towards her studies in an effort to become more prestigious than Eldrene but was never quite able to surpass her rival. Both were raised to full Aes Sedai circa AB 1115, with Tetsuan choosing the Red Ajah. Soon after receiving her shawl, Eldrene departed the White Tower and returned to Manetheren, eventually marrying and bonding King Aemon al Caar al Thorin many years later and becoming his queen. Tetsuan is believed to have remained in the tower.

enrichments.description:
Theodrin is apple cheeked, willowy and graceful, with a swanlike neck and coppery skin. Her mouth looks as if she wants to smile. Though Domani, she dresses modestly.

Her personality is good-natured. She is kind and patient.

Theodrin is strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards with a potential strength of . Egwene al'Vere compared her and Faolain Orande's strength with that of Amys and Melaine, grouping tham all as "far from weak". Due to her being a Wilder with a Block, it's possible she is taking longer to reach her full potential.

She is able to use the weave to open a gateway to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: Theodrin is apple cheeked, willowy and graceful, with a swanlike neck and coppery skin. Her mouth looks as if she wants to smile. Though Domani, she dresses modestly.

enrichments.description:
Therva Maresis is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She has a long nose. She is slim, and has yellow-slashed riding skirts and a cloak edged in yellow.

She is excitable by nature, and it was considered a bad sign if she ever looked calm and serene.

Therva is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.
enrichments.short_description: Therva Maresis is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

enrichments.description:
She is short and slight, with large brown eyes and a dimple in each cheek. Despite her ageless look she has an unfortunately youthful appearance due to her bone structure and large brown eyes. She usually wears dark gray skirts.

When she is displeased, her disgruntled expression deepened her dimple and makes her look sulky, which she doesn't realize.

Tiana is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability a the Talent, she should be able to Travel.
enrichments.short_description: She is short and slight, with large brown eyes and a dimple in each cheek. Despite her ageless look she has an unfortunately youthful appearance due to her bone structure and large brown eyes. She usually wears dark…

enrichments.description:
She is described as short and slightly plump with smooth copper skin, dark eyes, and long glossy dark hair. She was attractive, with a nice mouth and eyes, but not beautiful. She is from Saldaea.

Toveine has a sharp gaze that could bore into anything; she could cut one's heart out in front of you, but is not particularly cruel except when it comes to men who could channel, because she hates them deeply. It is not only because she is a Red sister but because she considered all of them responsible for her hard punishment.

She does not like men at all, preferring pretty young men in their mid to late teens, young enough to be eager and grateful and easy to control. This gets her into trouble during her exile. The notion of any sort of sexual relationship with an adult male made her skin crawl.

Toveine is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .
enrichments.short_description: She is described as short and slightly plump with smooth copper skin, dark eyes, and long glossy dark hair. She was attractive, with a nice mouth and eyes, but not beautiful. She is from Saldaea.

enrichments.description:
Tsutama Rath (pronounced: tsue-TAH-ma RATH) is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current Highest of the Red Ajah.

Tsutama is strikingly beautiful, with black luxuriant hair and a full bosom. She would have been considered even more beautiful except that she wears a permanently angry expression that almost overwhelms her agelessness.

She often wears all crimson, so bright that it might have given the most ardent Red pause, and cut tightly, molding her breasts or exposing them as if daring anyone to comment.

She tends to wear lots of jewelry and she is flamboyant and given to indulging herself with luxury and rare and expensive items. It is unclear whether this is how she has always been or this is a result of spending so many years working on a farm with only her basic needs fulfilled.
enrichments.short_description: Tsutama Rath (pronounced: tsue-TAH-ma RATH) is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current Highest of the Red Ajah.

enrichments.description:
She had straight white hair which fell to her waist. She had a strong face with dark tilted eyes and a hooked nose. She had a memorable deep voice.

Her appearance suggests she may have been Saldaean. This is, however, never confirmed.

Given her white hair, she is likely to have been well over 200 years old at the time of her death. This would place her as having enrolled in the White Tower around the time of Gitara Moroso and several of the Knitting Circle.

She died forty years ago, when Beonin was still Accepted.
enrichments.short_description: She had straight white hair which fell to her waist. She had a strong face with dark tilted eyes and a hooked nose. She had a memorable deep voice.

enrichments.description:
Turanna is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of Dumai's Wells by the Asha'man.
enrichments.short_description: Turanna is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

enrichments.description:
Valene is new to the shawl, so she lacks the ageless look of the Aes Sedai.

Valene has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She was born in 972 NE and went to the White Tower in 988 NE. She was a novice for five years and Accepted for six. She was raised in 999 NE.

Since Valene lacks the ageless look, she was chosen for the expedition to Cairhien.
enrichments.short_description: Valene is new to the shawl, so she lacks the ageless look of the Aes Sedai.

enrichments.description:
Valera Gorovni was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Valera Gorovni}}

She was short, little and plump, always wearing a smile. She seemed to be bustling even while standing still.

Valera has a strength in the One Power of . She is very strong for an Aes Sedai. Less than a dozen Aes Sedai are known to have been stronger than her at the time of her death.

She was born in the year . Her name may indicate she is Kandori.
enrichments.short_description: Valera Gorovni was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Valera Gorovni}}

enrichments.description:
Valinde is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of . She was by far the weakest among the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn and the only one unable to Travel without linking with another Aes Sedai.

We have no history for Valinde except that she was born in Illian and that she does not have a Warder. No date of birth or training times were included in the Companion for this character, the only member of the Embassy about which we have no such details.

She has joined the Salidar Aes Sedai and was a part of the embassy sent from Salidar to Rand al'Thor in Caemlyn. While in Caemlyn, she stays at an inn called The Crown of Roses.

According to Min, she was very eager to have Rand drive Sammael out of Illian. Min believes that a promise from Rand to try would have convinced Valinde to swear fealty to him - though Melaine scoffed at that idea.
enrichments.short_description: Valinde is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of . She was by far the weakest among the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn and the only one unable to Travel without linking with another Aes Sedai.

enrichments.description:
She is described as being slender and graceful with a straight back and almost white hair, with fine bones and a long patrician face.

Though Adeleas was two years older, the two sisters looked so much alike that they seemed like twins. Many people had difficulty telling Adeleas and Vandene apart, even though they were from different Ajahs. They themselves could not understand the confusion.

Vandene has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She is not strong enough to open a gateway to Travel unaided.

Her potential, given to be , is higher than her actual stength. We are told that women like Vandene and Adeleas who are very close can have similar strengths even if their potentials are different. The tendency would be for the stronger woman to not achieve her full potential as it is impossible for the weaker to exceed their potential. Adeleas only has a strength and potential of , making Vandene still the marginally stronger of the two. Vandene's life span, however, would have been dictated by her potential, not her actual strength.
enrichments.short_description: She is described as being slender and graceful with a straight back and almost white hair, with fine bones and a long patrician face.

enrichments.description:
Vayella is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Vayelle is 86 years old and has been Aes Sedai for 44. She was born in 914 NE and went to the White Tower in . After spending thirteen years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 956 NE.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.
enrichments.short_description: Vayella is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

enrichments.description:
She has a nose like an eagle's beak and sharp, tilted eyes. She has sharp high cheekbones and a penetrating stare from her eyes that are almost black.

Her voice is almost girlishly high-pitched. Her appearance is fierce. Her plain snowy dress appears stark and cold.

Elaida thinks she is normally the most self-possessed woman in the Tower and the model of a White sister.

Velina is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.
enrichments.short_description: She has a nose like an eagle's beak and sharp, tilted eyes. She has sharp high cheekbones and a penetrating stare from her eyes that are almost black.

enrichments.description:
Viria has dark hair that is braided and coiled atop her head. It is unknown whether she and Raechin are identical twins.

Nothing is known about Viria's strength and abilities in the One Power.

She has a sister, Raechin Connoral, who is also a Sitter for the Red. With the deaths of Vandene and Adeleas Namelle, they are the sole remaining siblings in the White Tower. Being a Sitter in the Hall means that Viria has been Aes Sedai for, at least, more than one hundred years.

Viria became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. Egwene al'Vere considers her an odd choice for the position, but not unexpected.
enrichments.short_description: Viria has dark hair that is braided and coiled atop her head. It is unknown whether she and Raechin are identical twins.

enrichments.description:
Yukiri Haruna is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower., Yukiri Haruna|Yukiri}} During the White Tower Schism, Yukiri voted to depose Siuan Sanche and replace her with Elaida a'Roihan, although she soon came to regret the decision in light of Elaida's growing incompetence.

Yukiri and a group of other Sitters formed the Black Ajah Hunters after Elaida grew deeply suspicious of Alviarin Freidhen, and were able to independently confirm the existence of the Black Ajah. She eventually began to work with Egwene al'Vere when she was held in the White Tower and reduced to a novice, and remains one of most senior sisters in the Tower.

Yukiri has green eyes and a small frame and is described as 5 feet tall, slight and slender. Egwene al'Vere thinks she is one of the shortest women she has ever met.

Despite her lack of height, she manages to comport herself as regally as any Queen. When frustrated, however, she can relapse into the farmer's accent of her youth. During negotiations and mediations she has been known to use her native accent as a way to unbalance the other parties as the contrast can leave them confused.

enrichments.description:
Zemaille is one of the Atha'an Miere and is tall and slim with a very dark complexion, straight black hair and black tattoos on her slender, graceful hands. She moved very gracefully, almost as if dancing, but seemed shy and reserved.

Zemaille is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Like all of the sisters raised from the Atha'an Miere, this is below average for an Aes Sedai, although in Zemaille's case, not significantly so. Alviarin calls her "weak", but this is not infitting with other strength descriptors.

Zemaille is 69 years old. She was born in the year ; she went to the Tower in claiming she was eighteen. After spending ten years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 980 NE.

Zenare is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She was not present when Nynaeve al'Meara Healed both Leane Sharif and Siuan Sanche from stilling and insisted on her going through the whole process again step by step and even tries to give advice on how to improve it.

Zerah Dacan is a Mayener Aes Sedai of the White Ajah., Zerah Dacan}}

Zerah is 5'5½" tall, and slim. She has black shoulder-length hair and large blue eyes. She is cool and self-possessed and moves gracefully.

Zerah is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

A live-action adaptation of the novels was originally planned as early as 2000, but was not formally announced until 28 April 2016. Production began in Fall 2019, and had to pause multiple times due to COVID-19, and wrapped in May 2021. Ahead of its premiere, it was renewed for a second season in May 2021.

Initially the series focuses on Moiraine as its protagonist as she searches for the Dragon Reborn.

entities.name: Nisain a'Cowel
entities.description:
Nisain a'Cowel is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is gangly with a strong chin, dark reddish hair and startlingly blue eyes. She has a lilting voice. , Nisain a'Cowel|Nisain}}.

Nisain is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Caren Endelle and Bennae Nalsad, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She has the Talent of reading weaves made of saidar; among the six rebel sisters sent to Shadar Logoth, she was the best.

entities.description:
Rubinde Acedone is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Green Ajah.

She is 5'5 tall, sturdy and has very dark hair with eyes like sapphires.

Rubinde is described as having a rebellious nature, likely a factor in being persuaded to depose Siuan Sanche and elect Elaida a'Roihan as her replacement.

She always looked ready to walk through a wall; even when she tried to smile, she looked like she was grimacing.

entities.name: Adrielle
entities.description:
She is tall and beautiful., Adrielle|Adrielle}} She is taller than Mezar Kurin, the Asha'man she is bonded to..

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was one of fifty-one sisters sent to destroy the Black Tower. They were, however, all captured and bonded by the Asha'man. Adrielle is bonded to Mezar Kurin. She has become quite friendly with Kurin even though she was bonded against her will.

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Toveine, at Alviarin's suggestion .

entities.description:
Aelidas is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

After Mazrim Taim declared himself as a False Dragon, Aelidas was selected as the head of the mission to capture and gentle him. Unbeknownst to her, the Black Ajah severely infiltrated the Red's delegation, and tried to use the opportunity to free Taim in the name of the Shadow.

entities.name: Aes Sedai advisors
entities.description:
The White Tower is known for keeping its hand in the politics of all nations in an effort to maintain peace, but also as a means of control. One way they can do this is to assign Aes Sedai advisors to monarchs great and small. While common, few nations publicly acknowledge the fact they have such an influence within court. The following is a list of known Aes Sedai advisors to the nations of the Westlands.

Altara: Cavandra to Queen Tylin Quintara Mitsobar and her father before her. As Altara was deemed a minor throne, her power was limited. She was one of the Aes Sedai loyal to the White Tower and returned there on the orders of Elaida. Joline Maza and Teslyn Baradon were sent as emmisaries to the Tarasin Palace, but were not formally the advisors of Queen Tylin. Likewise, Merilille Ceandevin was sent by the rebel faction, mainly because Salidar was on Altaran soil, but with the role of ambassador rather than a permanent advisor.

Amadicia: No advisors as Aes Sedai are outlawed here.

Andor: Ballair, to Queen Ishara Casalain and first ruler after the fall of Hawkwing's Empire to publicly have an Aes Sedai advisor.

entities.name: Aes Sedai symbol
entities.description:
The Aes Sedai symbol is a round black-and white disc. The two colours are divided by a sinuous line in the middle. It has long been associated with the Aes Sedai of the Age of Legends. It's a graphical representation of the philosophical understanding of the duality of life; active-passive, male-female, material-immaterial which underpinned the culture of the Age of Legends. , Old Tongue}} In the Third Age, it has been split into the white Flame of Tar Valon; some said it stood for the Light, and the black Dragon's Fang representing the evil.

Lews Therin Telamon had this symbol sewn to his cloak.

It was carved to the keystone of the stone arch of the opening to the Eye of the World.

The Seven Seals of the Dark One's prison were made of cuendillar and decorated with the symbol.

entities.description:
Afara is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

After the White Tower Schism, she joined the Rebel Aes Sedai.

Sheriam Bayanar and the Salidar Six send Afara, Edesina Azzedin and Guisin to Tarabon as emissaries of the Rebel faction.

All three were captured by the Seanchan and made damane. Afara was left behind in Tanchico when Edesina and Guisin were taken to Ebou Dar.

entities.name: Lelaine Akashi
entities.description:
Lelaine Akashi is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She is currently First Selector of the Blue and one of its Sitters in the Hall of the Tower.

Lelaine is tall, slender and quite pretty, with a warm smile that transforms her face, although she does not smile often. She is dignified, has dark penetrating almond shaped eyes, and full lips. Despite her age her hair has not sign of gray.

Lelaine is has a strength level of in the One Power, putting her at the very top tier of Aes Sedai in terms of strength. She was one of only four women mentioned by Cadsuane Melaidhrin in New Spring as being the on par with Moiraine Damodred, and Cadsuane predicted that these five would be at the top of the hierarchy once she, Kerene Nagashi and Meilyn Arganya were dead. Within a year of this prediction, Lelaine would have been the strongest Aes Sedai in the Tower.

Due to a number of deaths between New Spring and the end of A Memory of Light, she is now the fourth strongest living Aes Sedai, behind Nynaeve al'Meara, Elayne Trakand and Cadsuane Melaidhrin with a large gap between herself and Cadsuane.

entities.description:
Eleyan al'Landerin was an ancient Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Eleyan al'Landerin}}

There is a statue of her and her Warders in the southwestern side of Tar Valon, in the same place she sacrificed herself with her Warders to stop and repel Artur Hawkwing's army at the beginning of the nineteen-year-long siege to the city.

Her name indicates that she was from the Two Rivers region of Farashelle.

The name of this character comes from the name of a Tarvalon.net member.

entities.name: Teire Alentaine
entities.description:
Teire Alentaine is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Teire has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Teire was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien. After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan along with other sisters under the leadership of Covarla Baldene.

After Elaida learned of the failure from Dumai's Wells, she ordered the sisters to remain in Dorlan and sent Narenwin Barda to take command of the group.

entities.name: Doniella Alievin
entities.description:
Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien.

Doniella held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Serenia Latar's successor and Aliane Senican's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Doniella was a quiet Amyrlin, not particularly strong, but not in the control of the Hall, either; her benign neglect did leave the Hall pretty much in control of the Tower.

Doniella quite voluntarily resigned as Amyrlin in order to spend more time on her loved studies. She spent the next thirty-one years studying happily, however she was not allowed to return to the Tower and was strongly discouraged from letting anyone know that she had been the Amyrlin Seat.

entities.name: Dumera Alman
entities.description:
Circa , Dumera is recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Dumera's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Dumera was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Dumera and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

entities.description:
She is willowy, with brown hair and large brown eyes. She wears her Great Serpent ring on her right hand.

Desandre is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the Black Tower, with only Lemai being as strong.

Assuming she enrolled between the age of 14 and 18, the earliest she could have been born was 947 NE and latest was 958 NE.

She spent six years as novice and seven as Accepted.

entities.name: Katerine Alruddin
entities.description:
She had very long, dark hair, hard eyes, and a sharp face. She is vulpine with a mass of raven hair.

Katerine is strong enough to not need to defer to many Aes Sedai (see below). Her unwillingness to defer to others, however, can be extended to those few that are above her in her hierarchy. She has to "stamp out a spark of anger" when Galina Casban, her own Ajah Head, teases her and tries to avoid deferring to Saerin Asnobar, a Sitter. Both are only marginally stronger than her, but this highlights a personality flaw that chafes at being submitting to anyone's authority. Katerine's own point of view highlights that her respect towards Galina is less than what is due. She later questions Silviana Brehon's orders with regards Egwene. Although they are of equal strength, Silviana is her superior in training times and age and has absolute authority over the treatment of novices as Mistress of Novices. Katerine also snaps at Narenwin Barda, indicating a lack of respect for those weaker than her. In summary, she has a generally bad attitude towards everyone.

Like many sisters, Katerine has a contempt for Wilders.

Katerine is strong in the One Power with a strength level of . Verin considers her "far from weak".

entities.name: Doesine Alwain
entities.description:
Doesine was elegant, and tall for a Cairhienin. She was pale, slender, and somewhat boyish. Her large, dark eyes seemed even darker because of her paleness. Though pretty, she looked like a mischievous boy. Her eyes often seemed naughty.

She has a One Power strength level of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. Among the Black Ajah Hunters, however, only Seaine Herimon was weaker.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she has the Talent of Healing.

Doesine was 133 year old when she died. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . She was born with the spark, and was found by an Aes Sedai very shortly after she had first touched the Source. Doesine didn't believe what she had done, and didn't want to go to the Tower; she went unwillingly, bound hand and foot, and gagged. She would often tell this story to novices, to show them their circumstances weren't as bad as hers.

entities.description:
Zemaille is one of the Atha'an Miere and is tall and slim with a very dark complexion, straight black hair and black tattoos on her slender, graceful hands. She moved very gracefully, almost as if dancing, but seemed shy and reserved.

Zemaille is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Like all of the sisters raised from the Atha'an Miere, this is below average for an Aes Sedai, although in Zemaille's case, not significantly so. Alviarin calls her "weak", but this is not infitting with other strength descriptors.

Zemaille is 69 years old. She was born in the year ; she went to the Tower in claiming she was eighteen. After spending ten years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 980 NE.

entities.name: Lemai Ambani
entities.description:
Lemai spent six years as novice and eight as Accepted. She remained loyal to the White Tower during the White Tower schism.

Lemai is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the Black Tower, with only Desandre Alraed being as strong. In the hierarchy, Lemai is slightly behind Desandre, being referred to her as "second" to her. This is because she spent longer in training.

She was one of Toveine Gazal's group of fifty-one sisters sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to destroy the Black Tower. They were all captured and bonded involuntarily by the Asha'man. In particular Lemai was bonded by Morly Hardlin.

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Lemai, at Alviarin Freidhen's suggestion.

Merana is on the slim side of a medium build, with dark hair and hazel eyes. She is about 5'4 tall.

Merana is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of .

She is above the stated minimum strength to be able to Travel.

entities.name: Saraline Amerano
entities.description:
Circa , Saraline is recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Saraline's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Saraline was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Saraline and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

entities.description:
Amylia has pale hair and startling blue eyes. She is described as "bosomy".

She tends to wear bronze coloured skirts.

Amylia's strength in the One Power is not given in the Companion, although it is mentioned that she cannot Travel. It is unlikely, however, that she has access to anyone who could have taught her the weave.

Amylia's age and training isn't mentioned in the Companion, although she is described as having the Ageless look look, so she has been Aes Sedai at least five years. Given a minimum expected training time and average age of enrollment, she is likely at least 30 years old, likely much older.

entities.name: Amyrlin Seat
entities.description:
The Amyrlin Seat is the leader of the Aes Sedai in the White Tower in Tar Valon. Her full title is "Watcher of the Seals. The Flame of Tar Valon. The Amyrlin Seat," but she is usually just referred to as the Amyrlin. The word "Amyrlin" is a corruption of the name of an artifact in the Age of Legends called the Ring of Tamyrlin.

The Amyrlin is chosen by the Hall of the Tower for life, and forsakes her former Ajah to be seen as "from all Ajahs and yet of none", symbolized by her stole striped with all seven Ajah colors. The position can only be held by female channelers, and presumably only one who belongs to the White Tower. Interestingly, Tower law considers the Amyrlin to be Aes Sedai after having been raised, but does not require it as a prerequisite for raising - a fact that was exploited in the raising of Egwene al'Vere, who was only Accepted at the time.

The Amyrlin is the supreme authority among the Aes Sedai, who formally refer to her as "Mother" and she to them as "daughter" or "child" for Accepted and novices. She is widely recognized as one of the most powerful women in the Westlands, though she can be deposed for malfeasance by the Sitters of the Hall. This is referred to as being "stripped of stole and staff" and has only happened four times in recorded history. The Amyrlin is assisted in her duties by the Keeper of the Chronicles, who is second in command and traditionally sits in on most audiences.

The title "Watcher of the Seals" means holder and protector of the seven seals on the Dark One's prison. A secret kept from the rest of the world is that no Amyrlin Seat had known where any of the seals were since the Trolloc Wars.

entities.description:
She is stately, with a touch of gray in her hair. She has hazel eyes. She wears a marriage knife set with red and white stones nestled between generous cleavage, and carries a curved belt knife in the Ebou Dari fashion.

Before burning herself out, she had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. Few would have matched her strength, and even fewer surpassed it. She was an expert in ter'angreal.

Setalle was born Martine Janata somewhere in the Borderlands in .

She went to the White Tower in . She spent five years as a novice and four years as Accepted before being raised to the shawl in .

entities.description:
Ananda was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah., Ananda}}

She was slender with waist-length black hair.

Ananda was killed during the fighting when Siuan Sanche was deposed.

When Min Farshaw arrives to Tar Valon to inform the Amyrlin about the Dragon Reborn, she sees Ananda with two other Aes Sedai whose names are not mentioned and she sees "A sickly brown halo, shriveled and split by rotting fissures that fell in and widenend as they decayed." around Ananda and some other pictures around the other two and she knows that they are going to die. All on the same day. "Blood and skull and halo faded away in the dance of images around the three, came and faded again." (fulfilled) .

entities.description:
She has blue eyes and curly hair, wore in ringlets to her shoulders, also a stubborn jaw. After being stilled and Healed, she has lost the ageless look and, instead, looked merely short of her middle years. She also looked prettier after losing her ageless look.

Sashalle is very strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of . Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}} After being Healed, she was restored to her full strength, although she was no longer bound by the Three Oaths.

Her name indicates that she is likely from Andor. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . She was a novice for nine years and Accepted for six. Sashalle was raised to the shawl in .

Sashalle was one of the Aes Sedai involved in Rand al'Thor's kidnapping. Along with Galina, she was the strongest in this expedition, and so they were at the top in the hierarchy when the Red Ajah took charge after diplomatic failure.

Rianna Andomeran is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, but also secretly a member of the Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

Rianna is black haired with a white streak above her left ear. 5'4 tall, she had a coldly arrogant face.

Rianna has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She has the ability to cause someone's blood to boil, or to make one's heart to stop, killing them. Although this Talent is closely linked with Healing, her potential Healing skills are unknown.

entities.description:
The entry for Duhara Basaheen also mentions that she was Keeper under Sierin from 979 NE to 984 NE and indeed was depicted as so in the New Spring novel., Duhara Basaheen}} These years correspond to the years listed as the tenure of Sierin Vayu, so this has been raised as a possible inconsistency with Angharad ever having held the position.

One possible solution to this inconsistency comes from the fact that Duhara was discovered to have been involved in the pogrom of male channelers known as The Vileness and that she recieved penance for it., Duhara Basaheen}} It is also known that Sierin had "intended to crush" the Vileness, which makes it seem like she knew of its existence, but not necessarily who was involved or the exact nature of their involvement., The Vileness}} She certainly did not know enough to carry out what her successor did, namely publically whip and subsequently exile all three Red Sitters. Given unconfirmed suspicions, Angharad could feasibly have been a replacement for Duhara in while she was pending further investigation, a move that requires ratification by law of the Hall of the Tower. This very public change in sentiment against the Red Ajah could have provoked them to act swiftly, putting in motion events that would culminate in Sierin's murder later that year.

entities.description:
Her hair was greying, her face grave, and she loved to wear a lot of jewellery, especially necklaces and rings.

She was a Sitter for the Blue Ajah when Moiraine Damodred was raised Aes Sedai in .

It may be assumed that Anlee died at some point after the end of the Aiel War, as she is not mentioned in the main series, and such a prominent Blue would surely have been mentioned in Salidar, had she for some reason stepped down from her position. Being a Sitter means that she was also a senior sister. She may have died of old age; she may have gone into retirement; she may have been one of the sisters killed during "The Vileness". She may also have been the Blue Sitter who was killed during the White Tower schism.

The Kavarthen Wars occurred during her tenure.

Balladare is regarded as a weak Amyrlin and died in .

entities.name: Deane Aryman
entities.description:
Deane Aryman ( - 1084) is credited as one of the greatest Amyrlin Seats in Aes Sedai history. Apart from her numerous achievements, she is also the longest ruling known Amyrlin Seat, having ruled for ninety-two years, from to 1084. At the time of her raising, she had also been the youngest woman in history to be Amyrlin.

She was born in or around FY 920 in the village of Salidar in what was then the kingdom of Shiota. She made her way to Tar Valon in FY 934 and became Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah after spending five years as a novice and four as Accepted.

In FY 992 Aryman discovered damning evidence proving that the incumbent Amyrlin Seat, Bonwhin Meraighdin, had manipulated nations into attacking Artur Hawkwing after he allegedly embarrassed her by saving Tar Valon from destruction by the followers of the false Dragon Guaire Amalasan during the War of the Second Dragon. Those actions, and her subsequent manipulations of Hawkwing as he ruled as High King, were to blame for Hawkwing's siege of the city beginning in , endangering the existence of the sisterhood. Aryman accused Bonwhin of negligence, incompetence, and being unfit to hold the staff and shawl. Bonwhin was deposed and stilled, sentenced to muck out the Tower's stables until she died a few years later. Deane Aryman was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in Bonwhin's place. At the time of her selection she was the youngest woman who had ever been raised Amyrlin.

Aryman's attempts to make peace with Hawkwing, even offering him a Healing that could have saved his life as he lay dying, were rebuffed. After his death in , Aryman negotiated with General Souran Maravaile, commander of the besieging forces, and also with his lover Ishara Casalain, the daughter of the Imperial Governor of the province of Andor. The outcome of these discussions was Maravaile lifting the siege and attaching the remnants of his army to Ishara's, who was crowned Queen of Andor. Andor and Tar Valon immediately signed a treaty of friendship that was to last for more than a thousand years. These were immense diplomatic successes, cementing Aryman's position as Amyrlin.

Ashmanaille is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is lanky with dark hair and brown eyes. She has a narrow face and a pointed nose. Her slender build makes her appear more tall than she really is.

She has a detached nature, seldom showing any emotion at all.

She thinks about clothes as much as anything else, and her clothes are always neat and of a high quality.

She is attractive but unlike her Brown Ajah sisters she is seen as quite fierce; scowling as well as any Warder. Saerin retains an Ebou Dari sense of honor and often carries a traditional curved dagger behind her belt, which she unconsciously fingers when angry.

Saerin has a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai., Saerin Asnobar}} Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}}

The non-canon A Fire Within the Ways has her an expert in the Ways.

She is from Altara. Saerin was born in near Ebou Dar.

Edesina is handsome and slender, with waist-length black hair.

Edesina is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Given she is Yellow Ajah, she would have an above average ability at Healing.

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the Aiel War when the Dragon was reborn. Accepted Edesina asks Alanna and Pritalle to loan her stockings in preparation for the bounty collection.

entities.description:
Sereille Bagand was Amyrlin Seat from to .

Due to her fierce personality, morality, sternness, and severity, Sereille became one of the strongest Amyrlins in the last millenium.

Sereille had a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai.

Sereille Bagand was born in Far Madding in 586 NE, went to the Tower in 601 NE. After thirteen years as novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year at age 39, choosing the White Ajah.

She has been Aes Sedai as long as Elaida a'Roihan had been alive. She is strong enough to Travel . She was born in and went to the Tower in . She spent nine years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised in 950 NE.

She returned to the White Tower from the debacle of Dumai's Wells in the early hours of the morning to give Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan the bad news that Rand al'Thor had escaped.

She stands highest among the twelve sisters that initially returned back to Tar Valon. Elaida has her and her group stay away from the White Tower to hide her secrets and stay in the village of Dorlan.

During the War of the Hundred Years, Ishara of Andor sent her eldest daughter to study in the White Tower. For her show of support of the Tower, she was granted Ballair as an advisor.
