entities.name: Jenare Balmaen
entities.description:
Jenare Balmaen is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Jenare Balmaen}}

She is pale and sturdy. She has a pale, square face.

Jenare is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was a part of the group of fifty-one sisters, led by Toveine Gazal, sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to take out the Black Tower. Jenare was part of the group of ten sisters led by Toviene herself when they were both shielded and captured and bonded by the Asha'man. Jenare was bonded by Welyn Kajima, a fact for which she blamed Toveine.

entities.name: Jala Bandevin
entities.description:
She is around five feet tall. Moiraine, at 5'2" (157 cm), is "nearly a hand taller".

The ending of her surname suggests a Cairhienin origin.

Due to her already having gray hair at the time of the Aiel War, she likely to have been born before .

At this time, she had two Warders, one was a round-faced man playing a stately melody on a flute, the other a pale-haired young man no more than twenty. It is unknown if those Warders are still alive by .

entities.name: Teslyn Baradon
entities.description:
Teslyn has bony fingers. No one had ever thought her beautiful. She is scrawny, with narrow shoulders, a gaunt face, and a narrow nose. She has dark brown eyes and thin lips. After her time as a damane, she fleshed out a bit.

Teslyn has a One Power strength of . This is above average strength for an Aes Sedai and strong enough to be able to Travel. Joline Maza calls Tesyln "inexorable" and unlikely to defer to anyone that did not have a significant advantage over her.

Teslyn possesses a decent ability at Healing, although not as good as Joline.

Teslyn is 130 years old, she was born in Illian in . She went to the White Tower in and spent seven years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised in .

entities.name: Barashelle
entities.description:
She is commonly portrayed as a hero, and lover to her Warder, Anselan, but Birgitte reveals that really she was an Accepted who bonded a Warder before she was raised to Aes Sedai. As punishment her time as Accepted was prolonged three more years, despite the need of new Aes Sedai in the Trolloc Wars time, and also she was forced to pass the bond to another Aes Sedai. Once she was raised, she was finally forced to bond Anselan, a stubborn much older man than her previous Warder, chosen personally for her by the Amyrlin Seat.

The presumed love story of Barashelle and Anselan is detailed in a famous book: The Flame, the Blade and the Heart. Category:Historical people Category:Aes Sedai after the Breaking Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

entities.name: Barasine
entities.description:
We have no information on where Barasine stands with respect to the One Power hierarchy except that she stands lower than Katerine Alruddin. Since Katerine is very strong in the Power, her level is , this does not give us much information,

As many Reds, Barasine holds a dim view of Wilders.

Barasine was one of the sisters, along with Javindhra Doraille, who Logain Ablar says promised him support if he declared himself as the Dragon Reborn. He says that she talked a great deal. These accounts were intended to discredit the Red Ajah, although it is unstated if they were misrepresented truths (in the Aes Sedai fashion) or outright fabrications.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

entities.name: Narenwin Barda
entities.description:
Narenwin Barda is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is thin, very short and with a square face. She usually is so quiet that people could forget she was there; she was also mousy around other sisters.

Nerenwin is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of " or "., Narenwhin Barda}} The lower possible strength matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability a the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

Being a Yellow sister also usually indicates a skill in Healing.

entities.short_description: Narenwin Barda is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

entities.name: Duhara Basaheen
entities.description:
Duhara Basaheen was an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Red Ajah., Duhara Basaheen}} For a time she also held the position of Keeper of the Chronicles. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah. She became a Dreadlord before the Last Battle.

Duhara was tall, slim and beautiful with big dark eyes, full lips, long slender neck and the typical Domani coppery skin, but there was a meanness about her. She had worn, on both occasions we have met her, red skirts so dark they almost seemed black, although slashed with bright red.

She moved gracefully, but stood almost rigidly straight. She looked at everyone as if she were wondering what wrongdoing they had been up to. Basically she was meaner than a snake, though only her mouth gave any outward hint.

Even the mention of male channelers made her angry. In TWoTC it is stated that during the execution portion of male channelers pogrom, Duhara participated eagerly, but her involvement was discovered and she received a stiff penance (because this Vileness happened mostly during the reign of the Amyrlin Sierin Vayu and Duhara was her Keeper of the Chronicles, it has still to be explained how Duhara was able to participate so eagerly, and so far from the White Tower.)

entities.name: Adelorna Bastine
entities.description:
Adelorna Bastine is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah, and secretly the head of her Ajah, referred to as the Captain-General. She has two Warders, one of whom is named Talric.

She is short and slim, but wears an aura of confidence around her giving her natural authority, making it easy to ignore her short figure. She is around the same height as Egwene. She has dark hair and blue, slanted eyes.

Adelorna has a strength in the One Power of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. She can Travel.

Adelorna was born in the year in Saldaea.

entities.name: Sheriam Bayanar
entities.description:
Sheriam was also a member of the Black Ajah, although she had only joined the Shadow hoping it would advance her political standing in the Tower; nonetheless, she was ordered to steal several sleepweaver ter'angreal by Mesaana. Sheriam's true allegiances were exposed by Egwene when she learned of Verin Mathwin's decades-long project of chronicling sisters of the Black Ajah, and she was executed in the rebel camps outside Tar Valon.

Sheriam was of Saldaean heritage and displayed the typical high cheekbones and slightly tilted eyes from the region. She stood about 5'5" tall and was regarded as being slightly plump, though she had been more slender in her youth. Sheriam's most notable physical quality was her fiery red hair, which was easily notable from any distance. She also had clear pale green eyes, and a warm inviting personality.

Sheriam was considered to be very strong in the One Power by traditional Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of ., Sheriam Bayanar}}

When the Rebel Aes Sedai were gathering in Salidar, only two other sisters were as strong, Bera Harkin and Kiruna Nachiman, and none were stronger. After they were sent to the Aiel Waste to look for Rand al'Thor, this made Sheriam the strongest among them.

entities.name: Velina Behar
entities.description:
She has a nose like an eagle's beak and sharp, tilted eyes. She has sharp high cheekbones and a penetrating stare from her eyes that are almost black.

Her voice is almost girlishly high-pitched. Her appearance is fierce. Her plain snowy dress appears stark and cold.

Elaida thinks she is normally the most self-possessed woman in the Tower and the model of a White sister.

Velina is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

entities.name: Beldemaine
entities.description:
Beldemaine is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is plump with silver bells in her hair.

Beldemaine is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

As she is Yellow Ajah, we can assume she has an above average ability with Healing for an Aes Sedai.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Beldemaine is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

entities.name: Myrelle Berengari
entities.description:
Myrelle Berengari (pronounced: my-REHL beh-renh-GAH-ree) is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Myrelle Berengari}}

Myrelle is described as darkly beautiful with an oval face and smooth, olive skin. She has large, dark eyes and dark hair. She is about 5'4 tall.

She is impatient and has a particularly fiery temper, even among the Greens. She often wears a knowing smile.

Myrelle is strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of . Among the Salidar Six, she is equalled by Morvrin Thakanos, Anaiya Carel and Carlinya Sorevin. Sheriam Bayanar is slightly stronger, and Beonin Marinye slightly weaker.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Myrelle Berengari (pronounced: my-REHL beh-renh-GAH-ree) is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Myrelle Berengari}}

entities.name: Felaana Bevaine
entities.description:
Felaana is slim with yellow hair and a raspy voice. Egwene thinks that her hair gleams as if she brushes it several times a day.

Felaana is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

While Moiraine Damodred is out searching for the Dragon Reborn she meets up with several Aes Sedai in Kandor, Felaana being one among them. Felaana thinks she is a Wilder rather than an Aes Sedai who has not reached the ageless look yet and tries to convice Moiraine to come to the White Tower.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

entities.name: Bharatine
entities.description:
Bharatine is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. She allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai during the split.

Bharatine is thin, yet graceful, with a long nose. Though thin as a rail, she manages to look elegant.

Bharatine is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of ., Bharatine|Bharatine}}

She was born in and went to the White Tower in at the age of 15. She spent nine years as a novice and seven years as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in .
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Bharatine is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. She allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai during the split.

entities.name: Falion Bhoda
entities.description:
Falion Bhoda was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, who was also Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters and became a Dreadlord of the Shadow before the Last Battle.

Falion was a cold, long-faced Kandori with dark, glossy hair. She stands 5'5 tall.

She was willing to use the Power to torture anyone, even to death, but was dispassionate about it. She only cared whether they gave her the answers she wanted.

Falion was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . While she is strong enough to be able to Travel, it's not certain she would have had the opporunity to learn from any Black Sister we know can Travel.

entities.short_description: Falion Bhoda was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah, who was also Black Ajah. She was part of Liandrin's group of Black sisters and became a Dreadlord of the Shadow before the Last Battle.

entities.name: Nesune Bihara
entities.description:
Nesune is a slender and birdlike Kandori with dark hair and nearly black eyes.

She is strong in the One Power with a strength of . In the group of Aes Sedai that arrived in Far Madding, only Cadsuane Melaidhrin and Merise Haindehl stand higher. Among the thirty-nine Aes Sedai sent by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to kidnap Rand al'Thor, only Galina Casban and Sashalle Anderly are higher and Katerine Alruddin is her equal.

According to Egwene al'Vere, Nesune has an exceptional eidetic memory: she can cast a look on a page and then read it aloud, and remember conversations word by word that took place years ago. She can tell if the attention of a student wanders, even if her back is to the class. She is a naturalist, and likes to collect specimens.

Nesune is 174 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending five years as novice and four as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .

entities.short_description: Nesune is a slender and birdlike Kandori with dark hair and nearly black eyes.

entities.name: Jesse Bilal
entities.description:
Jesse is 5' 11" tall and wiry, resembling a sparrow, but she is much stronger physically than she looks. Her hair is grey with a little black, her eyes are small and dark., Jesse Bilal}}

She has a habit of tilting her head to one side when she is studying something in front of her, and a habit of tapping two or three fingers on her lips while thinking. She is very intent on whatever she focused on; some people think she focused so intently as not to notice other things around her, but they are mistaken.

She is a very forceful woman, especially for a Brown.

Jesse has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

entities.name: Black Ajah Hunters
entities.description:
The Black Ajah Hunters were a group of independent Sitters of five Ajahs in the Hall of the Tower under Elaida a'Roihan during the White Tower Schism. They came together more by happenstance than by actual teamwork, partially due to the animosity between the Ajahs, but teamed up in a joint effort to hunt down the Black Ajah.

The Black Ajah Hunters were the following Sitters:

Upon discovering that her Keeper of the Chronicles, Alviarin Freidhen, was definitely chipping away her power and possibly plotting against her, Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan, a Red Sitter who had pulled down and stilled the former Amyrlin Seat, Siuan Sanche of the Blue Ajah, and taken her place as Amyrlin Seat, considered the time right to start looking for proof of Alviarin's treachery. She ordered a Sitter from the White Ajah, Seaine Herimon, to search for evidence of treachery "as high as needed be," hinting at the Keeper. Seaine assumed this meant to search for the Black Ajah.

To help her in this dangerous task, Seaine enlisted the help of her former friend and fellow Sitter, Pevara Tazanovni of the Red Ajah. It was not only her friendship with Pevara that made Seaine ask for her help; all of Tazanovni's family had been murdered by Darkfriends. Seaine therefore thought her suitable for the task at hand.

entities.name: Black Oaths
entities.description:
The Black Oaths are the oaths that are sworn on the Oath Rod by the Black Ajah after they use it to un-swear their original Three Oaths as Aes Sedai. The Oaths are as follows:

These Oaths make it effectively impossible for someone to betray the Black Ajah. Even though Sheriam Bayanar only joined the Black Ajah hoping it would advance her political career, these oaths forced her to steal the dreamer ter'angreal after Mesaana ordered her to do so.

However, the Black Ajah Hunters were able to force Talene Minly into confessing by making her forswear all oaths that bound her on the Oath Rod, and then having her re-swear the Three Oaths.

Verin Mathwin also found a loophole to circumvent the third Oath by poisoning herself and revealing the secrets of the Black Ajah to Egwene al'Vere as she was dying, as the Oath forbids her from betrayal until the hour of her death, rather than the very moment of death.
entities.short_description: The Black Oaths are the oaths that are sworn on the Oath Rod by the Black Ajah after they use it to un-swear their original Three Oaths as Aes Sedai. The Oaths are as follows:

entities.name: Black Tower Alliance
entities.description:
The Black Tower Alliance is an alliance between the Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere and the Black Tower.

It began when the Rebel Aes Sedai traveled to Shadar Logoth and discovered strong residue weaves, stronger than a circle could protect against. Escaralde suggest that the only way to increase a circle past thirteen is to include male channelers. Moria Karentanis then makes an official suggestion to seek out the Black Tower in order to gain use of the Asha'man's aid.

The sitting was called by Moria Karentanis, Malind Nachenin, and Escaralde with the pretense of questioning a band of sisters who were sent to Shadar Logoth to survey the area where a beacon of saidar had been felt. (Unknown at the time, this beacon was the Cleansing of saidin.)

The five sisters who were sent are the strongest of the Rebel Tower at reading residues. They are Akarrin, Therva Maresis, Reiko, and two others unnamed. Akarrin, the strongest in the One Power amongst the five, leads the group, and testifies that they found a crater that appears to be all that remains of Shadar Logoth. She defers to Reiko, the strongest at reading residues to describe what she observed.

entities.short_description: The Black Tower Alliance is an alliance between the Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere and the Black Tower.

entities.name: Blue Ajah
entities.description:
The Blue Ajah of the Aes Sedai normally involve themselves with righteous causes and justice. They have the most extensive eyes-and-ears network, and enjoy the prestige of having the highest number of Amyrlin Seats raised from their Ajah in the last millennium.

The Blue has been at odds with the Red Ajah for a millennium and for a time were separate from the White Tower altogether. The head of the Blue Ajah is called the First Selector.

Another typical characteristic of the Blue Sisters is that they often become embroiled in intrigue. In the eyes of other Aes Sedai they are incorrigible schemers. At least in recent history, the Blue Ajah has been at the centre of the political landscape within the Tower, to a far greater degree than might be expected for their small size. This can be further seen by the fact they have the largest network of Eyes-and-ears of all the Ajahs.

While they are not as fond of men as the Green Sisters, the Blue Sisters do not avoid males as some of the other Ajahs, notably the Red and White, seem to. Alanna Mosvani of the Green Ajah comments that a Blue sister likes men as long as they share her causes and do not get in her way.

entities.name: Erian Boroleos
entities.description:
Erian is pale and lovely. She has dark hair and brown eyes, and is beautiful. She is short and slender, and her pale face is like an exquisite oval.

Erian is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

Erian is from Illian and is 49 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending seven years as a novice and five years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 978 NE. She had four Warders, but two of them were killed by Rand al'Thor. The other two are named Rashan and Bartol. Galina Casban, the Highest of the Red Ajah, became infatuated with Erian., Galina Casban}}

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split. She is part of the White Tower embassy that makes an alliance with the Shaido.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Erian is pale and lovely. She has dark hair and brown eyes, and is beautiful. She is short and slender, and her pale face is like an exquisite oval.

entities.name: Gabrelle Brawley
entities.description:
Gabrelle has brown hair, barely touching her shoulders, with large green eyes and an upturned nose. She has a dusky complexion, and is around 5'5" tall., Gabrelle Brawley}}

She attempts to seduce and win over Logain as an atypical Brown with a sense of pragmatism.

Gabrelle is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability at the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She has an ability in Healing. She heals Logain's wounds during the Last Battle.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Silviana Brehon
entities.description:
She is stocky with a square face and speaks with a gruff voice. She has her dark hair in a bun and has large eyes.

She is physically very strong; she reminds people of a strict aunt, the one who would not stand for any nonsense, but who views her nieces and nephews as a raw material to be whipped into shape as human beings. This may have been a factor in her being chosen as Mistress of Novices.

Silviana is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . After the events of The Path of Daggers, there are only four women stronger than her in the White Tower that we have details on, three of whom are also Sitters. The other is, of course, the Amyrlin Seat herself.

Silviana is 151 years old. She was born in the year 849 NE in Amadicia and went to the Tower in . After spending twelve years as novice and eleven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in the year 890 NE.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: She is stocky with a square face and speaks with a gruff voice. She has her dark hair in a bun and has large eyes.

entities.name: Brendas
entities.description:
She is pale with cool, dark eyes, and a voice like chimes. She never shows any emotion and speaks in a level tone.

Brendas has a One Power strength level of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. This is strong enough to be able to Travel. She is the second strongest of the White Ajah among the Rebel Aes Sedai of which we have information, only Carlinya Sorevin being stronger and Bernaile Gelbarn her equal.

Brendas is 54 years old. She was born in and went to the Tower in . After twelve years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 985 NE.

She was an Accepted during the Aiel War. She and Temaile were on duty attending Tamra Ospenya, the Amyrlin Seat, and Gitara Moroso, her Keeper, before Moiraine and Siuan’s shift on the day Gitara has her Foretelling.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: She is pale with cool, dark eyes, and a voice like chimes. She never shows any emotion and speaks in a level tone.

entities.name: Brown Ajah
entities.description:
The Brown Ajah of the Aes Sedai is devoted to knowledge and the collection of ancient wisdom. They generally forsake the mundane world, instead dedicating themselves to history and study, and are responsible for the administration of the White Tower Library. The Brown Ajah is run by a ruling council, the head of which is called First Chair.}}

The Brown is the fourth-largest Ajah, behind the Gray and before the Yellow with roughly one hundred and thirty sisters before the White Tower Schism. It has a low concentration of Black sisters with about twenty-eight, but we have only learned the identity of five.

The breakdown of the nationality of named Brown Ajah sisters in recent history is as follows:

One sister, Martine Janata, is labelled as "Borderlander" without further information. All Aes Sedai from the Atha'an Miere are Brown Ajah and this is likely not coincidence.

entities.name: Joiya Byir
entities.description:
Joiya Byir was a Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and a member of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

Joiya appeared to be a handsome woman, with a friendly, motherly face, dark gray eyes and dark hair.

Joiya is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . She was the weakest among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters.

Joiya was 171 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

entities.name: Mitsora Caal
entities.description:
Circa , Mitsora was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Mitsora's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Mitsora was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Mitsora and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

entities.name: Jeaine Caide
entities.description:
Jeaine had the appearance of a typical Domani, with coppery skin and a swan neck. She had dark brown eyes.

She detested men, and chose Green partly so she could beguile and control them. Yet, she was not attracted to women.

Jeane is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel. We can assume that all Black Ajah that took part in the Last Battle were taught the weave.

Jeaine was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and six years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

entities.name: Naorisa Cambral
entities.description:
Naorisa Cambral is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Nothing is known about Naorisa's strength or abilities in the One Power. , Naorisa Cambral}}

She is elected as a Sitter in the Rebel Hall to replace Delana Mosalaine. She reswears the Three Oaths on the Oath Rod and proves that she is not Black Ajah. She is then part of the unanimous vote to attack the White Tower with their army.

After the reunification, she and Kwamesa Taramasu (the other Gray Sitter elected in the Rebel Hall) were no longer Sitters. Varilin Zanaire and Yukiri Haruna resumed the seats they had before the split with the seat formerly held by the Darkfriend sister Evanellein Lorn, being taken by Andaya Forae who was appointed by the Head Clerk of the Gray Ajah, Serancha Colvine.

entities.name: Sheraine Caminelle
entities.description:
Sheraine Caminelle is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah captured by the Seanchan at Falme and renamed Mylen.

Sheraine is slender and very short, indicating that she is from Cairhien. She is a pretty little woman, 4'10 tall, pale with dark hair and eyes. She physically resembles fellow Cairhienin Moiraine Damodred.

Upon her capture by the Seanchan, she refuses to eat and becomes skin and bones. After Tuon takes her in, she becomes healthier, plumper and rounder of bosom and bottom.

When the Seanchan arrive at Falme, Sheraine and her Warder are ambushed and her Warder killed. She is made damane and renamed Mylen. She refused to cooperate with the sul'dam holding her, refusing to eat or drink, and nearly died. She was taken back to Seanchan, and Tuon bought her on the docks at Shon Kifar. All of the der'sul'dam had despaired and expected her to die, but Tuon successfully trained her. Mylen has become a perfect damane and was chosen to be one of six damane to accompany Tuon across the Aryth Ocean.

entities.name: Adine Canford
entities.description:
Adine Canford is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

Adine is a plump Andoran with blue eyes and short black hair.

Adine is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing. Moiraine describes her as "not very strong in the Power".

Adine is 95 years old. She was born in and she went to the White Tower in 920 NE. After spending twelve years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

entities.name: Anaiya Carel
entities.description:
Anaiya Carel (pronounced: ah-NYE-yah) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Anaiya Carel|Anaiya}} Evidence suggests that she was at one time the Blue Ajah First Selector.

Anaiya stood about 5'6" tall and was dark haired with a homely 'blunt face'. She had a warm smile. According to Moiraine, "almost everyone felt comforted, safe and special, when Anaiya smiled at them". Anaiya enjoyed beautiful clothing and had a fondness for wearing lace and ruffles.

She was astute politically and a first-rate organizer. Likely this was one of the reasons she was included among the Salidar Six. Moiraine calls her open, honest, and "accepting of everyone" while still able to see into the heart of the matter. She was not a flighty woman. Instead, she was deliberate, unflappable, and careful with her words.

She is kind towards children. When in Fal Dara, she ruffles the heads of playing boys as she passes. She is less formal than many Aes Sedai in other ways, asking Amalisa Jagad to call her by her first name only, while asking permission to call her merely "Amalisa". Egwene thinks that she is "different from the others, more like a woman from home".

entities.name: Carenna
entities.description:
Carenna is an Aes Sedai of an unknown Ajah. She allied herself with the rebels in Salidar. Therefore, she is not Red Ajah.

She went to the White Tower at age seventeen; spent thirteen years as a novice and eleven as Accepted; and was raised Aes Sedai at forty one. It can be said that twenty four years of training mean that Carenna is not particularly strong, in fact usually the period in training reflects the strength of an Aes Sedai (if other factors are not involved, such as stubbornness, periods of rebellion, immaturity, blocks) and twenty four years is the period of training of sisters at a low level in the hierarchy.

When Nynaeve passes off a trick for eavesdropping using the One Power learned from Moghedien as her own discovery, Carenna picks it up with suspicious quickness. Nynaeave thinks that she, as an Accepted, can hardly accuse Carenna of having used such a trick before her 'discovery'.

Carenna says that she thinks the weave can be used to communicate with other sisters over long distances (two or more miles away). This adaptation of the eavesdropping weave has not yet been seen, if it was successful. Though, the Wheel of Time Companion says that with inverted weaves, this communication would have been very secure. Category:Rebel Aes Sedai Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

entities.name: Galina Casban
entities.description:
Galina Casban was an Aes Sedai and former Highest, or leader, of the Red Ajah. She was also of the Black Ajah. Believed dead by the White Tower, she is now the permanent personal gai'shain to Therava of the Shaido Aiel.

Galina has long black hair and a pretty round face with hard eyes.

Galina Casban was a member of the Red Ajah. Her reputation for cruelty made her one of the most feared Aes Sedai. She has very little, if any, guilt over her actions or for the people that she hurts or kills as she is convinced that it is all for the greater good.

Ironically despite her strong belief in her own superiority, Galina was shown to have an almost cowardly side to her as she tended to try and avoid physical combat whenever possible.

entities.name: Romanda Cassin
entities.description:
Romanda Cassin was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was one of the most powerful and influential Sitters in the Hall of the Tower, firstly before her retirement, then among the rebels and, after that, in the reunified Hall. In the past and for a long time she held the position of Ajah Head and she regained this position for a while among the rebels of her Ajah.

Romanda was handsome, with dark eyes and gray hair worn in a bun at the nape of her neck. Her face always looked set for scolding, but she had a beautiful, high-pitched voice. She had a commanding personality and projected a grandmotherly air, with a strong will.

She had a weakness for love stories, particularly The Flame, the Blade and the Heart.

At a strength level of , Romanda was very strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards and in the top rank of Aes Sedai. At the beginning of the series, she was equalled only by Lelaine Akashi, Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan, Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche and surpassed by only Cadsuane Melaidhrin, although the latter had retired.

entities.name: Cavandra
entities.description:
Tylin comments that "Aes Sedai never tell a word more than they absolutely must", marking Elayne Trakand and Nynaeve al'Meara as exceptions to that rule. Surprisingly, she also says that she could also talk with Cavandra in the same way, indicating a more relaxed relationship between ruler and advisor.

Cavandra has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

She was Tylin Quintara Mitsobar's advisor before leaving her to go back to the White Tower after the new Amyrlin Elaida summoned her. Cavandra had been advisor also to Tylin's father when he was king of Altara.

The Companion says she "had limited influence, since she had been advisor to a minor throne for so long". It's unclear if this means that her influence was less because the throne was minor, or it was greater because of her longevity in the position.

entities.description:
Merilille Ceandevin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is a short and slender Cairhienin with glossy black hair and large liquid dark eyes. She is pale skinned and elegant.

Merilille has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She is not able to Travel. She is noted as having to rely on the help of Reanne Corly to open a gateway, a fact which irked her.

She went to the Tower in 845 NE at the age of 18, relatively late for a novice.

entities.description:
Cerist was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah in a Mirror World.

Cerist was captured by the Children of the Light, and was later rescued by Elayna Sedai.

entities.name: Shein Chunla
entities.description:
Before being raised Amyrlin Seat she had been the Captain-General of the Green Ajah.

She was the youngest Amyrlin since Deane Aryman, raised seven centuries earlier.

She was the Amyrlin Seat during the Third War of Garen's Wall. It is widely believed by historians that she completely mishandled the situation, and caused the war. It is also believed she died in the White Tower of natural causes.

However in the secret histories held in the Thirteenth Depository of the Tower Library, it has been recorded that Shein Chunla was controlled by the Hall of the Tower during this time.

entities.name: Rafela Cindal
entities.description:
Rafela Cindal (pronounced: rah-FELL-ah sin-DAHL) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is tall and plump and of a dark complexion. She has a round face that is normally mild and pleasant, but could be serious or even stern. Her voice is normally sweet.

Rafela is a strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of .

Merana Ambrey feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, even though she is its appointed leader. Rafela, Faeldrin Harella and Masuri Sokawa are the three strongest sisters in the group. She is strong enough to Travel.

entities.name: Jennet Cobb
entities.description:
Jennet Cobb is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Jennet Cobb}}

She is 5' 4 1/2" or 164 cm tall, with dark red hair flowing down her back, and green eyes. She is not beautiful, but most men would think her pretty except that her manner is reserved. Not cool, but private and very self-contained.

Despite this outward appearance, she has a considerable temper. She learned to control it during her time as a novice, although it was not easy for her. It could flare, however, especially over what she perceived as injustice.

Jennet is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

entities.name: Nirelle Coidevwin
entities.description:
Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given the common Cairhienin ending -in preceded by a distinct consonant combination.

Aloisia Nemosni, one of the oldest people alive and one of the Kin, may have been born during Nirelle's time on the Seat.

Nirelle held the position for twenty-three years until her death in . She was Suilin Escanda's successor and Ishara Nawan's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Nirelle was a strong Amyrlin, forceful and dynamic. Chosen in the belief that she would extricate the White Tower from her predecessor's foreign intrigues, she instead continued them, involving the Aes Sedai in a number of wars.

entities.description:
Coladara was born in Tear sometime between 925 and .

She was an Accepted in the White Tower during the final days of the Aiel War in .

At some point prior to , she was made advisor to King Paitar Nachiman of Arafel. They appear to have a close relationship. She is very fond of him.

When the White Tower split, she sided with neither Elaida nor the Rebels.

entities.description:
Lusonia Cole is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Lusonia Cole}}

Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest of the group that escaped Dumai's Wells. Therefore, it is likely that Lusonia's strength level is beneath , which is Covarla's level.

Lusonia was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

After kidnapping him and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan. Her room there is displaced with the arrival of Tarna Feir.

entities.name: Serancha Colvine
entities.description:
She has a pinched mouth and pinched nose, that constantly seems to be detecting a bad smell. She has light brown hair and pale blue eyes. Even her pale eyes seem pinched with disapproval. She might well have been considered pretty otherwise. She has tight, cramped handwriting.

No information is given about Serancha's strength in the One Power in either the books or the Companion. Both Sitters and Ajah Heads can be either weak or strong in the One Power, so no inferences can be made.

Serancha was born in the year and went to the White Tower in at the age of 15.

She spent seven years as novice and six as Accepted and appears to have made a few enemies. She was Accepted over both Seaine Herimon and Pevara Tazanovni. All three were later Accepted together. Pevara regards her as a prig suitable for the Gray.

entities.name: Shahal Comanli
entities.description:
She was 5'2" tall and quite stout, with copper skin. Shahal had a flirtatious streak; in fact, when she chose to flirt, men quickly forgot that she was short and stout.

Shahal is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

She was born roughly 200 years ago in Arad Doman. Nothing is known about her training, but she is likely to have been raised Aes Sedai sometime between between 835 and .

Shahal Comanli was one of the unaligned sisters in Cadsuane Melaidhrin's group in Cairhien.

entities.description:
Akarrin Comeris is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah, who has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She is slim, with quick eyes. She has a plain brown wool dress, and a cloak with surprisingly elaborate green embroidery. She nodded for emphasis with almost every other word.

Akarrin is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . Egwene thinks that "Akarrin was not strong in the Power, little more than Siuan if at all". In fact, this is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Akarrin is 199 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After eleven years as a novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 837 NE.

entities.name: Concentration technique
entities.description:
The concentration technique (sometimes called "the trick") is used by Aes Sedai and Asha'man. This technique allows the person to not feel the surrounding temperature.

The concentration technique is done by breathing and focusing inwards. As explained by Natasia to Moiraine Damodred, one's "mind must be as still as an unruffled pond throughout." She goes on the explain that one must focus on a point behind ones' navel and breathe at an unvaried pace, but not as normal breathing. Each inhalation, exhalation and the spaces between must take exactly the same length of time. This breath and focus causes the mind to become detached from the outer world, acknowledging neither heat nor cold. A person using this technique could travel through a blizzard or across a desert and not shiver or sweat. While the person would not feel the heat or cold, sunburns and frostbite would still occur after a time. As Natasia explained, "only the mind is truly distanced, the body much less so."

Upon gaining the shawl, new Aes Sedai are taught this technique. Asha'man are also taught the technique, originally by Mazrim Taim, but it is unknown from where he learned it. Taim was the person who taught Rand al'Thor the technique.

Min tried to learn the trick, but was not able to. Supposedly, the trick is not related to channeling ability; but no known non-channeler can perform it. It is possible that the concentration required to channel helps channelers master it.
entities.short_description: The concentration technique (sometimes called "the trick") is used by Aes Sedai and Asha'man. This technique allows the person to not feel the surrounding temperature.

entities.name: Raechin Connoral
entities.description:
Raechin Connoral is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

She is a tall, dark-haired woman, who likes to wear her hair in a coil of braids atop her head.

Nothing is known about Raechin's strength or abilities in the One Power.

She has a sister, Viria Connoral, who is also a Sitter for the Red. With the deaths of Vandene and Adeleas Namelle, they are the sole remaining siblings in the White Tower. Being a Sitter in the Hall means that Raechin has been Aes Sedai for, at least, more than one hundred years.

entities.short_description: Raechin Connoral is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

entities.name: Viria Connoral
entities.description:
Viria has dark hair that is braided and coiled atop her head. It is unknown whether she and Raechin are identical twins.

Nothing is known about Viria's strength and abilities in the One Power.

She has a sister, Raechin Connoral, who is also a Sitter for the Red. With the deaths of Vandene and Adeleas Namelle, they are the sole remaining siblings in the White Tower. Being a Sitter in the Hall means that Viria has been Aes Sedai for, at least, more than one hundred years.

Viria became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. Egwene al'Vere considers her an odd choice for the position, but not unexpected.

entities.name: Myriam Copan
entities.description:
When she was raised in she was considered a weak Amyrlin. However, after she returned from a seemingly self-imposed retreat in 758 NE she seemed a new woman. She was then a strong Amyrlin, considered one of the strongest the White Tower has ever had. She was considered a successful Amyrlin with Egwene al'Vere stating centuries later that she wants to be just like Myriam.

The true story, however, is not widely known. This "retreat" was actually a kidnapping by a fifty-three year old Cadsuane Melaidhrin. Cadsuane captured her with the intent to make her a stronger Amyrlin. Over the two months she had her captured, she toughened the Amyrlin through many methods, including physical ones. When she returned, she deflected the accusations by implying that Cadsuane did nothing of the sort.

Myriam held the position for forty-three years until her death in . She was Feragaine Saralman's successor and Zeranda Tyrim's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Notably, Myriam chose Sereille Bagand of the White Ajah as her Mistress of Novices, though the name of her Keeper of the Chronicles and her subsequent Ajah are unknown. Sereille served excellently in the same office also during the reigns of the two Amyrlins who succeed Myriam (a Brown and a Gray respectively) becoming legendary in this role.

entities.name: Mirlene Cornwell
entities.description:
Mirlene is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was enrolled in the Novice book in at the age of sixteen. After spending eleven years as a Novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in at the age of 34.

Mirlene was in the group of Aes Sedai that kidnapped Rand. She and both her Warders were killed during the Battle at Dumai's Wells.

Mirlene Cornwell is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion". She is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.

entities.name: Theodrin Dabei
entities.description:
Theodrin is apple cheeked, willowy and graceful, with a swanlike neck and coppery skin. Her mouth looks as if she wants to smile. Though Domani, she dresses modestly.

Her personality is good-natured. She is kind and patient.

Theodrin is strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards with a potential strength of . Egwene al'Vere compared her and Faolain Orande's strength with that of Amys and Melaine, grouping tham all as "far from weak". Due to her being a Wilder with a Block, it's possible she is taking longer to reach her full potential.

She is able to use the weave to open a gateway to Travel.

entities.description:
Zerah Dacan is a Mayener Aes Sedai of the White Ajah., Zerah Dacan}}

Zerah is 5'5½" tall, and slim. She has black shoulder-length hair and large blue eyes. She is cool and self-possessed and moves gracefully.

Zerah is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

entities.name: Nisao Dachen
entities.description:
She is very short (under five feet) and has an average build for her height. Neither plain nor beautiful, she has dark hair and large dark brown eyes that are her best feature.

She is considered intelligent, even by Romanda. As a Yellow, she is self-assured and thus often unwilling to step back for anyone.

Nisao is strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . She was likely chosen as a member of Egwene al'Vere's Council for this reason, although (along with Beonin Marinye) she is the weakest of that group. Nonetheless, she is the second strongest member of the Yellow we know of among the Rebel Aes Sedai, the strongest being Romanda Cassin. She has sufficient strength to Travel.

Her area of study is the healing of the mind problems and diseases.

entities.name: Sedore Dajenna
entities.description:
Sedore Dajenna was an Aes Sedai and a loyalist Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was plump and had a round face with dark eyes and long dark hair. In Elaida’s opinion, she was one of the most arrogant of all among the sisters.

Sedore is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

When Sedore died, she was 187 years old. Born in Tear in , Sedore went to the White Tower in 829 NE. After spending nine years as a novice and seven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 845 NE.

entities.name: Dalevien
entities.description:
Dalevien is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Dalevien is stocky with short, dark hair streaked with gray. Her appearance hints that she might be just over 150, as with some sisters with streaks of gray in their hair, like Verin Mathwin and Dagdara Finchey.

Dalevien and Felaana Bevaine are maintaining a shield on Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the Tower cells. Dalevien is comparing the text between two books, barely registering Egwene's arrival.

entities.name: Ludice Daneen
entities.description:
Ludice Daneen was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

She was bony, with a long grim face and brightly beaded Taraboner braids that hung to her waist.

She was handpicked by Tamra Ospenya for the task of searching for the Dragon Reborn due to her strict way and dedication to Tower law.

She was murdered by the Black Ajah while tring to find the Dragon Reborn. As in the case with Aisha Raveneos and Valera Gorovni, it is unknown where and how she was murdered.

entities.name: Danelle
entities.description:
She had big blue eyes and was dreamy, with few friends even in her own Ajah. She was 5'5 and slight of build. Mesaana also bore a passing resemblance to her, enough that only a little Illusion was needed for Mesaana to impersonate her.

Danelle was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Mesaana would have used an unknown weave to appear to be the same strength as Danelle to avoid suspicion, Messaana's true strength being almost as strong as it's possible for a woman to be.

Born in , she went to the White Tower in . Spending nine years as a novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised in . She would have progressed faster had she not always been going off into a dream. She spent much time in introspection and could drift off while talking to someone.

Danelle spent a lot of time out of the Tower - in fact, as soon as she gained the shawl she left - and had no close friends as she was always lost in thought or books. She was seldom in the Tower for more than a few months at a time, and at widely-spaced intervals. This meant she was quite unknown, and Mesaana took advantage of that to impersonate her. She also never had a Warder, which helped.

entities.name: Innina Darenhold
entities.description:
She was part of the White Tower secret group to Cairhien led by Coiren Saeldain and took part in kidnapping Rand al'Thor.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Chisaine Nurbaya, Janine Pavlara, Innina Darenhold and Vayelle Kamsa are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand. They did so under Verin's Compulsion.

As with many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Innina probably fought the Last Battle on the slopes of Thakan'dar. It is not stated whether she survived or not.

entities.name: Faiselle Darone
entities.description:
Faiselle Darone is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders.

Faiselle is stocky, copper-skinned and square faced. She owns silks with dense green embroidery.

Faiselle is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Faiselle is Domani and is 171 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending ten years as novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .

entities.name: Magla Daronos
entities.description:
Magla Daronos is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Yellow Ajah. Her Warder is Rorik.

She is described as being a large woman with broad shoulders and well muscled and so she looked as though she had worked a hammer or a sword. But she is not fat.

Her personality is in accordance with her body type: direct and forceful, sometimes overpowering.

Magla is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent. This is slightly different from how her strength is listed in the The Wheel of Time Companion - see Errata below.

entities.name: Cetalia Delarme
entities.description:
Cetalia Delarme (pronounced: seh-TAHL-ee-ah deh-LAHR-may) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah; she was also the head of her Ajah's eyes-and-ears network at the time of the Aiel War.

Cetalia is described as a tall, square-faced woman in sky-blue silk with steel-gray hair in a multitude of blue-beaded braids that hung to her waist., Cetalia Delarmes|comp}} Judging by her appearance, she must have been over two hundred years old when she died.

She was very strong in the One Power, by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . It was judged that she was stronger than Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche, at least until they both reached their full potential and demanded "more than mere deference" for her superior strength.

Being the head of the eyes-and-ears system of the Blue Ajah, Cetalia tested Siuan just after she gained the shawl; she used many puzzles in an attempt to find out if Siuan would be useful as an apprentice. Siuan passed the tests and spent her first months, and perhaps years, as an Aes Sedai being worked hard under Cetalia.

entities.name: Parenia Demalle
entities.description:
Notably, Parenia kept Sereille Bagand of the White Ajah as her Mistress of Novices, though the name of her Keeper of the Chronicles and her subsequent Ajah are unknown. Sereille served excellently in the same office also during the reigns of the two Amyrlin that preceded Parenia (a Green and a Brown respectively) becoming legendary in this role.

Parenia was the last Amyrlin elected from the Red-Yellow-Gray axis for 160 years. From this time on the Blue-White-Green axis was very politically strong - Amyrlins were elected almost exclusively from these Ajahs in alternation (except for one Brown) until Sierin Vayu and then another two Blues. The Reds could barely get even one of their allied Ajahs elected, whereas previously, more Amyrlins were raised from the Yellow or the Gray. There was no Yellow Amyrlin in nearly 300 years and no Red since Bonwhin Meraighdin until Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan.

Parenia was an Amyrlin of average strength and influence. She was more interested in negotiations and treaties between nations than in the ruling of the White Tower. She still kept fairly good control in order to gain backing for her diplomatic goals.

entities.description:
She is 5'2 tall, slim, wiry and whipcord tough. Rand thinks she is relatively pleasant for an Aes Sedai.

Nelavaire has a strength in the One Power of , slightly below average for an Aes Sedai. She is unable to Travel without linking.

She was born with the spark which began to manifest at the age of thirteen. Due to this, the White Tower made an exception and she was enrolled at thirteen as a Novice in the year .

After spending ten years as a novice and six years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in at the age of 29.

entities.name: Deposed
entities.description:
A deposition refers to the either legal or seemingly legal removal of a high office or regent. Most commonly within the series, it refers to the deposition and stilling of an Amyrlin Seat, one of the most severe punishments of Tower law. Thus far there have only been three deposed Amyrlin Seats.

To depose an Amyrlin Seat, a sister, not necessarily a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower, must bring forth strong and trustworthy evidence of an Amyrlin's failure to handle multiple situations, political insanity or incompetence. Such a vast political decision would normally require a greater consensus, therefore the most recently deposed Amyrlin's prosecutor and successor stretched the law to its extremes by merely inviting eleven Sitters to the meeting.

There are only three officially deposed Amyrlin Seats in Tower history, marked as damned by the Hall, stilled and set to do chores for the rest of their lives, or in some cases, even worse.

Another case of deposition is the case of Shein Chunla who was raised from the Green Ajah in and was deposed in in secret. Since the story is far too sensitive, the Tower had it hidden away in the Thirteenth Depository, availalbe only to the Amyrlin Seat, the Keeper of the Chronicles, Sitters and Ajah Heads. It is widely believed that Shein, who ruled during the Third War of Garen's Wall, completely mishandled the situation and caused the war. In fact, Shein's rule began the rule of strong Amyrlin. She tried to run everyone over with an iron hand, not very unlike the actions of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan several centuries later, a strategy that initially worked, but the Hall tired of her eventually, and began ordering her a penance for every action she took. At the same time, the Ajah Heads and Sitters had catfights over authority, each faction pulling the Tower in different directions. Eventually the sisters themselves organized a mutiny and in one of six mutinies in Tower history, Shein and the entire Hall were put down and sent into exile. Apart from Shein, no other secretly deposed Amyrlins are known.

entities.name: Takima Deraighdin
entities.description:
Takima has long black hair and skin the color of aged ivory. She is a tiny, bird-like woman and stands 5'1" or 155 cm in height., Takima Deraighdin}} However small, quiet and observant by nature, she can still be forceful if she wishes.

Takima is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Takima has a formidable memory. She remembers everything she reads. Takima could recognize one of her pupils at a hundred paces.

Takima was born in in the Mountains of Mist

entities.name: Cathal Devore
entities.description:
Cathal was tall for a woman at about 5'9" to 5'10", and she was lanky and bony in build. She was awkward, physically, often dropping things. She had dark brown hair that she wore drawn back with combs, and hazel eyes.

She blinked a great deal, as if she could not understand. In fact, she was a keen observer with an analytical mind—at least, when she had a reason to be interested in what was going on—and not nearly so retiring and half-asleep as she seemed.

She could recall every word she heard, word for word, even after a considerable time, a gift useful mainly when she could not take notes right away.

Cathal is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

entities.name: Kumira Dhoran
entities.description:
Kumira was a handsome with blue eyes, graceful hands and short dark brown hair. She was 5'5" tall. She preferred strong woolens over silk, but would sometimes wear a silk scarf. She sometimes gets ink stains on her clothes, but she would deal with them as soon as she could.

Like many of the Brown Ajah, Kumira could become easily absorbed in her studies, sometimes to the exclusion of the world around her. She had a reputation of aggressively pursuing those things of which she had taken an interest.

Unlike most Browns, she is also hard-headed, practical, observant and very strong-willed. She is interested in everything and doesn't like wasting time.

She was not afraid to swear, sometimes using the word "peace" as if it were an oath. She takes care not to offend anyone on purpose, even those of a lower status than hers; in fact, she is often more considerate of those with lower status, such as when she debates with Daigian over logic.

entities.name: Lirene Doirellin
entities.description:
Lirene Doirellin is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah., Lirene Doirellin}}

She is 5'2" tall, a little shorter than Egwene al'Vere. She has nervous eyes that remind Egwene of a sparrow watching out for cats. She used to be plump, but lost a lot of weight due to her exile. Her skin has become weathered as well.

Although she is Red Ajah, her clothing only has traces of red in it. It is possible that she wishes to disown the Ajah that disowned her in her years of exile.

Lirene is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

entities.description:
Faile mentions Jestian Redhill, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told them to do. Mashera bore seven children for a man she loathed.

Other than Elayne, she is the only reference we have to an Aes Sedai becoming pregnant.

entities.description:
Javindhra Doraille is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and for a while she was a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

Javindhra is tall, has smooth cheeks but a very angular face. She speaks with a very harsh manner. She is bony.

Javindhra is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Javindhra is 158 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as novice and five as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year . She was elected Sitter in the year 985 NE.

entities.description:
She is beautiful, with large 'liquid' eyes, often vague as any Brown.

Her strength is not given in the Companion, nor are their clues as to her strength in the books.

She has few friends, perhaps none. She was almost as dreamy as Danelle and perhaps as friendless and solitary.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

entities.name: Suana Dragand
entities.description:
Suana Dragand is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current head of the Yellow Ajah.

She described as "beefy" with "too much chin, a square stone of it". The Companion describes her as "A beefy woman, with too much chin, blue eyes, a square face and wide square hands"., Suana Dragand|comp}}

She has an unyielding demeanor.. Alviarin thinks she is arrogant and likely to take her own views as that of her whole Ajah. She has a blunt manner.

She is also politically well-connected and very knowledgeable - a woman with a will who could get things done..

entities.description:
Alind Dyfelle is a legendary and historical Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah, in fact when Bera and Kiruna find themselves confronted with Cadsuane Melaidhrin, Merana thinks that it must be like herself meeting Alind Dyfelle, Sevlana Meseau or Mabriam en Shereed.

entities.description:
Eadyth (pronounced: ee-DITH) is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

Her long white hair suggests she is very old for an Aes Sedai, likely well over 200 years old.

Eadyth was the First Selector of the Blue Ajah, as well as a Sitter in the Hall. She was considered one of the most capable Blue in the last one hundred years and was First Selector during this time.

She is one of the Blue Ajah Sitters who present the shawl to Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche when they first become Aes Sedai.

entities.name: Caren Endelle
entities.description:
Caren Endelle is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah., Caren Endelle}} She was part of Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

Caren is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Bennae Nalsad and Nisain a'Cowel, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

After kidnapping Rand and escaping capture during the Battle of Dumai's Wells she flees to Dorlan.

=Trivia== Caren Endelle is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.

entities.name: Celestin Eguilera
entities.description:
Celestin is about 5'6" tall. She has black and straight hair worn above the shoulder at a length that suggested she can’t decide whether to wear it long or short. Her eyes are gray, though they seem almost pale blue at times. Her nose is perhaps a little too prominent; it makes her look like she's looking down on people, which she probably is, consistent with her somewhat supercilious manner.

Celestin is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She went to the White Tower in 976 NE at the age of sixteen.

entities.name: Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan
entities.description:
Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah. She was formerly the Amyrlin Seat.

Once serving as the influential yet unpopular Aes Sedai advisor to Andor and one of the strongest Aes Sedai in the White Tower, Elaida deposed and replaced sitting Amyrlin Siuan Sanche after it was revealed that she was plotting to protect the Dragon Reborn. Elaida's controversial seizure of power led to the White Tower Schism.

Although she finally managed to capture the rebel Amyrlin, Egwene al'Vere, she became unpopular among her own supporters for her hubris and arrogance, her failings against the Dragon Reborn and the Asha'man, and the growing sectarianism of the Ajahs.

During the Battle of Tar Valon, she was captured by the Seanchan, made damane, and given the name Suffa. In her absence, Egwene was raised to Amyrlin by the remaining loyalist sisters, leading to the reunification of the White Tower.

entities.name: Elayna
entities.description:
Elayna was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as Keeper of the Chronicles, and briefly as Amyrlin Seat around .

Given her extreme natural weakness in the White Tower to the point that she cannot effectively participate in any combat without the use of objects of the One Power, Elayna's natural strength in the One Power likely sits at around , the level of Daigian Moseneillin, the weakest ever known Aes Sedai from the primary world. This is only an estimation, as the Mirror World that Elayna is from may have different standards for an Aes Sedai.

As a child, Elayna was once trapped in a collapsing cave during one of her adventures. She remembered this experience during her test to be raised Accepted at the White Tower, during the first experience with the silver arches. She then experienced being trapped in the basement of a prominent Darkfriend, and being sent to Fal Dara to stand against Shadowspawn as a full Aes Sedai. The Mistress of Novices of the time, of the Blue Ajah, deemed that she had passed the test, and raised her to Accepted.

Elayna was eventually raised to the shawl and chose the Brown Ajah, although she was as weak as possible for an Aes Sedai to be. She was a student of ter'angreal and used them to raise her abilities in the One Power to the extent that it raised her own political standing within the White Tower.

entities.name: Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan
entities.description:
Moiraine relates the legend that Eldrene was "so beautiful that it was said the flowers bloomed to make her smile". Histories relate that she was kind and patient and loved her subjects dearly. In turn she herself was greatly revered and it is known that soldiers of Manetheren invoked her name in battle as a rallying cry.

In the graphic novel, she and Aemon are depicted with blonde hair and blue eyes, but no physical description is given in the books or wider canon and so her portrayal is strictly artistic licence.

There is no history that survives the Trolloc Wars to relate Eldrene's activities as a full Aes Sedai sister. However, because the era was one of great upheaval that required the participation of nearly all Aes Sedai sisters, it is likely that Eldrene contributed in some manner. What is known with certainty is that sometime prior to she returned to Manetheren where she eventually married King Aemon al Caar al Thorin and bonded him as a Warder. She thus became the queen of Manetheren at a time when the entire world was at war against the Shadow and she ruled from her country's wondrous capital city, high and secure in the cloud-capped peaks of the Mountains of Mist. Her nation was known to have always been at the forefront of the fighting and it was said that people of other nations referred to Manetheren as "a thorn to the Dark One's foot and a bramble to his hand".

In time the wars would consume some within the alliance of nations, including Manetheren's close ally Aridhol. The fall of Aridhol would allow Shadowspawn forces to push unopposed into the centralized countries of Coremanda and Safer. This also allowed dreadlord generals to work towards their milestone goal of exterminating Manetheren. Sometime around Aemon was lured into overextending his military which allowed the shadow to strike directly towards the Manetheren capital. When the shadow's plans became known to Aemon, he recalled his forces from the Field of Bekkar - site of Manetheren's most recent victory - and back to the Manetheren heartland where they engaged their enemy in a titanic multiple-day struggle that came to be known as the Battle of the Tarendrelle River. Knowing that he could not win the battle unaided, Aemon sent messengers carrying a plea for aid to all the remaining allied powers of the Ten Nations thumb|260px|left|Eldrene feels the death of Aemon and a special messenger was sent to Eldrene's former rival Tetsuan who had since been elevated to the Amyrlin Seat.

entities.description:
Elise's name could indicate Andoran origin (see Kairen Stang, Elisa al'Seen, Elisa al'Vere, and Elise Marwin).

Elise held the position for twenty-one years until her death in . She was Catala Lucanvalle's successor and Comarra Zepava's predecessor.

She was such a weak Amyrlin that she had to beg to have what she wanted from the Hall.

entities.description:
She participated in the Last Battle and survived.

She is one of four Aes Sedai, the others being Saerin, Rubinde and Yukiri, trying to convince Rodel Ituralde to take the throne of Arad Doman after the Last Battle.

All the Aes Sedai that persuaded Rodel Ituralde to become King and Cadsuane Melaidhrin to become Amyrlin were Sitters, except Elswell. However, the situation might suggest that Elswell is also a Sitter and, if so, she would be the unknown Sitter of the Blue Ajah.

During a Q&A with Brandon Sanderson, he said, with no absolute certainty, that this theory is possibly correct. Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

entities.description:
Carniele is fair-skinned for a Tairen and has blue eyes and black hair. She is 5'6.5" tall and of medium build.

Carniele has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Since she is of Yellow Ajah, we can assume she has an above average ability at Healing.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the schism.

entities.description:
Chesmal Emry was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters

She was from Ghealdan. Chesmal was stern but handsome with dark hair and eyes. She was tall for a woman and seemed even taller. She was 5'7 tall.

She was often described as cold and arrogant.

Chesmal is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

entities.description:

Medanor held the position for twenty-nine years until her death in . She was Balladare Arandaille's successor and Kiyosa Natomo's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

It is possible that the Kavarthen Wars continued into her reign, as they are only stated as having begun at the end of the reign of the former Amyrlin Seat.

She was a fairly strong Amyrlin and skilled in mediation.

entities.description:
Demira Eriff is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Demira Eriff}}

Demira is a gracefully beautiful Domani with coppery skin. She wears clothing in the fashion of her native Arad Doman, although she often contemplates switching to less provocative dresses. as she does not like the unwanted attention. However, she never got around to changing her dresses as she was preoccupied with other matters.

Demira is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

She is the third weakest among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Berenicia Morsad and Valinde Nathenos being weaker and Kairen Stang being her equal. She is, however, only slightly weaker than Merana Ambrey and several others.

entities.description:
Suilin Escanda was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year .

Her name indicates that she was almost certainly from Tear.

Suilin held the position for forty-one years until her resignation in . She was Aliane Senican's successor and Nirelle Coidevwin's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Suilin was an Amyrlin of moderate strength who involved the Tower in a number of foreign intrigues.

entities.name: Meidani Eschede
entities.description:
Meidani is pretty, with dark golden hair, blue eyes and full lips. She is tall and slim, but has a large bust which seemed overly large because of her slimness, something which gave her concern. She often wore ornaments and pins in her hair as she liked jewelry. She has a melodious voice.

She had less control over her facial expressions than most Aes Sedai, especially when angry or resentful - her eyes would narrow or blaze with anger and her mouth would pout. This was more evident because she always controlled her voice well. This only happened with personal matters though, as she always maintained perfect composure during negotiations and mediations.

Meidani is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel, a weave she learned from Egwene al'Vere.

She was only a fair-to-average negotiator and mediator. If she felt things were not progressing as they should, she would dig in her heels even if it was a detriment to finding a solution.

entities.name: Eyes-and-ears
entities.description:
Eyes-and-ears is a term used loosely to describe a network of spies, or an individual informant loyal to a group or individual. Eyes-and-ears is a term most commonly used by the White Tower, though other organizations and rulers employ eyes-and-ears as well. Eyes-and-ears are also sometimes known in those circles simply as spy networks, though the term is interchangeable.

Each Ajah has their own eyes-and-ears, and individual Aes Sedai are also known to maintain eyes-and-ears loyal to themselves. Many believe that the White Ajah has no formal network of its own, but this was proven false by the Wheel of Time Companion - as even the Whites wanted to manipulate world events logically. In theory, all intelligence gathered by the Ajah's eyes-and-ears should be given to the Amyrlin Seat, but this is rarely the case.

When Siuan Sanche was deposed and stilled, she maintained control of the Amyrlin's eyes-and-ears, and was given a position of authority with the Rebel Aes Sedai. She had also previously been the head of the eyes-and-ears for the Blue Ajah - the largest network of any of the Ajahs. This title is now held by Aeldene Stonebridge.

Leane Sharif, as Keeper of the Chronicles, also maintained her own eyes-and-ears within Tar Valon.

entities.name: Karella Fanway
entities.description:
Circa , Karella was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Karella's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Karella was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Karella and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

Her name is spelled Karelia Fanway in The World of Robert Jordan's The Wheel of Time.

entities.description:
Alviarin Freidhen, acting in the interest of her true Ajah, the Black, ordered Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan to reward Farellin of the Yellow, Kiyoshi of the Gray and Doraise Mesianos of the Brown and uphold them as models of preserving the law. Farellien is given a new horse. Alviarin's goal was to create paranoia in the White Tower as none of the sisters involved had done anything to deserve such praise, and it implicated them as the informants on Adelorna Bastine and Josaine, who were severely punished for keeping angreal and ter'angreal in their rooms.

entities.name: Saroiya Farseen
entities.description:
Saroiya Farseen is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the White Ajah.

She is blocky/stocky but looks slim compared to Aledrin Malenry. She is 5'4" or 153cm tall. She has brown hair and brown eyes.,Saroiya Farseen|comp}} She has the habit of tugging her ear when in deep thought. She is extraordinarily patient. According to Romanda Cassin, when Saroiya starts grinding her teeth, most sisters would be shouting.

Saroiya is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Saroiya is 143 years old. She was born in Arad Doman in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending thirteen years as novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
