entities.name: Irgain Fatamed
entities.description:
Her strength in the One Power is unknown, but given the amount of time spent in training (12 years), it can be assumed that she is moderately strong and probably a middle-high ranking sister.

Irgain was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and six years as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 958 NE.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Irgain was one of the Aes Sedai involved in kidnapping Rand. She was shielding him along with Ronaille Vevanios and Sashalle Anderly when the Battle at Dumai's Wells occurred. They were all stilled when Rand broke the shield . Irgain's two Warders were also killed during the battle. She was taken prisoner soon after by the Aiel Wise Ones. They used mild manners with her because for them her stilling was a sufficient punishment.

entities.name: Tarna Feir
entities.description:
Tarna is from Altara and has pale, yellow hair, sharp, blue eyes, and a prominent chin. She is said to be humorless, arrogant, and haughty.

Tarna is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size and is trusted enough by Elaida to be among the first sisters taught the weave.

She was born in the year 950 NE in the north of Altara near the Andoran border. She was a Wilder who touched saidar about as early as is possible for a girl to do so, but had developed a block that made her unable to touch the Source unless she had her eyes closed.

In , at the age of fourteen, she became a novice in the White Tower. Galina Casban helped her overcome that by beating her until she overcame her block. This was technically illegal, but the Mistress of Novices at the time kept silent about it. At this time, this would likely have been Merean Redhill. Both Merean and Galina were fairly highly ranking sisters of the Black Ajah. After spending nine years as novice and six as Accepted, Tarna was raised to the shawl in the year 979 NE.

entities.name: Dagdara Finchey
entities.description:
Dagdara Finchey was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was as wide as any man and taller than most. She had graying hair and a round face.

Dagdara is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability with the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

It was said that Dagdara knew more of Healing than any two other Yellow sisters, until the arrival of Nynaeve al'Meara and her new Healing weaves. She was among the best healers in the traditional Aes Sedai method, in the same range as Samitsu Tamagowa, Suana Dragand, and Chesmal Emry.

entities.description:
Andaya Forae is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Gray Ajah.

She is 5'5" tall, with hazel eyes. , Andaya | SHORTCUT}} She is described as thin and birdlike. She is not particularly slim nor particularly small and reminds Elaida of a sparrow. She has long light brown hair, which she brushes till it gleams.

Andaya is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Andaya is 99 years old. She was born in Tarabon in the year and she went to the Tower in the year 918. After spending ten years as Novice and ten as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .

entities.name: Nalaene Forrell
entities.description:
She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She is one of the Aes Sedai bound to Rand al'Thor, and therefore one of the Aes Sedai who was captured after the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Along all the prisoner sisters in Cairhien she has sworn an oath of fealty to Rand al'Thor.

entities.name: Careane Fransi
entities.description:
She is described as stout, but graceful. Her bulk was muscle rather than fat. She had wide shoulders and arms as thick as most men's. She was 5'5" or 166cm tall.

Careane is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler. She was the weakest of the sisters sent by Salidar to Ebou Dar.

She was from Arad Doman. She was a novice for two years with Zarya Alkaese, now known as Garenia Rosoinde. She had three Warders, Cieryl Arjuna, Venr Kosaan and Tavan Shandare. Only Venr was a darkfriend.

She had been Aes Sedai for more than fifty years. Careane could have been in the same heart as Marillin Gemalphin, for she was the one who revealed her as Black Ajah.

entities.name: Alviarin Freidhen
entities.description:
Alviarin has a swan neck and is tall and slim. She has smooth, unblemished skin. Alviarin is quite beautiful; even seductive by some standards.

She cares little for relationships or the feelings of others. She frequently appears aloof, and often interacts with her peers in a coldly logical manner. Secretly Alviarin has had a history of heinous remorseless acts. Her ability to dehumanize others and behave in a manner that lacks basic empathy demonstrates someone with a sociopathic mind.

Alviarin is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She is a skilled administrator and records keeper which served her well during her tenure as the Keeper of the Chronicles under Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan.

entities.description:
Janya Frende is an Aes Sedai and a Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

Janya is unusually tidy for a Brown Sister. She is slender, with short, dark hair, and pretty despite a perpetual frown. Despite her age not a hint of gray is showing in her hair. She is described as "bird-like". Romanda thinks that Janya maybe has bad eyes, which would explain her squinting.

She is very inquisitive, wants to know the why and how of everything, and becomes very disappointed because she can not make ter'angreal or Cuendillar. She talks in quick and long cascades. She does not bother to hide her curiosity behind a mask of serenity

Janya is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

entities.description:
She was very tall and thin, not much short of bony, with an angular face, a long chin, and a cap of curly hair. She has spidery fingers..

Shevan can be very dry at times and she frequently was.

Shevan is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Shevan was 157 years old; she was born in and went to the White Tower in . After four years as novice and six as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .

entities.description:
Ryma Galfrey was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah who is now a damane.

She is slim and elegant, with dark hair and blue eyes.

Ryma is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Ryma was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending eight years as a novice and seven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

entities.name: Hattori Gatano
entities.description:
Hattori Gatano is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Her Warder is Sleete, whom she bonded ten years before the Last Battle.

Sleete mentioned that Hattori doesn't have much influence in the Tower, suggesting that she may be relatively weak in the One Power.

Since Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai, Hattori must have an One Power strength level of or less. She would not be able to Travel without linking.

entities.name: Toveine Gazal
entities.description:
She is described as short and slightly plump with smooth copper skin, dark eyes, and long glossy dark hair. She was attractive, with a nice mouth and eyes, but not beautiful. She is from Saldaea.

Toveine has a sharp gaze that could bore into anything; she could cut one's heart out in front of you, but is not particularly cruel except when it comes to men who could channel, because she hates them deeply. It is not only because she is a Red sister but because she considered all of them responsible for her hard punishment.

She does not like men at all, preferring pretty young men in their mid to late teens, young enough to be eager and grateful and easy to control. This gets her into trouble during her exile. The notion of any sort of sexual relationship with an adult male made her skin crawl.

Toveine is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

entities.description:
She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A Bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of Air.

entities.name: Bernaile Gelbarn
entities.description:
She is stocky in appearance and wears her hair in beaded braids hanging well below her shoulders. She is 5'5 tall, with hazel eyes and pale brown hair.

She tends to be aloof in public, but can laugh and tell jokes with close friends.

She is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . Among the ten ferrets, Bernaile is the third in hierarchy by strength and years of training. She is also second strongest of the White Ajah among the Rebel Aes Sedai of which we have information, only Carlinya Sorevin being stronger and Brendas her equal.

Born in , she goes to the White Tower in . After seven years as a novice and nine as Accepted, she is raised Aes Sedai in .

entities.name: Marillin Gemalphin
entities.description:
Marillin Gemalphin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

She is skinny, with dreamy blue eyes and lifeless brown hair. She has a narrow face.

She loves cats and other animals, quite possibly more than she likes people, going out of her way to Heal stray cats.

Marillin is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . Among thirteen sisters that fled with Liandrin, only Liandrin is stronger, although Eldrith Jhondar is only slightly weaker. When the much weaker Temaile Kinderode calls her a fool, Marillin is quick to reminder her who should stand higher among them, a fact observed by Elayne Trakand.

Zenare is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She was not present when Nynaeve al'Meara Healed both Leane Sharif and Siuan Sanche from stilling and insisted on her going through the whole process again step by step and even tries to give advice on how to improve it.

entities.description:
Shana Goridien is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah.

She has bulging eyes and reminds Elayne of a fish. She always looks startled, although she normally maintains a deep reserve.

Shana is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She matches Siuan Sanche's strength level after she was Healed for her stilling.

Although weak in the One Power, she is an expert at reading residues.

entities.name: Gray Ajah
entities.description:
The Gray Ajah of the Aes Sedai are dedicated to politics and mediation. They favor harmony and consensus above all else, and are often conflict mediators or ambassadors. The leader of the Gray Ajah is called the Head Clerk.

The Gray is the third-largest Ajah, behind the Green and before the Brown, with roughly one hundred and forty Sisters just prior to the Last Battle, as it is stated in TWoTC.

In The Gathering Storm it is discovered that there are thirty-one members of the Black Ajah among the Gray sisters, but only the names of six of them are known. In Towers of Midnight the name of the former Gray Sitter Evanellein is added to the list of Blacks infiltrated in this Ajah.

entities.name: Great Purge
entities.description:
The Great Purge was en event in modern Aes Sedai history, taking place in .

Egwene al'Vere, after receiving definite proof of the Black Ajah's existence in the form of member lists from Verin Mathwin's secret notes, returned to the Rebel Aes Sedai camp. After assembling the Rebel Hall of the Tower and swearing the three oaths on the Oath Rod and thereby proving herself not to be a Darkfriend, she proclaimed her knowledge of the Black Ajah's members, several of them found among the rebels. Among the Hall's present members, Moria Karentanis, a Sitter of the Blue Ajah, was discovered as a Black, shielded and blocked, the same happening to Egwene's Keeper of the Chronicles, Sheriam Bayanar. The Hall then proceeded to forsake and reswear their oaths on the Oath Rod in turn, in order to prove themselves friends of the Light. Afterwards, they had all the Rebel Aes Sedai come by Ajah to repeat the process, resulting in over fifty Black sisters captured out of the estimated seventy that were in camp at the time.

Afterwards, back in the White Tower and in control of both factions as the true Amyrlin Seat, Egwene repeated the process within the Tower. But before the Purge started, the majority of Black sisters inside the Tower, around sixty, were alerted and able to flee - only a dozen of them were captured and executed.

All the Black Sisters outside the White Tower at the moment of reunification, especially the seventy among the unaligned sisters, were also able to escape the capture and join the Shadow during the Last Battle.

entities.name: Great Serpent ring
entities.description:
The Great Serpent ring is an item of organizational regalia worn by Aes Sedai and their upper class of students in training, the Accepted. It is a golden ring fashioned into the shape of a serpent biting its own tail, an ancient symbol of eternity and time itself.

The Great Serpent ring is awarded to any of the novices who pass the qualifying test for Acceptance, and thus the Great Serpent ring is one of the most obvious ways to differentiate between a novice and Accepted (the more ornate dress worn by an Accepted is the other). Strictly speaking, an Accepted may only wear the ring on the third finger of her left hand.

When a candidate for full sisterhood is raised from among the Accepted as an Aes Sedai, she may wear the ring on whatever finger she chooses, or not at all as circumstances may warrant. The wearing of the Great Serpent ring is recognized as one of the most outward identifiers of an Aes Sedai by society at large, along with the 'ageless face.'

An Aes Sedai may use her Great Serpent ring as a signet ring to seal a letter and mark it in wax, as Moiraine Damodred was observed to have done.

entities.name: Green Ajah
entities.description:
The Green Ajah of the Aes Sedai holds itself ready for Tarmon Gai'don, for the final battle between good and evil when the Dark One inevitably breaks free from his prison. They were called the "Battle Ajah" during the Trolloc Wars and are excellent generals who can plan effective battle strategies. They bond as many Warders as they wish and have been on friendly terms with the Blue Ajah for a millennium. The head of the Green Ajah is known as the Captain-General.

The Green has been always the second-largest Ajah, after the Red, since the founding of the White Tower, but if initially the Red has been the largest by far, during the centuries, and especially after the Trolloc Wars, the gap between this two Ajah has started to dwindle progressively.

So in the last decades the Green Ajah is following closely behind the Red who has around two hundred members; in fact by the time of the Dragon birth, the Greens have roughly 190-180 members.}}

The Green also has a high concentration of Black sisters with at least thirty-eight, however we have only learned the identity of six.

entities.name: Liandrin Guirale
entities.description:
Liandrin has dark brown eyes and honey-colored hair, which she wears in a multitude of thin beaded braids. She is pretty with a face bearing doll-like features and a rosebud mouth.

She is selfish and cunning, willing to use manipulation or intimidation tactics to get what she wants. Liandrin deliberately behaves and speaks like upper crust Taraboners. However, when angry she will sometimes lapse into the more vulgar dialect she spoke during her commoner upbringing.

Liandrin is very strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . Few equalled this strength, and even fewer surpassed it.

Liandrin had developed a rudimentary form of Compulsion which she frequently uses to manipulate others to forward selfish personal agendas. She is very weak in healing, and is frequently jealous of those who can kill directly with the power; a skill tightly linked with healing. Though she first learned to channel on her own as a girl, she does not consider herself a wilder and loathes them.

She is a tall woman with silver-gold hair.

Guisin is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

She is allied with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

The Salidar Six, led by Sheriam, send Guisin, Afara and Edesina Azzedin to Tarabon as emissaries of the Rebel Aes Sedai. All three were captured by the Seanchan and made damane.

Gyldan is Elaida's close confidant and is one of thirteen sisters of the Black Ajah who were going to turn Egwene to the Shadow with thirteen Myrddraal. Kera has the blue eyes and fair hair that appeared occasionally among Tairens. She has an arrogant demeanor common to Greens.

She is of Tairen noble birth.|Kera Haellin}}

She is almost certainly a relative of High Lord Sunamon Haellin, although we do not know how distant a relative. She may be anything from a sister to a branch of the family that existed 200 years before the start of the books.

entities.description:
Rina Hafden is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah.

She is described as being elegant despite being stocky. She has a square face and an upturned nose. She is a fierce, tenacious and determined woman, not easily daunted.

Rina has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Rina is 77 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 955 NE.

entities.description:
She is tall, with blue eyes and dark hair drawn severely back and an ivory complexion. She is stern-faced with a stern manner. Some thought her beautiful without being pretty, some saw her as handsome, while others saw only severity.

Merise has a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong in the Aes Sedai hierarchy. Few are as strong as her, and fewer stronger. She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She has an ability at Healing, although not as good as Corele Hovian.

She went to the White Tower in at the age of thirteen, an extremely young age for a Novice. She lied about her age but was discovered, and so she spent fifteen years as a novice and five as Accepted.

entities.name: Hall of the Tower
entities.description:
The Hall of the Tower is the central council of the Aes Sedai, responsible for making policy and implementing the Amyrlin Seat's decrees. It is comprised of three Sitters from each Ajah and is presided over by the Amyrlin Seat. The Amyrlin, however, may not enter the Hall unless announced by the Keeper of the Chronicles, who may not enter the Hall without the Amyrlin.

During the Schism there were two Halls; one in the Tower loyal to Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan and the Rebel Hall loyal to Egwene al'Vere. Each Hall had only eighteen members as opposed to the usual twenty-one. Elaida formally decreed the Blue Ajah disbanded. Although no reciprocal motion was ever made by the rebels, it is unlikely that any Red Sisters were welcome nor would wish to join them. Since its reunification, the Tower once again has its full compliment of Sitters. See Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere for more information.

Each Ajah is represented by three Sitters, chosen inside the Ajah according to its rules and customs. Some Ajahs, like the Blue, do not see the role of Sitter as mutually exclusive to that of being the Ajah Head, as shown by both Eadyth and Lelaine Akashi, whereas others typically have Ajah Heads who are not Sitters and a woman will retire from the Hall to become Ajah Head. Suana Dragand and Ferane Neheran were seen as being exceptions by reentering the Hall after retiring from it years before.

Contrary to the usual strength-based hierarchy among normal sisters, Sitters from any Ajah are chosen more for experience and skill with years since attaining the shawl being a strong factor in their appointment. It is unusual for a sister to take a seat in the Hall before wearing the shawl for at least seventy or eighty years (more or less equivalent to being at least one hundred years old). Several Sitters in both Halls are notably weaker in the Power than those at the top of the hierarchy outside of the Hall of the Tower. Normally the rule is that Sitters are much older before they are first appointed. There are a few exceptions where Sitters are elected at a younger age (although not young compared relative to any non-channeler) and it is usually noted that these exceptions occur for some underlying political motivation or when the woman in question has shown a particularly strong political skill, such as is the case for Saroiya Farseen and Andaya Forae. While this breaks the general trend, it is also common for there to be at least one woman that is slightly younger in the Hall at any one time.

entities.name: Hall of the Tower during the White Tower Schism
entities.description:
The White Tower Schism began in when the Amyrlin Seat Siuan Sanche was deposed and stilled by a group of Sitters and others led by Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan. The action led to fighting among sisters and Warders in the White Tower and those sisters opposed to Elaida fleeing to Salidar. The Salidar Rebels set up their own Hall of the Tower, which eventually elected Egwene al'Vere as Amyrlin. Therefore, there were during this period two rival power structures, one in the Tower and one in Salidar, each with its own Amyrlin, Keeper of the Chronicles, Sitters, Mistress of Novices, and Ajah Heads.

While both groups lacked one of the seven Ajahs, they each treated the situation differently. In the Tower, Elaida dissolved the Blue Ajah, so the Blue seats and the blue portions of the symbols of the Tower and the Hall were removed. In the Rebel Hall, three empty red benches were present at every sitting. This difference generally had no effect on voting thresholds because (aside from votes to raise an Amyrlin, which are unique), the matters voted on in the books' events were lesser consensus issues, which do not require each Ajah to be present. The smaller size of the Tower Hall was relevant because it allowed it to raise Egwene to the Amyrlin Seat with only 11 Sitters present, which wouldn't have been possible before.

{| class="wikitable" ! Role ! Pre-Schism ! Tower Hall ! Rebel Hall ! Post-Schism

Each Hall comprised 18 Sitters, while a normal Hall would have 21. Elaida declared the Blues disbanded, reducing the size of her Hall by three. As no Reds joined the rebellion, there simply were none available to serve in the Rebel Hall.

entities.name: Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere
entities.description:
The Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere is the central council of the Aes Sedai since the healing of the White Tower Schism. This Hall should not be confused with the Hall Egwene al'Vere also presided during the White Tower Schism.

A significant change from its predecessors operating during the Schism is the inclusion of both Red and Blue Sitters, returning the Hall to 21 members (three for each Ajah). In addition, deaths, other membership changes, and–most notably–the revelation that some members of both Halls were Black Ajah left only the Brown Ajah to return the same three Sitters who sat when Siuan Sanche was deposed, the otherAjahs were able to return two same Sitters, but the Red changed all of their three Sitters.

The Amyrlin Seat presides over sittings, and her Keeper of the Chronicles announces her entrance. Egwene's Keeper of the Chronicles is Silviana Brehon, a Red. The hall comprises 21 Sitters, three from each Ajah. Under a law adopted during the events of Towers of Midnight, all members (as well as the Amyrlin) must be informed of a sitting, and the Ajahs must appoint a surrogate when a Sitter leaves the Tower.

entities.description:
Escaralde Hamdey is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and has been elected as a Sitter in the Salidar Hall, despite being too young.

Escaralde is very short but seems to loom by sheer force of will. She is 4'10, which is inches shorter than Nisao Dachen.

She is stubborn and would refuse to believe that she could not do or learn anything, until she proved it to her own satisfaction. She insisted on trying to learn to make ter'angreal despite lacking the sufficient strength.

Escaralde is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

entities.description:
Faeldrin Harella was an Aes Sedai from the Green Ajah.

She has cool eyes and thin braids in her dark hair adorned with colored beads. She is 5'4" or 163 cm in height.,Faeldrin Haralla|comp}}

Faeldrin is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of .

Merana Ambrey feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, even though she is its appointed leader. Faeldrin, Masuri Sokawa and Rafela Cindal are the three strongest sisters in the group. She is strong enough to Travel.

entities.description:
Bera is a stocky Andoran with a square face. She looks like a farmwife with short brown hair and brown eyes, and would have been mistaken for a farmwife if not for her agelessness. Despite this, she has a sternness and strength of character equal to that of her Green colleague Kiruna Nachiman.

She has a One Power strength of , placing her close to the very top of the Aes Sedai hierarchy. Among the rebel faction, only Romanda Cassin and Lelaine Akashi surpass her in strength, and only Sheriam Bayanar and Kiruna Nachiman are her equal., various entries}} She is strong enough to Travel.

She went to the Tower in at the age of 15. After spending only four years as Novice and four as Accepted. During this time, she and Kiruna were pillow friends. Alhough both enjoyed men exclusively later, they remained the very closest of friends.

Bera was raised to the shawl in the year at the age of 23 - an almost unprecedented young age.

entities.description:
Yukiri Haruna is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower., Yukiri Haruna|Yukiri}} During the White Tower Schism, Yukiri voted to depose Siuan Sanche and replace her with Elaida a'Roihan, although she soon came to regret the decision in light of Elaida's growing incompetence.

Yukiri and a group of other Sitters formed the Black Ajah Hunters after Elaida grew deeply suspicious of Alviarin Freidhen, and were able to independently confirm the existence of the Black Ajah. She eventually began to work with Egwene al'Vere when she was held in the White Tower and reduced to a novice, and remains one of most senior sisters in the Tower.

Yukiri has green eyes and a small frame and is described as 5 feet tall, slight and slender. Egwene al'Vere thinks she is one of the shortest women she has ever met.

Despite her lack of height, she manages to comport herself as regally as any Queen. When frustrated, however, she can relapse into the farmer's accent of her youth. During negotiations and mediations she has been known to use her native accent as a way to unbalance the other parties as the contrast can leave them confused.

entities.name: Mailaine Harvole
entities.description:
Circa , Mailaine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

It is highly likely that Mailaine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of , because from a letter dated , it is stated that after the stilling of Lideine Rajan, Mailaine ceased her resistance and led her followers to kneel.

It is not known if also Mailaine was stilled or instead enrolled in the White Tower.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner during the Battle of Dumai's Wells by the Asha'man.

Seaine is a Murandian with watery blue eyes and thick black hair and eyebrows.

Seaine is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel. Among the Black Ajah Hunters, however, she is the weakest.

Seaine is the daughter of a furniture-maker from Lugard. All her family are now long dead.

entities.description:
Corele Hovian is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is a pretty Murandian, 5' 5 1/2" tall, with blue eyes, thick eyebrow and a mass of raven black hair that give her always a wild appearance no matter how neatly she dressed. The tip of her nose turned up.

She is boyishly slim with a perpetual smile. She always seems amused and often has a joking way of speaking. Corele has a lilting voice.

Corele is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Illeisien is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

Illeisien is the leader of five Aes Sedai who accidentally encountered Tenobia Kazadi on her way out of Saldaea. She is described as being intent on secrecy - more so then Tenobia herself.

This group is uncommited to any faction - loyalist or rebel - so they are not Red nor Blue Ajah; they accompany Tenobia south. Category:Unaligned sisters Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

entities.name: Jezrail
entities.description:
Jezrail is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

Jezrail does not show too much deference to Katerine Alruddin, so she can't be too weak. Because Katerine's level of strength is , it can be guessed that Jezrail level could be between and in the top ten levels of the recent Aes Sedai hierarchy and enough to open alone suitable gateways for Traveling.

Jezrail almost married a young man before she came to the White Tower. She still keeps a miniature of him and speaks fondly of him, even though his grandchildren would be grandparents now. That would probably make her over one hundred years old, likely even older.

She prevents Katerine from using the One Power to punish Egwene al'Vere when she makes a display in a novice class by splitting her weaves fourteen ways, a deed that impressed Jezrail. She grabs Katerine's wrist and admonishes her for going too far, as Egwene was in danger of being injured. Jezrail also seems to dislike anything related with forkroot.

entities.name: Eldrith Jhondar
entities.description:
Eldrith was plump, with a round face. Asne Zeramene claimed that drab attire suited her.

Eldrith was strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . Even with such strength, she was only third strongest among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, with Liandrin Guirale and Marillin Gemalphin being stronger.

Eldrith was 116 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After twelve years as a Novice and seven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in 920 NE.

She was a little vague; considering her relative strength she could have risen faster as a student, but she was much too dreamy and absent-minded even then.

entities.name: Tesien Jorhald
entities.description:
Tesien Jorhald was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

Her name indicates that she was likely from Tarabon as no other names ending in "hald" are from anywhere else (see Geofram Bornhald, Aludra Nendenhald, Androl Genhald, Tazenia Nerenhald).

In traditional Red Ajah custom, she forced Pevara Tazanovni to give up being friends with Seaine Herimon once Pevara was raised to the shawl. This may indicate she was Highest of the Red Ajah at the time, but not necessarily so.

entities.name: Josaine
entities.description:
Josaine was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

She had remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Several years ago, Josaine found an angreal and kept it to herself. Alviarin Freidhen ordered Elaida a'Roihan to personally search Josaine's room, as well as Adelorna Bastine's, as Adelorna had removed an angreal from the storeroom without permission.

When Elaida found the angreal, she was to give stiff punishments to both sisters. At the same time, Alviarin ordered Elaida to reward Doraise Mesianos, Kiyoshi and Farellien (a Brown, a Gray and a Yellow), which will make it seem as if the latter three had exposed the former two. Elaida wanted to know why Alviarin was ordering this, as it would create dissension between the Ajahs.

Kairen Stang was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Kairen Stang}}

She was described as being beautiful, with an oval face and icy blue eyes. She is 5'4 tall.

Kairen was of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

She is the third weakest among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Berenicia Morsad and Valinde Nathenos being weaker and Demira Eriff being her equal. She is, however, only slightly weaker than Merana Ambrey and several others.

Vayelle is 86 years old and has been Aes Sedai for 44. She was born in 914 NE and went to the White Tower in . After spending thirteen years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 956 NE.

She was part of the White Tower secret expedition who were to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Moria is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

entities.name: Rashima Kerenmosa
entities.description:
Rashima Kerenmosa (c. 1150 - ) is one of the most decorated and famous Aes Sedai since the Breaking of the World. She is considered a hero by the Green Ajah, one of their greatest and, alongside Caraighan Maconar, the symbol of all it means to be a Green sister.

Rashima was born circa , during the Trolloc Wars. She went to the White Tower around and spent five years as a novice and five years as Accepted. She was raised to the Green Ajah around . In , she became the Amyrlin Seat, the most powerful position on the continent. While all Amyrlins during the Trolloc Wars had been more martial than their peacetime counterparts, Rashima took this to new extremes. She served directly as a general and battle leader, rather than relying on advice from a Warder or general. She fought in person rather than relying on others. Rashima is credited with restoring morale to the faltering Ten Nations after the destruction of Aridhol and Manetheren, with Trolloc armies ranging as far south as Barashta on the Sea of Storms.

Rashima led the defense of Tar Valon when the Trollocs broke into the city and partially razed it circa . She began diplomatic and military overtures that led to a string of major victories for the Ten Nations over the next ten years, most notably at Kaisin Pass, the Sorelle Step, Larapelle, and Tel Norwin. Rashima's efforts culminated at the Battle of Maighande in , where the nations achieved a decisive victory over the Trollocs. Although not the final victory—tracking down and destroying all the remaining Trolloc bands would take another fifty years—it broke the back of the Shadowspawn invasion.

Rashima died during the battle, along with her five Warders. Around their bodies a wall of Trolloc and Myrddraal corpses was found, along with the bodies of no fewer than nine Dreadlords. This proves that she must have been very strong in the One Power.

entities.description:
Reiko Kerevon is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is stout with long, dark hair in which she wears silver bells.

With a One Power strength level of , Reiko is very weak for an Aes Sedai and therefore stands very low in their hierarchy. She is the third weakest Aes Sedai we know of, with only Marris Thornhill and Daigian Moseneillin beign weaker.

Reiko is an Arafellin. She was born in and is 173 years old.

entities.description:
Temaile Kinderode was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and one of Liandrin's group of Black sisters.

She was a fox-faced Cairhienin with very big blue eyes and shoulder-length dark hair. She was 5'2" (158 cm) in height and appeared fragile, like a pretty child.

Despite her innocent appearance, she was a complete sadist and enjoyed hurting people physically and emotionally.

Temaile has a One Power strength of . This is relatively strong for an Aes Sedai.

entities.name: Gerra Kishar
entities.description:
Gerra held the position for thirty-seven years until her death in . She was the successor of Shein Chunla, and Varuna Morrigan's predecessor.

She was later on considered an Amyrlin as successful as Sereille Bagand, one of the greatest Amyrlins, but instead of iron will, Gerra used political prowess to turn the different groups of the Hall of the Tower against each other.

She was elected partly because her mild personality was so much in contrast to her predecessor, that many Sitters thought to be able to control her, and partly because Gerra was among the ringleaders of the coup that toppled Shein Chunla, which should have given the others some clue as to how biddable she would be.

Anyway she used her skills as a negotiator and mediator to play factions against each other, and an attempted coup against her was crushed utterly.

entities.description:
Kiyoshi is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is a stickler for punctuality and neatness.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Alviarin Freidhen suggests that Elaida a'Roihan reward her, along with Farellien and Doraise Mesianos, while simultaneously punishing Josaine and Adelorna Bastine, who held objects of the One Power without the Tower's permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs.

Kryalyn is the second-in-command of Aelidas as part of the White Tower's mission against Mazrim Taim when he declares himself to be a False Dragon.

entities.description:
She is short and toad-like. She has curly hair.

It is likely that she is a librarian, as Egwene al'Vere thinks of her as one of the Brown sisters who spent her life "roaming the back library stacks and only surfaced once a century or so to recite instructions to prospective Amyrlins". Once a century is likely an exaggeration, but the rest is possibly true.

She instructs Egwene on the proper procedure when going through the raising of a new Amyrlin Seat. Egwene had never met her before.

entities.description:
Lannis was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah and an ancient scholar who wrote about the Forsaken., Lannis}}

When Egwene learns that Mesaana hides in the White Tower camouflaging herself to a sister, she asks Yukiri and Saerin to find and learn everything about Mesaana in the library of the Tower. Saerin mentions Lannis:

"The only other thing I could find of relevance, Mother, was a curious reference from the Blue scholar Lannis, who indicated that Mesaana was second only to Demandred in sheer anger. Not hate. Anger. Lannis thought Mesaana was angry – at herself, at the world, at the other Forsaken– because she wasn't one of those at the forefront. That could make her very dangerous.".

entities.name: Annoura Larisen
entities.description:
Annoura Larisen is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and the Aes Sedai advisor to Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron, the First of Mayene.

She has dark hair, braided in the Taraboner style with dozens of long thin braids, a broad face, a wide mouth, a beak of a nose, and the typical ageless Aes Sedai look. She could have a pleasant smile. She has a stocky build. When nervous, she rubbed her thumbs with her forefingers. She is about 5'4 tall., Annoura Larisen|comp}}

She could be very self-effacing, fading into the background so others failed to notice her. She could appear distracted by things that didn't seem important, but she never was - not really. Towards non-Aes Sedai, she displays the typical Aes Sedai confidence and unflappability, manipulating Colavaere Saighan into thinking she was going along with her plan and met secretly with Masema Dagar.

Annoura was very weak in the One Power with a strength level of . The Companion says she is "very self-effacing, fading into the background", which would match being very low in their hierarchy. Merana Ambrey also believes that "Annoura should have been having the harder time with Cadsuane by far", indicating Annoura would be far below her own strength. With regards her ability to Travel, see Errata/Speculation below.

entities.description:
She is quite striking with dark hair in thin beaded braids that fall to her waist. Yukiri Haruna thinks she is fairly modest, for a Yellow.

She was born in in Tarabon and was enrolled in the White Tower in .

She is secretly a member of the Black Ajah and a member of a Heart along with Marris Thornhill and Karale Sanghir. She is Talene Minly's extra contact outside of her Heart.

Elayne recalls that the Stone of Tear was created using the One Power and that Atuan says that such a feat was impossible for the White Tower today.

entities.description:
She was Comarra Zepava's successor and Doniella Alievin's predecessor.

She was a strong Amyrlin who increased the Tower's influence and prestige. Her skillful negotiations ended many wars and effected many treaties.

She died in Altara after negotiating the end of a civil war there. Somehow her corpse was seized by Whitecloaks who hanged it as a final affront.

Her image at the gallows decorates an alcove in the Dome of Truth in the form of fresco

entities.name: Librarian
entities.description:
A librarian is a person who professionally works with information management. The professional duties of librarians encompass a wide range of activities, including the provision of access to information, the conduct of research, the creation and management of information systems, the creation, leadership, and evaluation of educational programs, and the provision of instruction on information literacy to users.

The role of the librarian has evolved significantly over time, particularly in the past century, which has witnessed the emergence of numerous media and technologies. From the earliest libraries in the ancient world to the modern information hub, there have been individuals responsible for the maintenance and dissemination of information stored in data repositories. The roles and responsibilities of librarians vary considerably based on factors such as the nature of the library, the librarian's area of expertise, and the functions essential for the maintenance of collections and their accessibility to users.

Education for librarianship has undergone a transformation over time, adapting to the evolution of its roles and responsibilities.

entities.name: Evanellein Lorn
entities.description:
Evanellein Lorn was an Aes Sedai and a sitter of the Gray Ajah, who was also secretly of the Black Ajah.

She wore a low neckline at Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's meeting. Elaida thought that she was too concerned with clothes and her own looks to seem a Green instead than a Gray. She was quite pretty, though not among the most beautiful of the Aes Sedai. She was tall, with a medium build, and dark brown hair which she wore in ever-changing styles and thought was one of her best features.

She worried about the size of her bottom, though her worries were all in her head. She was very concerned about whether men and women saw her as beautiful - but she was more concerned about women's opinions. She often wore the latest fashions, though only when she found them flattering. She preferred low-cut dresses, as she liked the shape of her bosom.

Evanellein is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

entities.description:
Catala held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Kiyosa Natomo's successor and Elise Strang's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Her resignation and retirement were, supposedly, of free will. The fact is that she was guarded until her death in . She had been a strong Amyrlin.

When she retired, approximately half the Hall resigned. These events were caused by one rebellion buried in the Tower's secret records.

Igaine held the position for forty-four years until her death in . She was Cerilla Marodred's successor and Beryl Marle's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Igaine was an Amyrlin of average strength and influence. She was chosen in large part because she would lead the White Tower away from the open involvement in the world's affairs that her four predecessor had espoused.

Around 500 NE, during Igaine's reign, the last traces of the nation of Caralain vanished.

entities.description:
Haesel Lusara is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah from Murandy, Haesel Lusara}}

Haesel is not particularly pretty, average in face and figure, but has a vivacity that makes most people see her as pretty.

About 5'4" tall, she is neither slim nor stout. Her black hair is worn in an elaborate braid that hangs halfway down her back, with the braiding running onto the top of her head. She has black eyes.

In "The Wheel of Time Companion" Haesel level of strength is described as , which is a quite high level in the Aes Sedai hierarchy.

entities.name: Larissa Lyndel
entities.description:
Larissa Lyndel was an Aes Sedai from the Yellow Ajah. She was also secretly part of the Black Ajah.

She was a bony woman whose "plainness almost overcame Aes Sedai age-lessness".

Larissa is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she would have an above-average ability in Healing.

entities.name: Mabriam en Shereed
entities.description:
Mabriam is one of the few historical Aes Sedai to be given a strength rating in The Wheel of Time Companion. She was exceptionally strong in the One Power, with a level of . This is the same strength as Cadsuane, with no sister being as strong in the last thousand years. Even given the decline in strength of Aes Sedai since her lifetime, she was still likely high in the hierachy, not that much weaker than the Forsaken who were uncommonly strong even during the Age of Legends.

History records that in addition to being a natural negotiator, she was Ta'veren; able to guide events around her to bend the pattern to her design.

During the late second or early third century After the Breaking, Mabriam proposed to the rulers of the nine other vast countries spanning the Westlands that they sign a formal treaty of alliance binding them together against the threat of the Shadow.

Through Mabriam's ta'veren nature and Aes Sedai help in the negotiations, the Compact of the Ten Nations was signed in . The Compact would stand for over eight hundred years and help the kingdoms fight the Trolloc Wars, although the wars would eventually overwhelm and destroy half of the kingdoms. The other half would collapse following the end of the wars and new nations would later arise.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Caraighan Maconar
entities.description:
With a strength in the One Power of , Caraigan is the strongest Aes Sedai whose strength is given in the Wheel of Time Companion. Three thousand years later, she would be matched by Nynaeve al'Meara. If either Sharina Melloy or Talaan din Gelyn become Aes Sedai, they will surpass her. It is not known if Caraighan was the strongest Aes Sedai of the Third Age or if any other Aes Sedai were as strong sometime between her lifetime and Nynaeve, except that none have come close in more than a thousand years.

Caraighan was born in in an unknown nation during a time of great change and consolidation. The Compact of the Ten Nations had been signed only three years before her birth and the great city of Tar Valon had just completed its long construction seven years before that. Indeed, the calendar marking these dates had only just been adopted a decade or so previously.

Although an organisation of Aes Sedai under Elisane Tishar had existed for some time before this, Caraighan would have belonged to one of the first generations of girls to have attended the White Tower as a novice. She would have been living at the same time as the similarly famous Aes Sedai Mabriam en Shereed and the False Dragon Raolin Darksbane. Birgitte Silverbow also had an incarnation around the time of Caraighan's birth.

Along with Rashima Kerenmosa and Cadsuane Melaidhrin, she is considered the greatest of the Green Ajah's heroes. According to the her entry in the glossary she was "the heroine of a hundred adventures, credited with exploits that even some Aes Sedai consider improbable despite their inclusion in the records of the White Tower." These exploits included:

entities.name: Juilaine Madome
entities.description:
Juilaine Madome is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

She is attractive with short-cut black hair and dark eyes. She is 5'7" (170 cm) tall.

Juilaine has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Juilaine was born in . She was born with the spark and was a tomboy when she was found, climbing trees, running in the streets and wearing boy's clothes much more often than dresses.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Juilaine Madome is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

entities.name: Maenadrin
entities.description:
Maenadrin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Maenadrin and Negaine were surprised to see Egwene al'Vere in the Brown Ajah quarters very late at night. In reality, Egwene had been following her usual path to the novice quarters and was just as surprised to see the Brown sisters on reaching what she thought was her destination. This confusion was a result in a shift in the Pattern which had swapped the locations of part of the novice quarters with a portion of those belonging to the Brown Ajah.

The swap occured without any of those inside the affected areas feeling any motion or vibration. Maenadrin, along with the other Browns in the same situation, continued to live in her old room in the middle of the novice quarters as the alternative would have been to be squeezed into a much smaller and basic accommodation provided to a novice.

entities.name: Maerin
entities.description:
Maerin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Her tent is large and extravagant, filled with lots of furniture and carpets. She is thought of as one of the Aes Sedai who "were not accustomed to austerity." Few brought as much to the battlefield as she.

Her number of Warders is unknown, but due to the amount of luggage she brought, she likely has several.

As part of Gawyn Trakand's efforts to protect his Ward, Egwene al'Vere, the Amyrlin Seat, he has her sleep in different tents every night, and during the initial White Tower offensive into the Shadow-dominated Kandor, Egwene stays for one night in her tent.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Maerin is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

entities.name: Maigan
entities.description:
Maigan is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Maigan}}

Her name suggests she is from Andor as we know another Maigan who is Andoran.

She is beautiful with a long face, large eyes, and full lips, and is "elongated" somehow but not very tall.

Maigan seems to be a very influential sister, chosen by the Blue Ajah as a substitute to Anaiya, killed by Aran'gar, as a member of Egwene's advisory council. She has the same level of strength in the One Power, , as three others in Egwene's council: Myrelle, Morvrin, and Carlinya.

entities.short_description: Maigan is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah., Maigan}}

entities.name: Jarna Malari
entities.description:
Jarna Malari (pronounced: JAHR-nah MAL-ah-ree) was an Aes Sedai and Sitter for the Gray Ajah and secretly head of the Black Ajah.

She had liquid brown eyes and long black hair which was going white at the temples., Jarna Malari|Jarna Malari}} She was 5'6" or 168 cm in height.

She was well-loved and respected by many Aes Sedai, seen as a model of virtue with a saintly reputation.

Sometime prior to the Aiel War, she was made a Sitter for the Gray Ajah. She was also appointed head of the Supreme Council of the Black Ajah at an unknown point.

entities.short_description: Jarna Malari (pronounced: JAHR-nah MAL-ah-ree) was an Aes Sedai and Sitter for the Gray Ajah and secretly head of the Black Ajah.

entities.name: Aledrin Malenry
entities.description:
Aledrin Malenry is an Aes Sedai and for a while a Sitter of the White Ajah in the Rebel Hall of the Tower.

She has dark golden hair, worn in a net instead of the typical Taraboner braids, and liquid brown eyes. She is very plump and has a dress with wide white sleeves and a snowy panel on the front that accentuates her berth . Egwene thinks that she is quite lovely when she smiles, though Romanda thinks that she falls short of pretty but she has a good head on her shoulders.

As an Accepted, she was considered excitable. This seems to have changed by the time she became Aes Sedai. Though an exemplar of White logic, she also has a degree of practicality and worldliness foreign to most Whites. These may have weighed against her becoming a Sitter any other time, but these were considered useful qualities for a Rebel Sitter.

Aledrin is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

entities.short_description: Aledrin Malenry is an Aes Sedai and for a while a Sitter of the White Ajah in the Rebel Hall of the Tower.

entities.name: Maralenda
entities.description:
Maralenda is an Andoran Aes Sedai of noble origin, in the rebel camp near Tar Valon. Therefore, she is not of the Red Ajah.

She is a distant cousin to the House Trakand and Siuan uses the fact that she had been seen talking to Romanda to distract Lelaine and trying to manipulate her.

entities.name: Marasale Jureen
entities.description:
Marasale's name could indicate a Domani origin (see Duhara Basaheen, Saroiya Farseen, Sanaiye Asaheen, and Hafeen Bakuvun).

She was the Amyrlin Seat at the time of Cadsuane Melaidhrin and Romanda Cassin's births.

Marasale held the position for twenty-seven years until her death in . She was Cemaile Sorenthaine's successor and Feragaine Saralman's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She was in large part a puppet of the Hall, chosen because the Sitters thought she would be easily controlled by them. In fact, in large part it happened.

entities.name: Therva Maresis
entities.description:
Therva Maresis is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah and has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She has a long nose. She is slim, and has yellow-slashed riding skirts and a cloak edged in yellow.

She is excitable by nature, and it was considered a bad sign if she ever looked calm and serene.

Therva is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

entities.name: Beonin Marinye
entities.description:
Beonin is a pretty Taraboner with dark honey-colored hair in a multitude of braids and blue-gray eyes so big they made her appear startled. She has a heavy accent.

She was usually quiet and watched everything carefully. Like Morvrin, she required a great deal of proof before believing anything.

Beonin has a strength in the One Power of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. She is equal strongest among those we have information on in the Gray Ajah among the rebel faction. The Sitter Kwamesa Taramasu is her equal. The only others that are close are Merana Ambrey and Meidani Eschede at level , both of whom are conveniently sent on missions away from Salidar. She is the weakest of the Salidar Six, but not by much.

Beonin was born in the year in Tarabon. Her mother, Aeldrine Marinye, was a wealthy merchant who traded in dyes despite the disapproval of her grandmother. Her grandmother, Collaris, was a noted advocate in Tanchico and instilled a love of the intricacies of law into the young Beonin.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Marith Jaen
entities.description:
Marith Jaen was Amyrlin Seat from to . She was raised from the Blue Ajah.

Born in , she went to the White Tower in . She is described in the Companion as being a "stainless-steel bitch".

She retired to the country in when Tamra Ospenya was raised Amyrlin Seat. It was speculated that she did so because of personality clashes with Tamra, and because she wanted to be Amyrlin instead. Her stated reason was that she wished to write her memoirs.

After the death of Sierin Vayu in , Marith was called from retirement to take the Amyrlin Seat. The Hall felt they had no choice, as both Tamra and Sierin had died suddenly, as had many senior sisters (as part of the Black Ajah's efforts to find the Dragon Reborn for themselves).
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Marith Jaen was Amyrlin Seat from to . She was raised from the Blue Ajah.

entities.name: Beryl Marle
entities.description:
Beryl Marle held the position for thirteen years until her death in . She was Igaine Luin's successor and Eldaya Tolen's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Beryl is described as a weak Amyrlin, a compromise candidate chosen after the Hall had deadlocked on others; she turned out to have little interest in the world at all, so the Tower's influence waned considerably during her rule.

During her reign, the Tower's last known Dreamer prior to Egwene al'Vere, Corianin Nedeal, died.

entities.name: Cerilla Marodred
entities.description:
Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien, given that her surname ends with the common Cairhienin ending -dred.

Cerilla held the position for twenty-two years until her death in . She was Ishara Nawan's successor and Igaine Luin's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Cerilla was a moderately strong Amyrlin. She negotiated the White Tower's way out of the situations in which her predecessor had enmeshed it. Her strength and influence came in large part from her ability to do that. In most other ways the Hall ran the White Tower and the Aes Sedai.

Despite Cerilla's interest and passion laying in the outside world, the Tower influence over the continent began to decline once more during her reign.

entities.name: Marthera
entities.description:
Marthera is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

During the Seanchan attack on the White Tower, Marthera stands with Josaine and Adelorna Bastine to fight the invaders. The group is defeated within minutes (Josaine dies and Adelorna is forced to flee) and Marthera is taken captive by the Seanchan and gets an a'dam placed around her neck. entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Annharid Matoun
entities.description:
She is about 5'5" tall, with coppery skin, dark brown eyes and black hair. She is a little stocky, but not heavy.

A forceful woman, not particularly arrogant for a Yellow, but strong-willed and determined, she did not suffer fools gladly

Annharid is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

Being of the Yellow Ajah also means that she has some skill with Healing.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: She is about 5'5" tall, with coppery skin, dark brown eyes and black hair. She is a little stocky, but not heavy.

entities.name: Mayam Colona
entities.description:
Mayam Colona is a Tairen Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has no Warder.

Mayam is slim, 5'6 tall, with dark skin, black eyes and black hair. She still lacks the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

She could eat as much as she liked without gaining a pound.

Mayam has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mayam Colona is a Tairen Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has no Warder.

entities.name: Joline Maza
entities.description:
Joline Maza is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders, Blaeric Negina and Fen Mizar.

Joline is slender and pretty, with large brown eyes. She is taller than Merilille.

Joline is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She is relatively skilled in the Aes Sedai method of Healing, at least better at it than Teslyn.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Joline Maza is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Green Ajah. She has two Warders, Blaeric Negina and Fen Mizar.

entities.name: Cabriana Mecandes
entities.description:
Cabriana Mecandes was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She had long golden hair and pale blue eyes, which was fairly rare for a Tairen.

Cabriana was very weak in the One Power, with a strength in the One Power of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing. Moiraine describes her as "not very strong at all".

Cabriana has the Talent of fast learning., Cabriana Mecandes}}
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Cabriana Mecandes was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

entities.name: Rosara Medrano
entities.description:
She is tall, with brown skin and black hair.

Rosara has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Rosara was one of the sisters in Cadsuane's group in Cairhien.

When Cadsuane went to Far Madding in search of Rand, she left Rosara and other sisters to keep an eye to the situation there, under the leadership of Samitsu Tamagowa.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: She is tall, with brown skin and black hair.

entities.name: Megda
entities.description:
Megda is a Tar Valoner Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. Her Warder is Maynard.

Megda is a slender woman with fiery red hair, green eyes, and pale skin.

She was known to be in Tobin's Hollow in Toman Head during the Seanchan attack in the region, after learning of rumors about women using the One Power to harm others. While in the region, she was able to convey messages by use of a ter'angreal.

She was taken as damane by a sul'dam named Tumva. Her messages stopped, which alerted the attention of Nadira Sedai. She manages to escape and be reunited with Maynard when Falme is attacked by the Heroes of the Horn.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Megda is a Tar Valoner Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah. Her Warder is Maynard.

entities.name: Meilyn Arganya
entities.description:
Meilyn Arganya was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She had one Warder named Andro.

She was a tall woman with silver-gray hair, a thrusting chin, a smooth face, and "startling" blue eyes.

She was exceptionally strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength of . Except for Cadsuane Melaidhrin, she was the strongest channeler the White Tower had seen in six hundred years.

She went to the White Tower in at the age of 16. She spent 7 years as a novice and 6 as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in at the age of 29.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Meilyn Arganya was an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She had one Warder named Andro.

entities.name: Melare
entities.description:
She is a plump Andoran with ample hips, bright blue eyes,and thick black eyebrows. Her mouth looks like she is ready to smile.

She is a slightly atypical Red sister in that she does not seem to despise men - in fact she sends money back to Andor for her grandnephews' education. This implies that Melare is not a very old Aes Sedai.

Melare, along with Arebis, Desala Nevanche, Zanica, and three other Aes Sedai, were involved in the capture of Leane Sharif at Northharbor. She did not quite approve of Desala beating Leane, even if she was claiming to be Aes Sedai.

She was also sent, along with Pevara Tazanovni, Javindhra Doraille, Desala, Jezrail, and Tarna Feir, to the Black Tower to put the proposition of Red sisters bonding Asha'man as Warders to Mazrim Taim. He has agreed to this. Melare was chosen because she supports her nephews; indicating that, unlike most Reds, she does not hate men.

entities.short_description: She is a plump Andoran with ample hips, bright blue eyes,and thick black eyebrows. Her mouth looks like she is ready to smile.

entities.name: Melvara
entities.description:
Melvara is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. Her supposed Ajah is unknown.

She was first mentioned in Verin Mathwin's book, naming her a Darkfriend. Category:Dreadlords Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Melvara is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. Her supposed Ajah is unknown.

entities.name: Kirin Melway
entities.description:
Kirin held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in . She was Aleis Romlin's successor and Noane Masadim's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Kirin was a quite weak Amyrlin, though not so lacking in influence and strength as her predecessor Aleis. In truth many of the things she did helped pave the way for some stronger Amyrlin to come after her.

Verin Mathwin last made a serious mistake during Kirin's reign. This was probably her choice betwen joining the Black Ajah or die.

Vandene and Adeleas retired at some point durign Kirin's reign, most likely in the late 920s.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kirin held the position for twenty-eight years until her death in . She was Aleis Romlin's successor and Noane Masadim's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

entities.name: Memara
entities.description:
She seems to be a pleasant person, both in appearance and personality. However, she seems very strong-minded, never letting anything stand between herself and her goals. She was also willing to do anything that did not violate the Three Oaths., Memara}}

Memara is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Memara was sent by Alviarin to Queen Tenobia in Saldaea as her personal advisor; her real purpose was to keep the queen under control and lessen Davram Bashere's influence on her, but Memara failed and was unsuccessful in both; she was left behind when Tenobia went to meet the other Borderland rulers.

Elaida intended to have Tenobia kidnapped and brought to the White Tower as King Alsalam and King Mattin Stepaneos; Likely Memara was initially part of this plan.

entities.name: Bonwhin Meraighdin
entities.description:
Bonwhin Meraighdin was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat.

Her name could indicate that she was from Fel Moreina in Esandara, given that -in is a common ending of names in Far Madding of both first names and surnames in the New Era; as common are long surnames.

She was born in FY 738 and was elected Amyrlin from the Red Ajah in , the same year as Guaire Amalasan declared himself as the Dragon Reborn and Bonwhin ruled for more than fifty years, one of the longest reigns in the history of the White Tower.

But finally, her attempt at controlling Artur Hawkwing as a puppet led to disaster. All the Aes Sedai were expelled from Hawkwing's empire and his armies put a nineteen-year-long siege to Tar Valon.

entities.description:
Meramor is one of only three Yellow sisters who accepts Nynaeve al'Meara as a full sister before she is actually raised.

entities.name: Turanine Merdagon
entities.description:
She had straight white hair which fell to her waist. She had a strong face with dark tilted eyes and a hooked nose. She had a memorable deep voice.

Her appearance suggests she may have been Saldaean. This is, however, never confirmed.

Given her white hair, she is likely to have been well over 200 years old at the time of her death. This would place her as having enrolled in the White Tower around the time of Gitara Moroso and several of the Knitting Circle.

She died forty years ago, when Beonin was still Accepted.

entities.name: Nalasia Merhan
entities.description:
She is very weak in the One Power, likely less than level in the One Power, and has been an Aes Sedai for years.

She disappears after Seanchan raid on the White Tower. She is on a shortlist of Aes Sedai that Egwene al'Vere receives when searching for candidates that may be Mesaana. It is likely she was captured by the Seanchan and made damane.

entities.name: Renala Merlon
entities.description:
In the present, Egwene al'Vere sends some Brown Ajah sisters to look for the example of Renala in relation to the divisions within the White Tower.

Egwene in fact considers Renala situation to have been in some way similar to the current one and wants them to look through the history of divisions, hoping that if the Aes Sedai make the connection, they might begin to see that the problems can be solved.

entities.name: Merym
entities.description:
Merym is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is only mentioned in passing and never appears in a scene.

Nothing is known about Merym's strength in the One Power.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She is one in the group of sisters that take Egwene into custody, when she was discovered blocking the harbor with cuendillar weaves.

entities.name: Mesaana
entities.description:
Mesaana (meh-SAH-nah; /mɛˈsɑː.nɑ/), previously known as Saine Tarasind, is one of the thirteen Forsaken who were trapped in Shayol Ghul at the end of the War of Power due to the Dragon's sealing. During the Age of Legends, Saine Tarasind worked as a teacher at Collam Daan. She later organized schools teaching the glories of the Dark One once she turned to the Shadow and took on the name Mesaana.

She is 5'5" tall, looks just short of her middle years, with big watery blue eyes and chin-length dark hair. She has a voice that sounds like chimes. She was pretty rather than beautiful.

She occasionally changes her appearance to that of a shadow, wearing blacks and whites and having eyes and lips of silver.

Her strength in the power is , making her one of the most powerful female channelers ever, only outstripped by Alivia, Semirhage, and Lanfear (prior to having the Finn feed on her).

entities.description:
Sevlana Meseau is a well-known, historical and legendary Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah who Merana thought of as impressive., Sevlana Meseau}} In fact when Bera and Kiruna find themselves confronted with Cadsuane Melaidhrin, Merana thinks that it must be like herself meeting Alind Dyfelle, Sevlana Meseau or Mabriam en Shereed.

entities.name: Doraise Mesianos
entities.description:
Doraise Mesianos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Although unconfirmed, her melodious surname ending in -os suggests an Illianer origin.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Alviarin Freidhen suggests that Elaida a'Roihan reward her, along with Farellien and Kiyoshi, while simultaneously punishing Josaine and Adelorna Bastine, who held angreal and ter'angreal without the Tower's permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs.

entities.name: Mestra
entities.description: She partook in the battle against the White Tower and its allies in Tel'aran'rhiod. She was killed by Egwene al'Vere with a ball of fire. If she was in her own body in Tel'aran'rhiod when she was killed, (which Darkfriends tend to do) her soul would be obliterated. It is likely, however, that she was using one of the stolen dream ter'angreal. Category:Dreadlords Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

entities.name: Talene Minly
entities.description:
Talene Minly was an Aes Sedai and a Sitter. She belongs to the Black Ajah, posing as a sister of the Green Ajah.

She is described as being statuesque with golden hair. She has blue eyes and is beautiful, with a perfect oval face, full red lips, full-bosomed and round of hip. Seaine thought of her as "beauty carved from ice", though this thought came at a time of tension. Talene could be very personable and charming, though she hated deferring to anyone or to be less than another in any way whatsoever.

Talene has a One Power strength of , which is strong for an Aes Sedai.

While she is strong enough to Travel, there is no way she would have been able to learn the weave.

entities.name: Miyasi
entities.description:
She has iron-gray hair and is tall and plump. A stern woman who brooked no nonsense and saw nonsense everywhere.

Having gray hair may indicate that Miyasi is very old, most likely more than two hundred.

Miyasi is very particular and will only eat walnuts if they are whole.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split. She is one of the sisters to hold the shield over Leane Sharif, when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her.

entities.name: Niande Moorwyn
entities.description:
Niande Moorwyn is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Niande Moorwyn}}

She is pale-haired and plump, with a sharp nose and inquisitive gray eyes.

Niande is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Niande is 149 years old, she was born in and went to the Tower in . After thirteen years as novice and twelve as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .

entities.name: Moradri
entities.description:
Rumor has it that her Warders are her two brothers, though no one has dared comment on it to her.

They are described as "handsome", so are likely not old men. Assuming they are her younger brothers and she is no more than 15 years older than them, she is likely not older than 70, but as young as 30.

She reports to Saerin Asnobar about the positions of the Aes Sedai during the Battle of Tar Valon.

entities.name: Gitara Moroso
entities.description:
Gitara Moroso (pronounced: gih-TAH-rah moh-ROH-soh) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, advisor to Queen Mordrellen Mantear of Andor and the Keeper of the Chronicles under Tamra Ospenya.

She was thought to be beautiful, almost voluptuous, with snow-white hair. She also was flamboyant enough for a Green or a Yellow with a fondness for jewelry.

Moiraine Damodred thought her to be always just and usually fair, but kindness never seemed to occur to her.

Gitara is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

entities.name: Berenicia Morsad
entities.description:
Berenicia Morsad is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She is part of the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She is plump and always looks grave. She has a sharp tongue.

Berenicia is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability for the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She is the second weakest in strength among the sisters making up the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn, with only Valinde Nathenos being weaker.
