entities.name: Delana Mosalaine
entities.description:
Delana Mosalaine was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah and one of the Sitters of the Salidar Hall. She was also Black Ajah. Aran'gar, in the guise of Halima Saranov, was posing as her secretary.

Delana was somewhat stout and had an ample bosom. She had pale watery blue eyes and very light - almost white - hair. She was oddly graceful for one so stout. She had a deep voice for a woman, though not masculine. She was 5'6" tall.

She had a disconcerting habit of staring at someone so intently that it seemed nothing else existed. People were said to begin thinking of all the things they had done wrong because of her stare, and to sign treaties just so she would stop staring.

Delana is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

entities.short_description: Amira Moselle was an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah.

entities.name: Daigian Moseneillin
entities.description:
She had pale skin with long black hair and was plump and curvaceous. She wore the kesiera typical of many Cairhienin noblewomen. Hers is described as a moonstone dangling by a thin silver chain. She often wore clothes in the Cairhienin fashion. As the younger daughter of a minor Cairhienin house, she was entitled four stripes of color on her bosom. She added slashes of white to the skirts to represent her Ajah.

Daigian was loved and appreciated by the other sisters. Cadsuane Melaidhrin thinks that she had an excellent mind. She was considered a fine logician, and was extremely persistent and would never quit.

She logically assumed that, being the lowest-ranking Aes Sedai ever, she would have to act as servant when none were around and thus acted quiet and meek among all other sisters. Although she accepted her low rank as an Aes Sedai, she insisted on proper respect from non-Aes Sedai - both channelers and non-channelers. Aside from being stronger than those that would have been rejected by the Tower, other channelers still would be considered relatively untrained.

Daigian is described as exceptionally weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of , the "lowest level at which a woman traditionally was accepted for the Tower to become Aes Sedai". We know of no others as weak as her.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Alanna Mosvani
entities.description:
Alanna was a slender, graceful, and beautiful woman with waves of black hair. She is described as "dark" and "darkly pretty" which means she is likely dark-skinned. She is also described as vulpine.

She was 5'4 1/2" or 164 cm in height.

She was noted for her temper and her sense of humour.

Alanna was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She was strong enough to be able to Travel.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Alanna was a slender, graceful, and beautiful woman with waves of black hair. She is described as "dark" and "darkly pretty" which means she is likely dark-skinned. She is also described as vulpine.

entities.name: Murane
entities.description:
Murane is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

Murane is part of the Red Ajah's mission to capture Mazrim Taim. However, she is also sent by the Black Ajah in order to kidnap Taim before he can be brought to the White Tower and gentled.

entities.name: Musarin
entities.description:
Musarin is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is tall and aging. She has white hair., Musarin}} Her hair color implies she is significantly more than two hundred years old.

She is guarding Leane Sharif when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her in the cells. A bubble of evil erupts and begins to melt Leane's cell. Leane is saved when Gelarna and Musarin pull her out of the cell with weaves of Air. Category:Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower Category:Aes Sedai Category:Channelers

entities.name: Malind Nachenin
entities.description:
Malind Nachenin is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Green Ajah.

Malind is a slightly plump and pretty Kandori with a round face, full smiling lips, and fierce, dark eyes.

Malind is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Malind is 59 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in 957 NE. After spending twelve years as Novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 980 NE.

entities.short_description: Malind Nachenin is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Green Ajah.

entities.name: Kiruna Nachiman
entities.description:
Kiruna Nachiman was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Kiruna was 5'7, statuesque and regal-looking, with dark eyes, a full mouth and a full bosom, and arrogantly beautiful. As a member of the Royal House of Arafel, her queen-like demeanor was hardly surprising.

Kiruna had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. There are very few named Aes Sedai stronger than her. She is certainly strong enough to Travel.

Born in , she was the younger sister of the King of Arafel, Paitar Nachiman. She was supposed to be his favorite sister.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kiruna Nachiman was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

entities.name: Nadira
entities.description:
Nadira is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. Her Warder is Gable.

Nadira was communicating with Megda of the Green Ajah via ter'angreal when the other woman went to Toman Head to investigate claims of women harming others with the One Power. Communication stopped after Megda was taken damane by the Seanchan, which worried Nadira, who went to the village of Aturo's Orchard on the border of Almoth Plain and Toman Head.

Nadira later traveled to Tanchico, where she began investigating the activities of Belyne Sedai, and learned that Megda had been able to escape Falme when the city was attacked by the Heroes of the Horn.

entities.name: Samalin Naerodan
entities.description:
Samalin Naerodan is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and a Sitter in the Salidar Hall., Samalin Naerodan|comp}}

Samalin is a fox-faced Murandian with a mannish stride.

Despite being sharp-faced she has a surprising sense of humour and a bright, clear laugh.

Samalin has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Samalin Naerodan is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and a Sitter in the Salidar Hall., Samalin Naerodan|comp}}

entities.name: Kerene Nagashi
entities.description:
Kerene Nagashi was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and its Captain-General. She was also one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

She was tall and beautiful with short dark hair lightly touched with white. Her eyes were nearly black.

She was reputed to adhere to the strictest letter of the law no matter her own feelings, whether pity or contempt.

Kerene was exceptionally strong in the One Power, with a level of ., Kerene Nagashi|comp}} She stands above Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche, but lower than Cadsuane Melaidhrin. Cadsuane said that "no one had come to the Tower who could match [herself] in a thousand years. No one to match Kerene or Meilyn in almost six hundred." There was "a sharp drop" between Kerene and Moiraine in terms of strength.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kerene Nagashi was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah and its Captain-General. She was also one of Tamra Ospenya's Searchers.

entities.name: Nagora
entities.description:
Nagora is a Cairhienin Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a loyalist contingent. , Nagora}}

She is lean with pale hair worn in a roll on the nape of her neck. She is short of stature and sits very straight as if to make up for her lack of height.

She is one of the few Whites with a Warder.

She is one of the sisters to hold the shield over Leane Sharif, when Egwene al'Vere comes to visit her. She also taught Egwene logic; the lesson turned to how to deal with an aging Warder.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nagora is a Cairhienin Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a loyalist contingent. , Nagora}}

entities.name: Amico Nagoyin
entities.description:
Amico Nagoyin was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and part of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters.

Amico was slender and beautiful, with large dark eyes, long neck, and pale skin.

Amico is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, only Joiya Byir was weaker and Berylla Naron was her equal.

Amico was born in 967 NE and went to the White Tower in 982 NE. She was a novice for six years and Accepted for four, and was raised to the shawl in . Considering Amico's strength and years of training, she can be considered among the "fast learners" in fact she remained in training like strong sisters in the top ranks.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Amico Nagoyin was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and part of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters.

entities.name: Aeldra Najaf
entities.description:
Aeldra is lean with short white hair and coppery skin.

She was born in Arad Doman. Her white hair means she is likely well over 200 years old.

She was raised to Keeper of the Chronicles after Gitara Moroso died in office. Her tenure was rather brief, as the Amyrlin Seat, Tamra Ospenya, passed away less than a year after Aeldra was raised. The next Amyrlin, Sierin Vayu, chose Duhara Basaheen to be Aeldra's successor.

She had a love for pranks as a novice and Accepted. She was a kindly woman in many ways.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Aeldra is lean with short white hair and coppery skin.

entities.name: Bennae Nalsad
entities.description:
Bennae Nalsad is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She has dark hair liberally streaked with gray worn in a silver net, and sharp, blue eyes. She is slender, in a bony way.

Bennae is is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . Along with Caren Endelle and Nisain a'Cowel, she is the joint fourth weakest Aes Sedai about which we have information.

She went to the White Tower when she was sixteen. She spent thirteen years as a novice and eleven years as Accepted before being raised to the shawl. Although her age is not known, judging by her graying hair she is probably more than 200 years old.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Bennae Nalsad is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

entities.name: Adeleas Namelle
entities.description:
Adeleas Namelle was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She was Vandene's older sister., Adeleas Namelle|Adeleas}}

Adeleas was slender and white-haired. She wore her hair at the back of her neck.

Many people had difficulty telling Adeleas and Vandene apart, even though they were from different Ajahs. They did not understand how people could make this mistake. Mat thought they were so alike that they may as well have been twins.

Adeleas is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Adeleas was not strong enough to Travel.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Robert Jordan estate / Tor Books / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Adeleas Namelle was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah. She was Vandene's older sister., Adeleas Namelle|Adeleas}}

entities.name: Vandene Namelle
entities.description:
She is described as being slender and graceful with a straight back and almost white hair, with fine bones and a long patrician face.

Though Adeleas was two years older, the two sisters looked so much alike that they seemed like twins. Many people had difficulty telling Adeleas and Vandene apart, even though they were from different Ajahs. They themselves could not understand the confusion.

Vandene has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She is not strong enough to open a gateway to Travel unaided.

Her potential, given to be , is higher than her actual stength. We are told that women like Vandene and Adeleas who are very close can have similar strengths even if their potentials are different. The tendency would be for the stronger woman to not achieve her full potential as it is impossible for the weaker to exceed their potential. Adeleas only has a strength and potential of , making Vandene still the marginally stronger of the two. Vandene's life span, however, would have been dictated by her potential, not her actual strength.

entities.name: Azille Narof
entities.description:
Circa , Azille was recorded as being one of more than twelve delegates who each sat for their sovereign ajahs (note the lowercase), in negotiations centered around unifying all female channelers of differing allegiances into one indivisible society., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}} It is known that one outcome of these discussions was a decision to establish a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power. It is also known that many decisions made at these conferences were not unanimous and that various dissenting delegates threatened to walk out of negotiations at different times. Azille's allegiances in these discussions is not recorded and the weight of her political influence is unknown.

Fifty-one years later in Azille was recorded as being one of seven women providing assistance and council to Elisane Tishar, herself a former delegate who became the first Amyrlin Seat. This is strong evidence that Azille and her six colleagues represent the founding Aes Sedai who chartered the seven Ajah sisterhoods that would come to define Aes Sedai power and influence.

entities.description:
Berylla Naron is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She was also Black Ajah and part of Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters.

Berylla is lean, almost to scrawniness. She has black hair and dark brown eyes.

Berylla is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . Among Liandrin's group of Black Sisters, only Joiya Byir was weaker and Amico Nagoyin was her equal.

Berylla is 67 years old. She was born in 933 NE and went to the White Tower in 948 NE. After seven years as a novice and five years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

Natasia is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She is Saldaean, with dark tilted eyes, high cheekbones and full lips.

Nearly every flat surface in her room is filled with figurines, small carvings and painted miniatures.

She was known as a lenient teacher, and lectured pedantically.

entities.description:
Valinde is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of . She was by far the weakest among the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn and the only one unable to Travel without linking with another Aes Sedai.

We have no history for Valinde except that she was born in Illian and that she does not have a Warder. No date of birth or training times were included in the Companion for this character, the only member of the Embassy about which we have no such details.

She has joined the Salidar Aes Sedai and was a part of the embassy sent from Salidar to Rand al'Thor in Caemlyn. While in Caemlyn, she stays at an inn called The Crown of Roses.

According to Min, she was very eager to have Rand drive Sammael out of Illian. Min believes that a promise from Rand to try would have convinced Valinde to swear fealty to him - though Melaine scoffed at that idea.

Her strength of will and strong personality helped her manage Tower affairs, making her a strong Amyrlin.

Due to her Japanese-inspired name, it is likely that she hailed from the Borderlands.

Selame held the position for fifty-five years until her death in . She was Deane Aryman's successor and Rabayn Marushta's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

She failed to capitalize on Deane's earlier successes as mediator and negotiator to put an end to the Hundred Years War, and the war continued for another thirty years. Still, she was an Amyrlin of average strength.

entities.name: Corianin Nedeal
entities.description:
She studied Tel'aran'rhiod in detail for at least fifty years, as well as many ter'angreal related to Tel'aran'rhiod and Dreaming, in particular the sleepweaver that Egwene uses to enter Tel'aran'rhiod before her training with the Wise One dreamwalkers and later on by Nynaeve al'Meara, Elayne Trakand, Siuan Sanche, Leane Sharif, and eventually the rest of the Aes Sedai in Salidar. Verin Mathwin found the ring and a collection of her notes only by chance; all records of the ter’angreal had been removed from the official records. Verin thinks that Corianin was a very secretive woman. She kept most of her knowledge to herself, leaving most of what she had learned only in her notes.

This brings into question how much information Corianin withheld from the White Tower in her research. Given that Verin withheld the notes at the same time she was assisting Egwene in her search for members of the Black Ajah, Verin could have been caught between her Black Ajah oaths and the Amyrlin's command to help Egwene (violating which would have also meant violating the oaths). In that case, it is entirely possible Corianin was herself Black Ajah and that her notes proved it, or that somehow the notes, or how she came to possess them, would show Verin to be a Black sister.

entities.description:
Negaine is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She and Felaana Bevaine found Beonin Marinye wandering in Tar Valon and brought her to Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan when she asked to see the Amyrlin Seat.

Negaine and Maenadrin were surprised to see Egwene al'Vere in the Brown Ajah quarters very late at night. In reality, Egwene had been following her usual path to the novice quarters and was just as surprised to see the Brown sisters on reaching what she thought was her destination. This confusion was a result in a shift in the Pattern which had swapped the locations of part of the novice quarters with a portion of those belonging to the Brown Ajah.

entities.description:
Ferane is 5'2" or 158cm in height. She is plump and stout with a mild, round face and the coppery skin of a Domani She has steely black eyes . Her hair is long and black, at times looking like it is in urgent need of brushing.

Despite being a White, she has a fierce temper. She can appear vague as a Brown, and often as untidy, but she can catch the slightest crack in the logic of an argument.

Ferane never lost the skills taught to all Domani girls and has been known to captivate a man's attention whenever she wished. She also has a measure of vanity, evidenced by the relative luxury of her apartment furnishings.

Ferane has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

entities.description:
She is from Tarabon. She has dark hair that she wears in beaded braids and is 5'4" or 163 cm in height; Sarene is considered one of the most beautiful women in the Tower, but she seems totally unaware of her stunning beauty..

When Accepted together, Moiraine thinks Sarene has a sharp tongue that often gets her into hot water, and remarkably little tact, though she seems to be as unaware of what she says as she is of her beauty. Moiraine also thinks Sarene's mother must have been glad to see Sarene's sharp tongue go off to Tar Valon.

Sarene is a typical White. She insists on reasoning logically, and often does not understand matters of the heart. However, Egwene notes that she has a temper, and although she usually keeps it leashed, she can snap your nose off if you put a foot wrong. Sarene will listen to what other people have to say, and is not afraid to admit that she is wrong.

Sarene is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel., Sarene Nemdahl}}

She was raised to the shawl twenty years ago.

It was unknown whether she sided with Elaida, the Rebels or remained neutral during the White Tower Schism.

She did not heed Egwene's advice to remain alert and refrain from being alone due to recent Aes Sedai murders in the Tower.

She doesn't hide the fact that she dislikes teaching Novices and Accepted.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She is plump and blue eyed and as mean as a snake with an itch.

She is sent to collect tributes for Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower and collected a tribute from Aesdaishar in Chachin. Ashmanaille, sent by the Rebel Aes Sedai to do exactly the same thing, was told by the shambayan that the Tower had already collected its tributes, and deduced that the sister from Elaida's Tower was Nesita.

She is one of the Red Ajah who follows Egwene al'Vere around the White Tower and feeds her forkroot. When Egwene tried to refuse the tea, Nesite helped pour it down her throat with a funnel.

She disappeared without a trace after news of Elaida's deposition of Siuan Sanche and her subsequent ascension to the Amyrlin Seat, either returning to Tar Valon, recognizing Elaida, or joining the Rebel Aes Sedai in Salidar.

Present are Demandred, Aran'gar and Osan'gar, as well as Graendal, while Mesaana and Semirhage are absent. Moridin joins late, accompanied by Cyndane. The main topic that is discussed is Rand's plan to cleanse the taint from saidin.

She is small, about 5'2" or 158 cm tall, with waist-length black hair, black eyes, and a dark complexion, but not so dark as a Domani. Her dark eyes seems almost black when she is concentrating.

Ayako prided herself on her logic, but she was not a particularly cool-appearing woman, being rather on the merry side, with a twinkle in her eyes, although she seemed shy, a rarity among Aes Sedai.

Ayako is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

When she is displeased, her disgruntled expression deepened her dimple and makes her look sulky, which she doesn't realize.

Tiana is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

entities.name: Novice book
entities.description:
The novice book is used in the White Tower to officially enroll those who wish to attempt to become Aes Sedai. Once enrolled in the novice book, a novice may not forsake Tower training until she is put out by the Tower or until she attains the rank of Aes Sedai. Though an instrument of administration, nevertheless it is held in great esteem by Aes Sedai.

An age restriction was once in place for those who wished to be written into the novice book, as it was believed that any girl over the age of eighteen was too old to adapt to the discipline. Consequently many times young women lied about their age to be enrolled in the Book, facing severe punishments when discovered. On the other hand in some exceptional cases the same Aes Sedai decided to not respect this rule, for instance when they discovered women with a very great potential, as in the case of Nynaeve who was enrolled and then tested immediately as Accepted at the age of 26, becoming the strongest initiate enrolled in the Novice Book since the time of Caraighan Maconar, almost three thousand years earlier.

When Egwene al'Vere became Amyrlin Seat of the rebel Aes Sedai, she removed this restriction and opened the novice book to women of all ages. Many Aes Sedai with an old mentality, as Romanda, were not convinced about this opening of the Book, until some relatively old women were discovered with a potential even greater than Nynaeve, as Sharina Melloy.

As Amyrlin of the reunified White Tower, Egwene has continued allowing older women to enroll, and currently the number of novices sits at close to one thousand. This is a number which many believe will continue to increase, providing the novice book remains open to all. The oldest novice in the White Tower is 67 years old. The ability to Travel also increases the possibility of finding more women to enroll.

entities.name: Nubei Peldovni
entities.description:
Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest of the group that escaped Dumai's Wells. Therefore, it is likely that Nubei's strength level is beneath , which is Covarla's level.

An Arafellin, Nubei sedai remained loyal during the Tower split. She was sent to Cairhien to kidnap Rand and escaped Dumai's Wells with Covarla Baldene. Along her she took refuge in Dorlan.

Nubei Peldovni is described only in The Wheel of Time Companion, she is never mentioned in the main books of The Wheel of Time. entities.name: Chisaine Nurbaya
entities.description:
Chisaine Nurbaya is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

She was on the White Tower secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor led by Galina Casban.

She was captured by the Asha'man at the Battle of Dumai's Wells.

Chisaine Nurbaya, Janine Pavlara, Innina Darenhold and Vayelle Kamsa are the last four of the prisoners to swear fealty to Rand. They did so under Verin's Compulsion.

entities.name: Nyein Kalede
entities.description:
Nyein has dark skin, hair, and eyes. Like other Sea Folk Aes Sedai, she doesn't wear any jewelry except for her Great Serpent ring.

Outwardly, she is a shy, withdrawn woman.

She is one of the Atha'an Miere and works in the White Tower Library, along with Aiden Shimura and Zemaille Amassa, the other Atha'an Miere Aes Sedai. They tend to stay on the upper levels of the library with the secret records.

At the time of the Dragon Reborn's birth, there were four Sea Folk Aes Sedai in the White Tower, and two of them were almost 300 years old. Nyein is one of the younger two.

entities.name: Beldeine Nyram
entities.description:
Beldeine Nyram was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah.

Beldeine was Saldaean and exhibited the natural traits of the region; namely slightly tilted brown eyes and a nose with a hint of a hook. She also displayed the typical tilted cheekbones, though they were not as pronounced as most Saldaeans. Beldeine's aging slowed more considerably than most other Aes Sedai, which caused her to frequently be mistaken for a young woman no older than twenty.. At 5'5" or 165cm, she was above average in height and stood a hand or more taller than Verin Mathwin.

The Green Ajah quickly noted her keen mind and management ability and marked her as a sister who might perform well as an administrator. Such duties were boring to Beldeine, whose personality sought out adventure whenever possible. Nonetheless, such abilities might explain why Egwene chose her as Keeper in the alternate reality in her Accepted test.

Beldeine was strong in the One Power by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of ., Beldeine Nyram}} She can Travel.

entities.description:
Faolain Orande is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, sworn to Egwene al'Vere.

Faolain is dark of complexion and has a round face and dark curly hair.

Faolain is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power potential of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel.

She has had a suffient length of training to assume she has already reached her full potential.

entities.name: Tamra Ospenya
entities.description:
She was described as having long hair streaked with gray as well as a square face.

Tamra was of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is further evidence that strength is not always a factor when it comes to appointed positions.

She was thought to be fair and always just. She also seemed to be a devious manipulator.

She was raised to Amyrlin Seat from the Blue Ajah in . Her raising to the staff and stole was rumored to be the reason for the retirement of Romanda Cassin and Marith Jaen.

She guards Egwene al'Vere's cell when Seaine Herimon comes to visit her.

entities.name: Janine Pavlara
entities.description:
Janine Pavarla is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

She is 5'3" and plump, with large dark eyes and luxuriant black hair, which she wears pulled into a bun on the back of her neck.

Janine is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was born in and went to the White Tower in 978 NE. After spending eleven years as a novice and nine years as Accepted, she was raised to the Red Ajah in 998 NE. Since she is new to the shawl, she has not yet achieved the ageless look. It was for this reason that she, along with Beldeine Nyram and Marith Riven, was chosen to participate in Rand al'Thor's kidnapping.

entities.description:
Birlen Pena is an Aes Sedai of the Black Ajah. She was first mentioned in Verin Mathwin's book, naming her to be a Darkfriend. It is unknown which of the seven Ajahs she also belongs to, but being in the Tower just before reunification means that she was not a Blue.

She escapes from the White Tower just after Egwene al'Vere becomes Amyrlin Seat, and avoids re-swearing on the Oath Rod.

entities.name: Elza Penfell
entities.description:
She had a pleasant-face with brown hair and eyes. She is 5'5 tall.

She is normally cool, but could become rabid about Rand.

Elza is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

In fact, she was so conscious of her strength that other Aes Sedai felt she thought too much about her place in the hierarchy, when dealing with other sisters.

entities.name: Phaedrine
entities.description:
She is lean and small-boned, with dark hair and brown eyes. Much like the Brown Ajah stereotype, she tends to allow her low quality clothing to fall into disrepair, with tears and stains. She might be considered pretty if not for how much she frowns.

Phaedrine is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

Although she is not strong enough to Travel, she and Shemari linked together were just strong enough to make a barely usable gateway.

She is allied with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

entities.description:
She fought with Egwene al'Vere at the Last Battle. Her Warder and Sleete guarded the area where Egwene, Silviana Brehon, and Gawyn Trakand were fighting in one of the early battles.

Because she has a Warder who is not an Asha'man, she is not Red Ajah. It is also unlikely that she is White because few of them have Warders and probably not Yellow as well because the majority of the Ajah was in Mayene.

She is named after Pia Maria Vaajakallio, a Finnish fan who was one of a number of people involved in a competition to have a character named after them.

entities.description:
Poleine was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around .

Elayna Sedai is raised to Amyrlin Seat while Poleine is away from the White Tower on a foreign mission

She is believed to have been close to uncovering the secret to unlocking a certain Portal Stone. She was later captured by the Black Ajah and rescued by Elayna.

entities.description:
As the Last Battle rages on the border between Kandor and Arafel, Pylar fight alongside the Amyrlin Seat, Egwene al'Vere.

Her status following the Last Battle is unknown, but she is assumed alive.

entities.name: Raemassa
entities.description:
Raemassa is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

She fights in Kandor during the Last Battle, accompanied by Egwene al'Vere, the Amyrlin Seat, Leane Sharif, Lelaine Akashi, Silviana Brehon, Romanda Cassin and a handful of Warders when a huge gateway splits the air and brings hundreds of Sharan channelers onto the battlefield. The Aes Sedai camp is completely routed in the attack.

Her status following this ordeal and the Last Battle is unknown, but lacking other information she is presumed alive.

entities.name: Rahvin's Pet Aes Sedai
entities.description:
Rahvin's Pet Aes Sedai is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah who has just been recently raised to the shawl.

She is quite young with brown eyes and lacks the ageless look of an Aes Sedai.

She had been planted in Andor by the White Tower ruled by Elaida a'Roihan to spy on Morgase Trakand. She was, however, betrayed by someone from the Black Ajah who told Rahvin. He used Compulsion on her to report back what he wanted the White Tower to know.

It is not known what happened to this Aes Sedai after Rand killed Rahvin and conquered Caemlyn.

entities.description:
Circa , Lideine was one of more than twelve women who sat for her ajah (note the lowercase), in discussion of building a new city as a center of Aes Sedai power., Chapter 9, Formation of the White Tower|bwb 9}}

From a letter dated , it is stated that Lideine has since been stilled, along with several of her followers. It is highly likely that Lideine became a renegade Aes Sedai after the talks of .

It appears she was a leader among the Aes Sedai who refused to follow Elisane Tishar, since after her stilling, most of the resistance against Elisane came to a halt.

entities.description:
She is tall and slender. She is seen wearing silver bells embroidered onto her white dress, perhaps suggesting she is Arafellin.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

When Alviarin Freidhen was removed as Keeper of the Chronicles, Alviarin heard Norine Dovarna address Ramesa with a scathing remark about Alviarin. Ramesa seemed to wonder why Norine was addressing her, since they were not friends.

She takes part in the Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod and is seen standing next to Alviarin Freidhen, sending random blasts of Power away from them in order to try and draw Egwene al'Vere into a trap.

If she was with Alviarin, it is likely that she escaped and survived the battle.

entities.name: Alvera Ramosanya
entities.description:
Alvera held the position for twenty-nine years till her death in . She was Eldaya Tolen's successor and Shein Chunla's predecessor.

During her reign, the Aiel gave the Cairhienin a chora sapling in gratitude for the water their ancestors were given by those of the Cairhienin.

Though she tried to establish some measure of leadership, she was a weak Amyrlin. The Hall had been in control of the White Tower with her two predecessors and chose Alvera for that purpose. She died at a young age, she was 248. There is a possibility that she was actually murdered in an attempt to assert some authority.

entities.name: Rand's Aes Sedai
entities.description:
In recent times Aes Sedai divided themselves in many factions. Among these factions was formed a group of sisters that allied themselves directly or indirectly to the Dragon Reborn, under many different circumstances. It can be calculated that the sisters allied to the Dragon were more than eighty, but many of them were turned to the shadow before the Last Battle.

Group of 9 Rebel Aes Sedai (5 Greens, 2 Browns, 1 Gray, 1 Blue) that were forced to swear loyalty to the Dragon after the battle of Dumai's Wells:

This is the group of 22 loyalist sisters (5 Reds, 5 Greens, 5 Whites, 3 Browns, 2 Yellows, 2 Greys) that were captured during the battle of Dumai's Wells and later, when they were captives in Cairhien Aiel Camp, they were persuaded to swear loyalty to the Dragon by Verin utilizing her mild kind of Compulsion:

This is the group of around 50 sisters that were bonded by the Asha'man led by Logain, so they were indirectly allied to the Dragon. The majority of them were probably later turned to the shadow. We know the name of 10 of them:

entities.name: Tsutama Rath
entities.description:
Tsutama Rath (pronounced: tsue-TAH-ma RATH) is an Aes Sedai, a former Sitter and the current Highest of the Red Ajah.

Tsutama is strikingly beautiful, with black luxuriant hair and a full bosom. She would have been considered even more beautiful except that she wears a permanently angry expression that almost overwhelms her agelessness.

She often wears all crimson, so bright that it might have given the most ardent Red pause, and cut tightly, molding her breasts or exposing them as if daring anyone to comment.

She tends to wear lots of jewelry and she is flamboyant and given to indulging herself with luxury and rare and expensive items. It is unclear whether this is how she has always been or this is a result of spending so many years working on a farm with only her basic needs fulfilled.

entities.description:
Aisha Raveneos was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She was stout and had soft, brown eyes. She was a plain-faced woman who wore wore a wealth of jewelry, earrings with large firedrops, long necklaces of both emeralds and rubies, but only the golden Great Serpent for a finger ring.

She was reputed to "adhere to the strictest letter of the law no matter her own feelings, whether pity or contempt".

With a level of , she was very strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai.

entities.name: Red Ajah
entities.description:
The Red Ajah of the Aes Sedai was, for more than two thousand years, dedicated to prevent the wrong and dangerous use of the One Power. In particular the Red sisters dedicated themselves in locating men with the ability to channel saidin (the tainted and very dangerous half of the One Power) and bringing them to the White Tower for gentling.

Red sisters generally do not have friends outside of their Ajah, and upon donning the shawl are often forced to end any friendship with women not also of the Red. Until recent times they bond no Warders, and have been at odds with the Blue Ajah for a millennium. The leader of the Red Ajah is known as the Highest.

For a detailed list of all known members, see List of Red Ajah sisters

During the more than three-thousand year history of the Tower, the Red has always been the largest Ajah. From the founding up until the Trolloc Wars, the overall proportion was much larger than it is now, with between one quarter and one third of all Aes Sedai choosing the Red. During and after the Trolloc Wars, the focus of Aes Sedai as an organisation shifted from curtailing the activity of male channelers to fighting the Shadow at the Blight and the Green Ajah correspondingly began to increase in numbers to almost rival the Red in terms of numbers. Despite this, the Green has never surpassed the Red as the largest Ajah.

Silvane is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of .

Silvane was one of the sisters in Cadsuane Melaidhrin's group in Cairhien.

When Cadsuane went to Far Madding searching for Rand, she left Silvane and other sisters to keep an eye on the situation in Cairhien, under the leadership of Samitsu Tamagowa.

entities.description:
Merean Redhill (pronounced: MEH-ree-an red-hill) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah publically, and secretly a member of the Black Ajah.

She was plump and motherly with graying hair. She was 5'8 tall.

She was very strong in the One Power, with a strength of , only a little below Moiraine's ultimate strength. Few would have been her equal, and even fewer would have surpassed her.

She was Aes Sedai for more than 200 years. She was born in .

entities.description:
Rislyn was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah in a Mirror World.

Rislyn is given charge of the defenses of the White Tower in the absence of the Amyrlin Seat, much to the displeasure of Sephraem.

entities.description:
Marith Riven is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Marith Riven}}

Marith is 5'6" tall and has not yet achieved the ageless look.

Marith is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Marith is 32 years old. She was born in 968 NE and went to the White Tower in 984 NE. Marith spent eight years as a novice and seven as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in 999 NE.

entities.name: Aleis Romlin
entities.description:
Aleis Romlin was an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year .

Her name indicates that she was from Far Madding, "Aleis" being a Far Madding female name, and -in a common Far Madding surname ending.

Aleis held the position for thirty-two years until her death in . She was Sereille Bagand's successor and Kirin Melway's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}} After the death of her predecessor, there was talk of raising Cadsuane Melaidhrin instead of Aleis. Cadsuane, wanting to avoid this, stayed away from the Tower for an entire ten years.

The last judicial stilling of a woman before the deposition and stilling of Siuan Sanche and Leane Sharif took place before , and therefore possibly under Aleis' reign, but the woman's name and her subsequent crime(s) are not known. It is also possible that the last woman or women to be stilled were the ones trying to overthrow Sereille Bagand.

entities.name: Rosil
entities.description:
Rosil is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is slender and tall, with a long neck.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she has the Talent of Healing.

We don't know her strength in the One Power, but she is put in charge of the Aes Sedai manning the Healing station in Mayene during the Last Battle, implying that she holds some high level in the Aes Sedai hierarchy and possesses a high strength in the One Power.

entities.name: Chai Rugan
entities.description:
During the White Tower Schism, she remains a loyalist to the Tower.

Chai is one of thirty-nine sisters sent to escort the Dragon Reborn to Tar Valon. As such, she was present at the Battle of Dumai's Wells, but managed to escape.

She is one of twelve sisters kept in Dorlan in order to prevent word of the Tower's defeat from reaching the city.

She was first mentioned in Verin Mathwin's book, naming her a Darkfriend.

entities.name: Farnah Sadaou
entities.description:
Farnah Sadaou is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah who became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. She replaced Talene Minly., Farnah Sadaou}}

In communications between Encyclopedia Wheel of Time and Brandon Sanderson, Farnah's last name is revealed to be Sadaou. Her last name is not given in The Wheel of Time Companion.

Because she is chosen as a Sitter after reunification, it can be assumed that Farnah has been Aes Sedai for more than one hundred years and is, at least around 130 years old.

Nothing is known about Farnah's strength or ability in the One Power.

entities.name: Coiren Saeldain
entities.description:
Coiren Saeldain is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She is plump and stately. She has a billowing voice.

She is notoriously pompous, bombastic and self-important. She has a mannerism that makes it sound as if she is making speeches or pronouncements every time she speaks. She is, nevertheless, no fool.

Coiren is high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

entities.name: Sanaiye Asaheen
entities.description:
Covarla Baldene obtained command in Dorlan because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai. Sanaiye's strength must therefore be below that of Covarla ().

She was one of the Aes Sedai sent to kidnap Rand in Cairhien. She escaped with Covarla Baldene after Dumai's Wells battle and took refuge in the village of Dorlan.

This Aes Sedai is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.

entities.name: Karale Sanghir
entities.description:
Karale Sanghir is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah. She is also Black Ajah and member of a Heart along with Atuan Larisett and Marris Thornhill.

She is forced to swear on the Oath Rod obediance to Yukiri and the rest of the Black Ajah hunting Sisters. She is adamant that she now walks in the Light again.

After her interrogation, the hunt for the Black Ajah came to a problematic stalemate, since Karale's contact outside of her Heart was with the Rebel Aes Sedai.

Her Warder takes poison and kills himself when he is betrayed by Karale.

entities.description:
Feragaine held the position for twenty-two years until her death in . She was Marasale Jureen's successor and Myriam Copan's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Feragaine was in large part a puppet of the Hall, as her predecessor Marasale, she was chosen because the Sitters thought she was easily controlled by them, in fact in large part it happened.

She made some effort to restore her power and authority but was almost always outmanoeuvred. Her interests as in many from the Blue Ajah lay outside the White Tower and its politics and she floundered badly in the treacherous currents of the Hall.

During her reign the legendary Sereille Bagand was selected as Sitter by the White Ajah, showing her remarkable qualities in a so influential Hall.

entities.name: Sephraem
entities.description:
Sephraem was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah in a Mirror World, where she served as a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower around .

After the unexpected death of the Amyrlin Seat, Sephraem tried to wrestle control from Elayna Sedai, who had been the most recent Keeper of the Chronicles.

entities.name: Serinia
entities.description:
Serinia is an Aes Sedai of an unknown Ajah.

When Jesamyn did not return from Caemlyn, Elayne Trakand sent Serinia to discover what was wrong. She returned with Captain Charlz Guybon only to tell Elayne that Caemlyn had been overrun.

Having been sent to Caemlyn probably means that Serinia is strong enough to open a gateway alone to Travel.

entities.name: Shanelle
entities.description:
Shanelle is slender. She has pale blue eyes and a dark, pretty face.

Shanelle has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

Although she was not particularly strong, Healing was her best Talent by far, and she had a very good ability with it.

She was born not far from Ebou Dar, although we do not know how old she is.

entities.name: Leane Sharif
entities.description:
She has the copper skin of a Domani, and is thin and nearly as tall as a man. She is willowy, graceful, and beautiful. When Min meets her at Tar Valon, she describes her hair straight, dark and only a little longer than Min's own hair.

She lost her ageless look after being stilled, and looked about 23 years old.

As Keeper of the Chronicles, she was brisk and well-organized.

After being stilled and Healed, she was considered very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of . Leane explains that she and Siuan were less than half their original strength and, had they even been as strong as half, "most [in Salidar] would be as strong, and a good many stronger". Siuan, with a strength level of , considered herself so weak that a "no more than middling" sister like Aeldene Stonebridge would expect her to be "holding my tongue until [she] give me permission to speak". Aeldene would be classed as no more than low average and we know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker than Leane.

entities.name: Shawl
entities.description:
The shawl is a vestment worn by all Aes Sedai as an official garment of their rank as full sisters. "Raised to the shawl" is a colloquialism indicating that an Accepted has been elevated to full sisterhood. Although the Great Serpent ring is more widely acknowledged as the symbol of an Aes Sedai, the ring may be worn by Accepted, full sisters, and even women trained by the Tower but who were not raised to sisters for varying reasons. Only full sisters may wear the shawl.

The shawl is commonly described as a piece of fabric edged with a long, silky fringe in the color of an individual sister's Ajah, and with the Flame of Tar Valon set forth in white, which hangs in the center of a sister's back when the shawl is worn. The shawl is worn around the shoulders of an Aes Sedai, or looped over her arms. The shawl is also described as being embroidered with grapevines and flowering apple branches, but the actual color of the fabric from which the shawl is sewn was never revealed.

Before the White Tower Schism, the shawls were rarely worn except on formal occasions. A sister dressed formally would be expected to wear her shawl along with a dress in her Ajah colors. Newly raised sisters also are prone to wearing the shawl frequently, even outside of official occasions. It is speculated that they wear them to demonstrate to their former instructors that they now share a common rank, or that the individual sister wearing it is wearing it as a bit of celebration.

In the wake of later events in the White Tower, with its openly hostile relations between the Ajahs, the Aes Sedai still in Tar Valon wear their shawls whenever they are in mixed groups as a blatant demonstration of their Ajah loyalties, as well as a bit of almost jingoistic pride.

entities.name: Ispan Shefar
entities.description:
Ispan Shefar was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah, and secretly of the Black Ajah.

Ispan was a Taraboner with black hair in a multitude of braids with blue and green beads after the Taraboner fashion.

Ispan was strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of .

She was 109 years old when she died. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as a novice and eight years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in 922 NE.

entities.name: Shemaen
entities.description:
Shemaen is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

During the Aiel War, Shemaen is told by Adelorna Bastine about Gitara Moroso's Foretelling that the Last Battle will come during the lifetime of sisters now breathing. Ellid Abareim overhears this conversation and repeats it to her fellow Accepted, Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche.

entities.short_description: Shemaen is an Aes Sedai of unknown Ajah.

entities.name: Shemari
entities.description:
Shemari is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and a librarian.

Shemari is a vigorous, square-faced woman. She is often too proper in her behavior to the point of seeming to mock those she is greeting; she had been known to curtsy to Egwene from a hundred paces away.

She is quite weak in the One Power, needing to link with another Aes Sedai in order to weave a gateway.

She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

entities.short_description: Shemari is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah and a librarian.

entities.name: Shemerin
entities.description:
Shemerin is plump. She never mastered the outward calmness of the Aes Sedai and so always has a look of strained anxiety in her eyes.

She is a coward, and knows she is. Many sisters thought she was unsuitable to be Aes Sedai, even before Elaida demoted her.

Shemerin is strong in the One Power, with a level of . While there are Aes Sedai stronger in the Power, there are not many. In fact, among the Yellow Ajah we have details on, only Romanda Cassin is stronger and only Desandre Alraed is her equal.

As a member of the Yellow Ajah, she is regarded as a good Healer.

entities.name: Berana Shemon
entities.description:
Berana Shemon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and was elected Sitter in the Rebel Hall of the Tower, despite being too young. She has no Warder.

She is 5'4 1/2 tall, haughty, with big brown eyes cold as snow and dark brown hair. She looks slim compared to Aledrin and has silver-embroidered white skirts.

Berana is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Berana is seventy years old, she was born in the year and went to the Tower in . After spending ten years as Novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .

entities.name: Aiden Shimura
entities.description:
She is round and very dark, even darker than Zemaille. She has black hair and dark eyes.

As with the other Aes Sedai of Atha'an Miere origin, Aiden is relatively weak in the One Power.

Aiden lied about her age when she enrolled as a novice.

She is one of the few Atha'an Miere sisters and works in the White Tower Library, along with Nyein and Zemaille, the other Sea Folk Aes Sedai. They tend to stay alone on the upper levels of the library with the secret records.

entities.name: Masuri Sokawa
entities.description:
Masuri Sokawa is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

She is slim, pretty but not beautiful, and has brown, merry eyes. She always speaks quietly, but unlike many Browns, she always speaks straight to the point.

She is an untypical Brown in that she takes some interest in clothes and men, and likes to flirt, though she could sometimes ignore the man she is flirting with, because of something interesting, such as a book or just a sudden interesting thought.

Masuri is a strong by Aes Sedai standards, with a strength level of .

entities.short_description: Masuri Sokawa is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

entities.name: Marya Somares
entities.description:
She was tall and slender with dark deep-set eyes.

During the Aiel War, Marya held the White Tower's seat on a decision-making council for the Grand Alliance. She was advised by Azil Mareed, a Domani and commander of the Tower Guard. She was the only member of the council to be excluded from field command of the armies of the Alliance, most probably because the aversion to Aes Sedai from the Children of the Light.

She supposedly died in her bed but she was actually killed by the Black Ajah because she was suspected to be aware of their goals and to be one of the sisters chosen by Tamra Ospenya to search for the Dragon Reborn.

entities.name: Melavaire Someinellin
entities.description:
Melavaire Someinellin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Melavaire is a stout, short Cairhienin (inches shorter than Egwene), with flecks of white in her dark hair.

She was kindly, but could be fearsome when angry.

She is likely to be more than 150 years old as she has streaks of white in her hair, a sign of extreme age in an Aes Sedai.

entities.short_description: Melavaire Someinellin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

entities.name: Cemaile Sorenthaine
entities.description:
Cemaile held the staff and stole for twenty-four years until her death in . She was Varuna Morrigan's successor and Marasale Jureen's predecessor.

Cemaile was a ruler of moderate strength and influence at the beginning of her reign, but by the end she was reduced to the role of a very weak Amyrlin, one of the weakest. She had great plans to restore the White Tower influence and greatness, but those went badly awry.

It is recorded only in the secret documents that from till her death she was not more than a puppet in the hands of the Hall, and her Keeper was in fact her guardian appointed there by the Sitters. This role of her Keeper was achieved by the Hall taking advantage of a special secret Tower Law about incapacitated Amyrlins and interpreting it quite extensively.

During her reign, the Tairens ceased collecting items of power: the twisted redstone doorway from Mayene (secretly studied by Aes Sedai) was one of the last items added to the Great Holding.

entities.name: Carlinya Sorevin
entities.description:
Carlinya was 5'5" or 165 cm tall, pale, with cool, almost black eyes and a broad face. After most of her dark hair was fried off in a Tel'aran'rhiod nightmare, she wore it in a cap of dark curls. She was of moderate build, neither slender nor stout.

She was somewhat messy, her hair sometimes being unkempt and her dress edge muddy from forgetting to wear a cloak. She often dressed in white with white embroidery, including a white skirt embroidered with scrolls.

She had a cold manner, seldom showing any sign of emotion. Her rationality made few concessions for human foibles. Or for anyone disagreeing with her. Siuan Sanche thinks she is "A great deal of logic and not much common sense".

With a One Power strength level of , Carlinya was strong by Aes Sedai standards and among the top tier of channelers among the Rebel Aes Sedai. Among the Salidar Six, she is as strong as Anaiya Carel, Morvrin Thakanos and Myrelle Berengari, but not as strong as Sheriam Bayanar.

entities.name: Fera Sormen
entities.description:
Fera is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of .

She was born in , and went to the White Tower in . She spent 13 years as a novice and 9 as Accepted.

She was on the White Tower secret expedition to kidnap Rand al'Thor in Cairhien.

She was taken prisoner by the Asha'man at Dumai's Wells and has sworn fealty to Rand al'Thor. However, unlike the other Aes Sedai, her oath was a lie.

entities.name: Ester Stepashin
entities.description:
Ester is under five feet tall, with large brown eyes, a short cap of dark brown curls and a small, upturned nose. She is cute, almost doll-like, which she does not like having pointed out, any more than she enjoys anyone referring to her height.

With a strength level is , she is strong for an Aes Sedai. She is strong enough to Travel.

Among the ten ferrets, Ester is the second in hierarchy by strength and years of training.

Ester is 45 years old. She was born in 955 NE and went to the White Tower in 972 NE. After spending seven years as a novice and eight years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

entities.name: Stole of the Amyrlin Seat
entities.description:
The Stole of the Amyrlin Seat is one of the symbolic items of regalia worn by the Amyrlin Seat. It is a long strip of silk, about "a hand wide" that the Amyrlin wears over her dress, that traditionally contains seven bands of color, one for each Ajah. Robert Jordan confirmed the order of these colors for the graphic novel:}}

These colors are also repeated on the hems of the dresses of Accepted in the White Tower.

The size of the stole is a mystery. It is generally described as "broad," in contrast to the "narrow" stole of the Keeper of the Chronicles. Egwene al'Vere can store the stole in her belt pouch. Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan's stole is "wide enough to cover her shoulders." Perhaps, like the width of the Keeper's stole, the width of the Amyrlin's is based at least partly on personal preference.

Just after the coup, Elaida is seen wearing the traditional seven-striped stole. However, she clearly resented the Blue Ajah and appeared in dreams wearing a six-striped stole with no blue stripe on three occasions. It is not clear when she made this a reality, but she is noted as wearing the six-striped version by Alviarin Freidhen on her return from Tremalking and by Tarna Feir after Alviarin's replacement. Around the same time, the disbanding of the Blue Ajah was first mentioned. It's possible that the declaration of war by Egwene al'Vere in Murandy towards the end of The Path of Daggers was a precipitating event that caused such an irrevocable rift that Elaida could make her dreams a reality.

entities.description:
The stole of the Keeper of the Chronicles is a symbol of office for the Aes Sedai in the position of Keeper of the Chronicles. It is a strip of fabric in the color of the wearer's Ajah, worn over her dress, hanging from behind her neck and down her torso. The width of the stole is decided by the Keeper.

entities.name: Aeldene Stonebridge
entities.description:
Aeldene Stonebridge is an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah.

She has a crooked nose that was said to have been gotten from fighting with her fists as a girl.

Aeldene is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler. Siuan describes her as "no more than middling" in strength.

She is from the Mountains of Mist in Andor.

entities.name: Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai
entities.description:
This article is about the distribution of One Power strength among Third Age Aes Sedai. For a list of all strength rankings and an explanation of the numbering system, see One Power strength rankings.

The following table gives a full list of strengths of Aes Sedai according to their entries in The Wheel of Time Companion. If there are no Aes Sedai at a given level, it is not included below. Those who are in training as novices are marked with *, those who are Accepted are marked with **. The Kin are not included in this list. See Strength in the One Power among the Kin for more details. {| class="wikitable sortable" style="background-color: #dimgray;" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5" ! style="text-align:center;" | Strength Level ! style="text-align:center;" | White Tower initiates ! style="text-align:center;" | Notes

Some modification and explanations are required:

The Companion lists Cadsuane's strength as , which would be significantly stronger than Elayne/Egwene/Aviendha's potential and just below Nynaeve. Additionally, the Companion entry for Tamela calls the Wise One "the equal of Cadsuane, with a strength level of ".

entities.name: Sulmara
entities.description:
In FY 450, history records that she was removed from her home kingdom by the Aes Sedai and taken to Tar Valon, where she spent many years mucking out the White Tower stables as a lesson in humility.

It is not known why this was done, although there are many theories. Some suggest that Sulmara was an Aes Sedai (maybe the last to rule openly as Queen and Aes Sedai before Elayne Trakand some 1,700 years later) who had returned home to rule her kingdom without the Amyrlin Seat's leave, although this is not considered likely. It is also suggested that Sulmara was simply a Queen who had ignored her Aes Sedai advisor's suggestions one time too many, compelling the sisters to make an example to show that even a Queen was not beyond the White Tower's power.

entities.name: Valene Sural
entities.description:
Valene is new to the shawl, so she lacks the ageless look of the Aes Sedai.

Valene has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

She was born in 972 NE and went to the White Tower in 988 NE. She was a novice for five years and Accepted for six. She was raised in 999 NE.

Since Valene lacks the ageless look, she was chosen for the expedition to Cairhien.

entities.name: Talva
entities.description:
Talva was an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah. She was also part of the Black Ajah.

She is thin, and wears her golden hair in a bun.

Talva is among the Black sisters who flee the White Tower before the Black Ajah hunters can question them.

While eavesdropping on Egwene al'Vere, Nynaeve al'Meara and Elayne Trakand in Tel'aran'rhiod, Talva unknowingly sets off one of Egwene's wards. She begins to weave Fire at Egwene when the Amyrlin comes to investigate, but is too slow, and Egwene shields her and binds her in flows of Air instead.

entities.name: Samitsu Tamagowa
entities.description:
She is a slim, pretty, hazel-eyed Arafellin, who wears bells in her dark, braided hair.

She had a commanding, overbearing manner and could be petulant when balked.

As a Healer, Samitsu does not care if she gets bloodied or messy.

Samitsu is 144 years old. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . After spending nine years as a novice and four years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .

entities.name: Tamra Ospenya's Searchers
entities.description:
After the Foretelling that Gitara Moroso had that the Dragon had been reborn on the slopes of Dragonmount, Tamra Ospenya used the Accepted Moiraine Damodred and Siuan Sanche to deliver five messages to five sisters. These were to be Tamra Ospenya's Searchers for the Dragon Reborn.

All five of these women were people that Tamra thought she could trust to keep her secret about the Dragon being reborn. All of them had been Aes Sedai for well over a hundred years - presumably she had known them all almost from the time she was training as novice or Accepted. All of them also had a reputation for adhering very strictly to the law. This is important because, as Amyrlin, she can have the information Sealed to the Flame and these women are likely to take their duties and orders very seriously and never betray the secret of the Dragon Reborn. It is also possible that, because of their strict adherence to the law, they would also take the Prophecies of the Dragon seriously and be more faithful in their duties.

The details of the searchers and their fates are as follows:

entities.name: Serafelle Tanisloe
entities.description:
Serafelle is 5'4 tall, and pretty in a plump fashion, with brown hair and large hazel eyes. Sometimes, especially when thinking, she had the physical mannerisms of a spoiled noblewoman.

She was a quick study and a fast learner—very observant, very intelligent and quick-witted.

Serafelle is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Serafelle was born in Murandy in to mid-level nobility.

entities.name: Kwamesa Taramasu
entities.description:
Kwamesa Taramasu was an Aes Sedai and rebel Sitter of the Gray Ajah.

Kwamesa was dark and slender with a sharp nose. She was of average height, 5'3 1/2 tall., Kwamesa Taramasu|comp}}

She has the habit of peering down her nose at everyone and put great store in ceremony. Some thought her precocious.

There is potentially conflicting infomation on Kwamesa's exact strength in the One Power. The Companion lists her strength level as , which would make her strong for an Aes Sedai. In the books, however, Nynaeve thinks that Reanne Corly "easily equaled Sheriam, say, or Kwamesa or Kiruna. Not many women possessed so much strength". The other three women in that list all have a strength of . Nynaeve may simply be grouping strong sisters together, but she has met several Aes Sedai stronger than Kwamesa to use as examples - all the members of the Salidar Six, for example. Being would make her very strong for an Aes Sedai.

entities.name: Larelle Tarsi
entities.description:
She had long dark hair with white wings and copper skin. She had thin eyebrows. She is elegant.

Larelle had a strength in the One Power of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. At the time of New Spring, she is stronger in the One Power than Moiraine Damodred, although Moiraine would eventually be stronger once she reached her full strength.

She taught Moiraine in several classes, both as novice and Accepted and had a way of asking the question you least wanted to hear. Her pupils were torn between being intimidated by her and wanting to be her. Every girl in her classes thought her the perfect sister. She had a way of asking the last question you wanted to hear.

While Moiraine Damodred is out searching for the Dragon Reborn she meets up with Larelle in Kandor.

entities.name: Namine Tasil
entities.description:
She is the eldest daughter of Quillin Tasil. Her mother was one of the most successful silk merchants in Bandar Eban. Since her father is still alive, it can be assumed that Namine is a relatively young Aes Sedai.

She went to the White Tower and joined the Brown Ajah, settling down as a Librarian. Cadsuane Melaidhrin was impressed with Namine's understanding of current events and followed the link down to her father, an Andoran innkeeper in Bandar Eban, who became one of her eyes-and-ears.

entities.name: Pevara Tazanovni
entities.description:
Pevara Tazanovni is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah.

Pevara is a pretty woman with large dark, twinkling eyes, short black hair and a merry face., Pevara Tazanovni|Pevara}} She is "pleasingly plump", stout and 5'4" or 163 cm in height. Her personality is cheerful, and she has a ready smile. She does not dislike men, as many Red Sisters do; instead, her devotion to her Ajah comes from her belief that gentling male channelers is a way for her to challenge the Shadow to the best of her abilities.

Pevara has a One Power strength of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}} She is weak in Earth.

She is capable of opening a Gateway and possesses the Talent of Healing. Seaine Herimon notes she was very good at hunting down men who can channel.

entities.name: Cariandre Temalien
entities.description:
Cariandre is plump, full-bosomed and 5'5 tall. She was good-looking, though not a beauty. She is described as wearing elaborately red-embroidered gray silk. She has dark eyes and hair which she wore cut short, exposing her ears.

She cultivated a cool, reserved air, such as she imagined a noblewoman to have. However, she also had a bad temper, and would snap at people she should not (such as sisters who stood above her) and say things better left unsaid.

Cariandre is very weak for an Aes Sedai, with a strength in the One Power of . We know of only a handful of Aes Sedai that are weaker. She is the same strength as Siuan Sanche after Siuan was Healed from stilling.

She was born in Ghealdan in . Cariandre was the daughter of a shoemaker. She went to the White Tower in where she spent thirteen years as a novice and twelve as Accepted. She was raised to the shawl in 972 NE.

entities.name: Berisha Terakuni
entities.description:
Berisha Terakuni was an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

She had hard eyes and a narrow face. She was lean and the same height as Egwene al'Vere. She spoke with a strong Arafellin accent.

We have no precise description of Berisha's strength in the One Power from the Companion, although her ability to open a gateway large enough for a cart with passenger to pass through indicates she is at least a strength of . She also seems to offer resistance to Katerine Alruddin, which she would not be able to do if she were much weaker. Since Katerine has a strength of , Berisha can be guessed to have a level between and , making her considerably above average among Aes Sedai.

She was from Arafel. She stood high in the Aes Sedai hierarchy.

entities.name: Teramina
entities.description:
Teramina is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Teramina|Teramina}}

She has been an Aes Sedai for years and is very weak in the One Power.

She disappears from the White Tower after Egwene al'Vere becomes Amyrlin Seat and asks all Aes Sedai to re-swear the Three Oaths on the Oath Rod. This would put strong suspicion on her being Black Ajah.

Egwene thought Teramina might have been posing Mesaana, but she had been in the White Tower for years.

entities.name: Tesan
entities.description:
Tesan is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is an arithmetist who applies numbers to logic.

She has the typical beaded braids of a Taraboner. Her hair is dark and she has a narrow face.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the Schism.

In the White Tower, Alviarin Freidhen hears her discussing statistical methods relating to the failing of the Keepings on the food storerooms in the Tower with Astrelle.

entities.name: Tetsuan
entities.description:
Records regarding the appearance of Tetsuan are scant. Scraps of history imply that she was "plain" in her appearance though exceptionally strong in her ability to channel. Records indicate that until the arrival of Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan at the White Tower, Tetsuan was considered an exceptional novice and the strongest channeler of her era; possessing strength greater than all other Aes Sedai of the time and was exceeded only by the legendary Aes Sedai Caraighan Maconar who had died nearly 700 years previous. Tetsuan's absolute strength in the power is unknown, but given that she was less powerful than both Caraighan Maconar (who was rated as on the power strength scale, Caraighan Maconar}} ) and Eldrene (strength unknown but also exceeded by Caraighan Maconar), it is reasonable to assume Tetsuan's strength to be between and .

Due to the loss of knowledge that accompanied the destruction of records during the Trolloc Wars, very little of Tetsuan's history is known to loremasters. Her region of birth and her surname have both been forgotten.

What is known about her is that she arrived at the White Tower as a novice circa AB 1105 during the middle years of the Trolloc Wars. For a short time Tetsuan was regarded as the strongest potential channeler of her era. This prestige ended with the arrival of fellow novice Eldrene ay Ellan ay Carlan of Manetheren.

White Tower records imply that Tetsuan and Eldrene quickly emerged as adversaries and that Tetsuan developed an adolescent jealousy of Eldrene's overwhelming beauty and greater strength in the power. Specific details of their animosity are unknown, though it is believed that because she had a "plain" appearance, Tetsuan bent all of her time towards her studies in an effort to become more prestigious than Eldrene but was never quite able to surpass her rival. Both were raised to full Aes Sedai circa AB 1115, with Tetsuan choosing the Red Ajah. Soon after receiving her shawl, Eldrene departed the White Tower and returned to Manetheren, eventually marrying and bonding King Aemon al Caar al Thorin many years later and becoming his queen. Tetsuan is believed to have remained in the tower.

entities.name: Morvrin Thakanos
entities.description:
Morvrin Thakanos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Morvrin is 5'5" tall, round-faced and stout, with graying hair, brown eyes, plump hands, and ample hips.

Morvrin is a placid sort, and sometimes has an absently vague look. She requires a great deal of proof for anything.

Morvrin is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai. Among the Salidar Six, she is equaled by Myrelle Berengari, Carlinya Sorevin and Anaiya Carel with only Sheriam Bayanar stronger and Beonin Marinye weaker. However Morvrin serves the distinction of being much more senior, having worn the shawl for more than a hundred and fifty years longer than the others.

entities.name: The Vileness
entities.description:
The Vileness is a term quietly used by some Aes Sedai to refer to a period of treachery and murder that occurred between the years and ., Vileness, the|Vileness}} It began with the discovery by the Black Ajah that the Dragon had been reborn. This was followed by a pogrom aimed at gentling or killing as many potential candidates as possible.

During the six-year period over ten-thousand men and boys would lose their lives, along with thirty to fifty Aes Sedai sisters and two Amyrlins. Only fifteen to twenty-five were men who could channel, the official number being only seven. Two-thousand of the male deaths are recorded in the secret histories of the Tower. The Vileness would also deepen already existing animosities between factions within the White Tower; most notably between the Red and Blue Ajahs.

For centuries, a secret cabal of Darkfriend Aes Sedai, the Black Ajah, existed within the White Tower. The Black Ajah recruited sisters from among all the legitimate Ajahs to serve them, and they worked in great secrecy. One of the reasons for the Black Ajah's existence was to provide the Shadow with access to the Dragon Reborn, since it was assumed that the Aes Sedai would locate and either take control of or ally with the true Dragon Reborn when he emerged. The Black Ajah was led by a Supreme Council, with one woman as Head of the Council, and reported to the Forsaken Ishamael during the rare periods when he was at liberty from Shayol Ghul.

After Gitara Moroso died the Black Ajah heard rumours connecting her death with a Foretelling, one which had the Amyrlin Seat, Tamra Ospenya, making secret and hasty plans with influential senior sisters.

entities.name: Third War of Garen's Wall
entities.description:
The Third War of Garen's Wall was a military conflict fought some time around . Historical records of this war are patchy at best, possibly due to Aes Sedai machinations. It is not even known who fought the war, although Ghealdan, which controls the ridgeline of Garen's Wall, was almost certainly involved. Altara, which lay to the east, may have also been involved, but it is also possible it was a civil war within Ghealdan itself.

Aes Sedai meddling in the records is possible due to the fact the sisters themselves teach in history classes within the White Tower that the then-Amyrlin Seat, Shein Chunla, caused the war due to bungled mishandling of the situation. However, what is not taught is that some ascribe the mistakes of this period to the Hall of the Tower of the time, which was effectively ruling by decree and overruling Chunla's authority. The situation grew so bad that Chunla and the Sitters were all deposed in a mutiny launched by the other sisters.

Records of this mutiny and Chunla's fate (smothered to death by sisters fifty years later to prevent her being reinstalled on the Amyrlin Seat) are sealed in the Thirteenth Depository of the White Tower library. Category:Aes Sedai Category:New Era Category:Wars

entities.name: Marris Thornhill
entities.description:
Marris is described as being plump-chinned. She usually seemed mild and absorbed in her studies.

Marris is exceptionally weak for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power strength level of . She is the second weakest known Aes Sedai, just above Daigian Moseneillin, and so at the bottom of the hierarchy. It may be speculated that being at such a disadvantage with respect to other Aes Sedai would make her bitter enough to join the Black Ajah.

Marris' history is not given in the books or Companion, although some details may be inferred. Her lack in strength means she would have spent a long time in training. Daigian, of similar strength, was in training for forty eight years whereas two other weak Aes Sedai, Bennae Nalsad and Cariandre Temalien were in training for twenty-four and twenty-five years respectively. Marris is considerably weaker than these two, however. Her connection with Leane Sharif and Elin Warrel may indicate they were in training together, but this is less certain.

She spends long periods in the White Tower itself.
